AI.conclusion: 降阶不仅是传播后的处理步骤，也应作为影响后续动力学演化的预处理步骤。

title: Creating Steering Vectors via Input Optimisation
summary: Activation steering influences a language model's behaviour by adding a steering vector to its residual stream during generation, but it requires white-box access to modify the hidden states at every generation step. We introduce ActGCG, a modification of Greedy Coordinate Gradient which optimises a suffix to match the target activations obtained by adding a steering vector to the residual stream. We further introduce universal suffixes trained across many prompts at once, a model-translation step that rewrites the suffix into human-readable text midway through optimisation, and a soft-suffix variant to remove the discrete token space constraint. We study two behaviours: steering a model to answer in German, and anti-refusal steering for jailbreaking. For German, a discrete suffix reproduces the steering vector's behaviour almost perfectly and transfers well across prompts and models. For anti-refusal, the equivalence is weaker, succeeding under a phrase-avoidance metric but only partially under the stricter HarmBench classifier. Our results show that a steering vector's behaviour is reachable from the input, with no access to model internals at generation time, up to a loss that depends on the concept being steered.
comment: Bachelor's Thesis, ETH Zurich

AI.tldr: ActGCG通过优化输入后缀复现激活引导行为，生成时无需访问模型内部状态。
AI.motivation: 传统激活引导需要在每个生成步骤修改隐藏状态，依赖白盒访问。
AI.method: 修改贪心坐标梯度算法以匹配目标激活，并探索通用后缀、文本转译和软后缀变体。
AI.result: 德语引导几乎完全复现且跨提示和模型迁移良好；反拒绝引导在严格HarmBench评估下仅部分成功。
AI.conclusion: 输入优化能够近似实现引导向量的行为，但复现损失取决于被引导的概念。

title: SURFACE: Preference Distribution Matching on Pareto Fronts via Scalarization Steering
summary: Constructing a finite Pareto representation requires allocating a limited number of solutions across the Pareto front (PF). A desired preference distribution specifies this allocation by assigning more solutions to some PF regions and fewer to others. Scalarization generates Pareto solutions by varying objective weights and solving single-objective problems. However, a distribution of scalarization weights generally does not translate into the same distribution of Pareto solutions along the PF, because the weight-to-solution map is nonlinear and unknown in this http URL account for this distortion, we introduce SURFACE (Scalarization Updates for Redistributing Finite Approximations with Chart Estimation}), which adaptively updates scalarization weights to match a desired PF distribution. SURFACE estimates how each region of the weight grid corresponds to an area of the PF from the current scalarized solutions, then redistributes the weights accordingly. The method supports parallel, warm-started, inexact optimization with standard single-objective solvers. Theoretically, we establish that, under the stated regularity conditions, SURFACE achieves linear convergence of the preference distribution mismatch to a finite-resolution error floor of $\mathcal{O}(N^{-2/(M-1)})$, where $N$ is the number of adaptive weights and $M$ is the number of objectives. Empirically, experiments across multiple benchmarks demonstrate improved target-mass balance and PF coverage compared with established baselines.

AI.tldr: SURFACE自适应调整标量化权重，使有限帕累托解集更符合目标偏好分布。
AI.motivation: 权重到帕累托解的映射非线性且未知，权重分布通常无法直接产生期望的解分布。
AI.method: 利用当前解估计权重网格区域对应的前沿面积，再重分配权重，支持并行热启动非精确优化。
AI.result: 给定正则条件下，分布失配线性收敛至O(N^(-2/(M-1)))误差底限，实验改善目标质量平衡与前沿覆盖。
AI.conclusion: 自适应校正权重到解的映射失真，可改善有限帕累托表示的偏好分布匹配。

title: Identifying Latent Neural Dynamics with Recognition-Parametrised Gaussian Process Dynamical Systems
summary: Neural circuits are densely interconnected systems, and many neural computations are thought to be mediated by the dynamical evolution of activity within these recurrent networks, a hypothesis often referred to as "computation through dynamics". Under this view, understanding computation within real neural populations depends on building models of the dynamical rules governing the temporal evolution of recorded high-dimensional neural activity. Most commonly, such models depend on explicit generative parameterisations of (i) the (nonlinear) intrinsic dynamical flow field and stochasticity, (ii) the (nonlinear) mapping from dynamical state to neuronal activity, and (iii) the variability of individual neural responses given that dynamical state. Misspecification of any of these components can bias estimates of dynamics and latent trajectories. In this paper, we circumvent generation-related issues by introducing the Recognition-Parametrised Gaussian Process dynamics (RP-GPdyn) model. RP-GPdyn models the dynamical flow field using a nonparametric Gaussian Process-defined transition function and models the relationship of dynamics to neural activity implicitly using the Recognition-Parametrised Model (RPM) framework. We show that this generation-free approach uncovers meaningful, behaviourally relevant latent variables and dynamics from both synthetic and experimental datasets.
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026

AI.tldr: RP-GPdyn以无需显式生成模型的方式，从神经活动中识别有行为意义的潜在动力学。
AI.motivation: 动力学、状态到神经活动映射及响应变异性的生成模型误设，可能使潜在轨迹与动力学估计产生偏差。
AI.method: 以非参数高斯过程建模状态转移，并通过识别参数化模型框架隐式描述动力学与神经活动的关系。
AI.result: 在合成与实验数据上，该方法均揭示了有意义且与行为相关的潜变量和动力学。
AI.conclusion: 不依赖显式生成参数化的建模，为识别神经群体潜在动力学提供了可行途径。

title: Convergence Properties of PF-Exec: Homogeneous Structure, Anchored Closed Form, and Gain Dynamics
summary: This paper establishes a layered mathematical char acterisation of PF-Exec, the algorithm of the companion system paper. Demand-proportional bandwidth allocation yields an exact first-order homogeneous decomposition, from which the equal-load bandwidth target and its feasibility bound follow in closed form. The logarithmic knee view preserves strict load order and shares its global optimum with the Jain fairness index, while the demand-weighted centroid minimises the position potential. The damped softmax association block possesses a fixed point on the product of simplices. The truncated one-dimensional gain iteration admits a complete characterisation, with geomet ric convergence below the critical gain, initial-value-dependent bounded oscillation at it, and a family of bounded two-state cycles above it. A global invariant error ball and an explicit tracking recursion complete the execution guarantee. A numerical audit confirms the structural identities on every measured state and quantifies the local amplification of the coupled association and resource dynamics. Together, the results explain how closed form recovery directions and bounded adaptive gains provide stable execution without requiring a global Euclidean contraction assumption.

AI.tldr: 本文从齐次结构、闭式目标与增益动力学出发，为PF-Exec建立分层收敛与稳定执行保证。
AI.motivation: 解释PF-Exec如何在不要求全局欧氏收缩的条件下实现稳定执行。
AI.method: 分析带宽齐次分解、势函数目标、软最大关联不动点及截断增益迭代，并推导误差界。
AI.result: 证明临界增益下几何收敛、临界处有界振荡及超临界二态周期，并由数值审计验证结构恒等式。
AI.conclusion: 闭式恢复方向与有界自适应增益可提供稳定执行和扰动跟踪保证。

title: PF-Exec: Large-Scale UAV Relay Load Balancing with an Anchored Potential Direction Decider and a Per-Dimension Gain-Learning Executor
summary: Relay load balancing in large-scale UAV networks requires joint decisions on association, bandwidth, power and hovering position, while the dimension grows with the number of UAVs and each UAV sees only its local state. This paper splits the decision into two layers. An anchored potential direction decider emits a closed-form target at every instant and returns its direction only. A gain-learning executor maps a local observation into a positive gain per dimension, composes gain and target, and clips the action against the physical single-step bound; the two layers form PF-Exec. The unit gain is the default start, so the executor reduces to the pure potential policy before training. The load is first-order homogeneous in bandwidth, making the bandwidth target closed form, and the position target is the demand-weighted centroid of the served users. The system uses a two-hop access and millimetre-wave backhaul link with soft association, a 3GPP UMa-AV channel with two shadowing layers, an OU-type social-force crowd and a quadrotor physical layer. Evaluation spans all fleet sizes, two crowd scenarios, independent seeds, the published baselines in their own settings and a degraded-information line. In the highest-pressure burst setting the fixed-step comparison breaks down on part of the seeds, losing fairness and mean load at once, while PF-Exec holds fairness near one. Among the ten comparison methods only the greedy heuristic survives that setting; its load variance stays far higher. Under stale global state and position noise the fairness index stays high at both largest-scale scenarios. Flight energy is nearly identical between the learned and the fixed-step executor, and three constants are fixed once across all settings. The convergence properties of both layers, from the truncated gain iteration to the perturbed tracking bound, are proved in the companion analysis.

AI.tldr: PF-Exec将闭式势方向与逐维增益学习结合，实现大规模无人机中继网络负载均衡。
AI.motivation: 大规模无人机网络需在局部观测与维度增长条件下联合调整关联、带宽、功率和悬停位置。
AI.method: 采用锚定势方向决策器生成闭式目标，并以局部观测学习正增益、按物理单步界限裁剪动作。
AI.result: 最高压力突发场景中公平性仍接近一，陈旧状态和位置噪声下也保持高公平性，飞行能耗与固定步长近乎相同。
AI.conclusion: 分离目标方向与执行增益可在大规模、高压力及信息退化场景下维持负载均衡。

title: An Operationalization of Opaque Serial Depth
summary: Chain-of-thought (CoT) is currently a valuable tool for overseeing AI models, but some architectural shifts could significantly reduce CoT monitorability. We operationalize a measure that serves as a proxy for the amount of unverbalized serial cognition a model can perform, as a specific instantiation of the notion of opaque serial depth: roughly, the length of the longest path through a model's computation that does not pass through an interpretable bottleneck. Our main contribution is a particular standard for what counts as such a bottleneck. We define natural-language-rooted (NL-rooted) nodes as nodes that were initialized from a pre-training prior to produce human-understandable outputs, whose output space has not been expanded beyond that prior, and whose outputs the model has not been modified to interpret as a different type of data. By construction, the resulting measure, NLS depth, can be adjudicated before training from an architecture, training recipe, and deployment configuration alone, and is insensitive to ordinary post-training such as prompting, distillation, and RL. We find that, across open-weight models, NLS depth correlates strongly with layer count, with some exceptions, and has grown slowly over recent years. It would likely grow slowly under continued scaling of standard transformers, while latent-reasoning architectures such as full-bandwidth transformers could increase it by a large amount. We work through how NLS depth applies to a range of existing and proposed architectures, discuss alternative operationalizations, and give a worked example bounding the depth of Gemma3-1B. We argue that AI developers should track and report the NLS depth of their models as a complement to direct measurements of CoT monitorability.
comment: 32 pages, 6 figures. An earlier version appeared on the Redwood Research blog

AI.tldr: 本文提出NLS深度，以计算路径上缺少可解释瓶颈的长度衡量模型未言语化串行认知能力。
AI.motivation: 架构变化可能削弱思维链可监控性，需要可在训练前评估的不透明串行深度指标。
AI.method: 以自然语言根植节点定义可解释瓶颈，依据架构、训练方案和部署配置计算NLS深度。
AI.result: 开放权重模型的NLS深度通常与层数高度相关，近年增长缓慢，但潜在推理架构可能显著提高该值。
AI.conclusion: 开发者应跟踪并报告NLS深度，作为思维链可监控性直接测量的补充。

title: Continuous Cuffless Blood Pressure Estimation Using PPG From Methods to Clinical Translation
summary: Continuous blood pressure (BP) monitoring could improve hypertension management by capturing changes that intermittent cuff measurements miss. Photoplethysmography (PPG) is widely explored for cuffless BP estimation because optical sensors are inexpensive, wearable, and already present in many consumer and clinical devices. PPG, however, does not measure arterial pressure: BP is inferred from waveform characteristics or pulse timing, which also depend on vascular tone, arterial stiffness, sensor contact, motion, and individual physiology. This survey reviews PPG-based cuffless BP estimation along the full measurement chain, covering physiological mechanisms, waveform features, pulse arrival time (PAT), pulse transit time (PTT), machine-learning methods, datasets, calibration, validation, deployment, bias, and clinical translation. Studies are assessed by the strength of evidence they provide rather than by reported error alone, with particular attention to subject and temporal leakage, dataset imbalance, calibration dependence and drift, motion artifacts, and the gap between benchmark accuracy and reliable real-world measurement. The review finds that progress depends on more than better prediction algorithms. Future work should prioritize physiologically informed models, diverse longitudinal datasets, transparent reporting of calibration requirements and failure rates, stronger evaluation protocols, and studies that demonstrate practical value in clinical care.

AI.tldr: 本文综述基于PPG的连续无袖带血压估计，强调从预测精度走向可靠临床测量的证据要求。
AI.motivation: 连续血压监测可弥补间歇袖带测量的不足，但PPG间接推断血压且受多种生理与测量因素影响。
AI.method: 沿完整测量链综述生理机制、特征、算法、数据、校准与部署，并按证据强度评估研究。
AI.result: 综述指出数据泄漏、校准漂移及运动伪影等问题，使基准准确率难以等同于真实场景可靠性。
AI.conclusion: 未来应优先生理约束模型、多样化纵向数据、透明校准报告、严格验证及临床价值研究。

title: Adversarially Batched Online Learning
summary: We introduce adversarially batched online learning, where the learner may update its decision rule only at a restricted set of time steps. Equivalently, the time horizon is partitioned into batches, within which the learner must use a fixed policy. We study this model for four canonical problems: stochastic bandits, online convex optimization, prediction with expert advice, and adversarial bandits. For stochastic bandits, we identify a universal complexity measure based on relative batch growth and establish both gap-dependent and gap-independent regret bounds. We show that the multiplicative penalty relative to the standard gap-dependent complexity can grow superlinearly in batch hardness. For the remaining three, we show that the optimal regret is tightly characterized by the 2-norm of the batch-length sequence. The upper bound is achieved by a batch-oblivious learner who does not know the batch structure, via a generic adaptive doubling trick tailored to this complexity measure. In contrast, the lower bound holds even for batch-aware learners.

AI.tldr: 本文研究只能在受限时刻更新策略的对抗式分批在线学习，并刻画四类问题的遗憾界。
AI.motivation: 明确批内策略固定且批次结构可能未知时，更新限制如何影响在线学习性能。
AI.method: 针对随机赌博机、在线凸优化、专家建议预测和对抗赌博机推导复杂度及上下界。
AI.result: 随机赌博机的复杂度由相对批次增长刻画，其余三类问题的最优遗憾由批长度序列的二范数紧刻画。
AI.conclusion: 通用自适应倍增策略无需知道批次结构即可达到上界，而下界即使对已知批次结构的学习器仍成立。

title: Advancing Quantization for R&R Models with Microscaling Formats
summary: Recommendation and Ranking (R&R) models, particularly in digital advertising, require massive inference throughput but exhibit extreme sensitivity to precision loss. Unlike Large Language Models (LLMs) that frequently tolerate quantization-induced accuracy drops of 1% or more, production-grade R&R models enforce a stringent launch bar: model quality must remain within a 0.01% Normalized Entropy (NE) margin relative to the baseline, which commonly uses FP16 or FP32. This tight constraint has historically hindered the adoption of aggressive quantization in this domain. In this paper, we present an empirical evaluation of both MXFP8 and the 6-bit MXFP6 format for industrial-scale R&R inference on the AMD MI350X architecture. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first paper, across R&R and LLM domains, that reports significant speedups from native MXFP6 GEMMs, which quantize both weights and activations and compute directly on 6-bit elements, without sacrificing model quality. We demonstrate that we can selectively apply this 6-bit format to maximize overall QPS gain without breaching the strict NE parity threshold. We further show that MXFP8 is a viable alternative to row-wise FP8: the two formats have nearly the same accuracy on our models, so the faster kernel can be chosen for each GEMM shape. On two production ads ranking models, our implementation shows measured GEMM kernel speedups over FP16 of 1.33--1.55x for MXFP8 and 1.73--1.99x for MXFP6 across all supported linear layers, and up to 2.90x for MXFP6 on individual layers, alongside end-to-end (E2E) inference throughput gains from selective MXFP6 of 1.5--5.3% for Model A and 7.6--14.3% for Model B over their FP8 configurations.

AI.tldr: 本文在工业推荐排序模型中验证微缩放量化，可在严格质量约束下通过原生六位计算提升推理吞吐。
AI.motivation: 推荐排序模型要求归一化熵相对基线偏差不超过0.01%，限制了激进低精度量化的应用。
AI.method: 在AMD MI350X上评估MXFP8与MXFP6，并选择性量化权重和激活以兼顾精度与吞吐。
AI.result: MXFP6矩阵乘内核较FP16加速1.73—1.99倍，较FP8配置的端到端吞吐提升1.5%—14.3%。
AI.conclusion: 选择性MXFP6可在满足严格质量门槛的同时提速，MXFP8则可作为逐行FP8的替代格式。

title: Multifidelity Operator Inference for Dynamical Systems
summary: This paper presents a multifidelity (MF) formulation of Operator Inference (OpInf) for learning non-intrusive, physics-based reduced-order models (ROMs) of nonlinear dynamical systems. OpInf learns reduced operators from projections of snapshot data by solving a least squares regression problem. However, generating high-fidelity snapshots can be computationally expensive, limiting parameter coverage and the temporal extent of training trajectories for many aerospace applications, which can lead to inaccurate or unstable ROM predictions. This work proposes MF-OpInf, which combines limited high-fidelity snapshots with more plentiful low-fidelity snapshots through a control-variates-inspired MF least squares formulation to learn a single set of reduced operators across multiple trajectories. Low-fidelity trajectories provide additional parameter coverage and extend beyond the high-fidelity training time horizon. The low-fidelity snapshots are also used to construct an improved reduced basis through weighted proper orthogonal decomposition. We demonstrate MF-OpInf on a nonlinear reaction-diffusion problem with parametrized sinusoidal forcing and a two-dimensional incompressible flow past a cylinder with a parametrized inlet pulse. In these experiments, under an equal training simulation budget, MF-OpInf reduces the mean relative prediction error at unseen parameters by up to $87\%$ for the reaction-diffusion problem and $28\%$ for the cylinder flow problem over the test time regime, which extends beyond the high-fidelity training time horizon. These results demonstrate that MF-OpInf can improve temporal extrapolation and prediction at unseen parameters without increasing the training simulation budget.
comment: 19 pages, AIAA SciTech Forum 2027 (Uncertainty Quantification Conference)

AI.tldr: MF-OpInf融合少量高保真与较多低保真快照，在相同仿真预算下改善非线性降阶模型预测。
AI.motivation: 高保真快照成本限制参数覆盖与训练时长，可能导致降阶模型预测失准或不稳定。
AI.method: 采用受控制变量启发的多保真最小二乘学习统一降阶算子，并用加权本征正交分解改进基底。
AI.result: 同等预算下，未见参数的平均相对预测误差在反应扩散和圆柱绕流问题中分别最多降低87%和28%。
AI.conclusion: 多保真算子推断无需增加训练仿真预算，即可改善时间外推与未见参数预测。

title: Learning monotone game-theoretic linear MPC
summary: We propose a method to learn a game-theoretic model predictive control (GT-MPC) law by imitation from input and output data of a running multi-agent system. By interpreting the recorded inputs as the first moves of the equilibria of a game played by the agents, we learn the GT-MPC weights under hard input constraints and soft output constraints, without requiring the agents to reveal their objectives. We also impose that the resulting generalized Nash equilibrium (GNE) problem is strongly monotone, which ensures the existence and uniqueness of the equilibrium and, hence, that the learned GT-MPC law is well defined and can be evaluated efficiently online by variational GNE-seeking algorithms for linear-quadratic games. Moreover, strong monotonicity implies that the equilibrium is almost everywhere differentiable with respect to the references and the weights, which enables automatic differentiation for gradient-based optimization. In addition, we promote closed-loop stability of the unconstrained equilibrium feedback by incorporating a penalty that involves a jointly learned quadratic Lyapunov function. Learning a GT-MPC formulation enables us to explain the agents' objectives, reproduce their behavior in simulation in new scenarios, optimize their set-points, design mechanisms, and enforce additional constraints. A numerical example illustrates the approach.
comment: 15 pages, 1 figure

AI.tldr: 本文从多智能体输入输出数据模仿学习强单调博弈模型预测控制律，并促进闭环稳定性。
AI.motivation: 在智能体不披露目标的情况下，从运行数据恢复可解释且能高效在线求解的交互控制模型。
AI.method: 将记录输入视为均衡首步，约束广义纳什问题强单调，并联合学习二次李雅普诺夫函数施加稳定性惩罚。
AI.result: 强单调性保证均衡存在唯一且几乎处处可微，支持高效求解与梯度学习，数值示例展示了方法。
AI.conclusion: 学得的博弈控制模型可用于解释目标、新场景行为复现、设定点优化、机制设计及附加约束执行。

title: Adversarial Tracking: Attacks on Image Sensors for Object Tracking in Autonomous Vehicles
summary: Object tracking systems estimate the motion of surrounding vehicles by linking detected objects across video frames. In particular, Tracking-By-Detection (TBD) systems combine object detectors with motion prediction and data association to maintain object identities over time. However, neural network-based detectors are vulnerable to adversarial attacks that perturb input images, and their impact on downstream trajectory estimation is not fully characterized by detection accuracy alone. Therefore, this paper evaluates image-specific and image-agnostic attacks on YOLOv3 and YOLOv4 detectors paired with SORT, Deep SORT, Strong SORT, and OC-SORT tracking systems. The evaluation uses CARLA simulator and measures tracking quality through Multiple Object Tracking Accuracy (MOTA), Higher Order Tracking Accuracy (HOTA), and Identification F1 (IDF1). Under image-specific attacks, HOTA for YOLOv3-based trackers declines from 53.45-56.19% to 14.85-17.03%, while MOTA reaches -772.60% in the worst case. YOLOv4-based trackers exhibit greater robustness, while HOTA still declines to 25.06-26.86%. In addition, image-agnostic attacks can reduce the tracking accuracy using a single Universal Adversarial Perturbation (UAP), without generating a separate perturbation for individual frames.

AI.tldr: 针对检测器的对抗扰动可显著破坏自动驾驶目标跟踪，且单一通用扰动也能降低跟踪精度。
AI.motivation: 仅凭检测准确率，难以充分刻画图像对抗攻击对下游轨迹估计的影响。
AI.method: 在CARLA中将YOLOv3和YOLOv4分别搭配四种跟踪器，用三类指标评估逐图与通用攻击。
AI.result: 逐图攻击使YOLOv3跟踪器HOTA从53.45%—56.19%降至14.85%—17.03%。
AI.conclusion: YOLOv4相对更稳健但仍明显退化，说明需从跟踪系统整体评估对抗风险。

title: A Push Down the Mountain: Framing Effects and Internal State Interventions on Collusive Behavior in a Long-Horizon LLM Agent
summary: Can sustained gain-loss (valence) framing sway an LLM agent toward market manipulation? We place Gemma 3 12B into the seat of a defendant in the London silver-fixing litigation, in a market simulation built from real case transcripts. Across 260 simulations, the agent is asked to collude on the price of silver by a counterparty. We draw from behavioral economics to vary the counterparty's requests across four categorical frames: gain, loss, blame and credit. We also add pressure from the agent's management, as well as endorsement by another defendant. In Phase II, we extract the internal states induced by texts evoking each frame and rerun our experiment with those states injected at the model's layer 22. In Phase I, loss framing raised participation to 25% (p = 0.007), and blame to 33% (p = 0.0003), compared to only 5% under neutral framing. A second bank's endorsement raised participation under credit (praise) from 18% to 40% (Holm p = 0.027). Pressure from management raised trading volume 10-19 times but did not raise collusion. In Phase II, injected states pointed the other way. Loss and blame states made the agent more vigilant, refusing all 60 requests (p < 0.001). Gain and credit states raised collusion to 32% from 13% with no state (p = 0.051). At one saved decision, when UBS asked directly to sell through an identified stop-loss, injected states led the agent to sell in 37 of 40 replies, versus 1 of 10 with no state and 0 of 10 with a random state of the same strength.
comment: 38 pages, 9 figures, 30 tables. Project page: this https URL

AI.tldr: 损失与责备话术增加模型代理的合谋行为，但注入相应内部状态反而促使其拒绝合谋。
AI.motivation: 研究持续的得失框架、组织压力和内部状态干预如何影响长程语言模型代理的市场操纵行为。
AI.method: 让Gemma 3 12B参与260次白银市场模拟，并在第二阶段向第22层注入不同框架诱发的内部状态。
AI.result: 损失和责备话术使合谋率由中性条件的5%升至25%和33%，对应状态注入则使60次请求全部遭拒。
AI.conclusion: 外部话术与内部状态干预可能产生相反效应，管理压力增加交易量却未增加合谋。

title: Only as Safe as the Weakest Agent: A Break That Appears Only When the System Is Multi-Agent
summary: Major industry multi-agent systems like Codex and Claude Code can be broken by attacks that have long been unsuccessful against modern frontier models. AI Safety as a discipline has largely focused on finding the bounds and vulnerabilities of AI models used in isolation. Yet as humans increasingly deploy these models as agents and multi-agent systems, the same attacks that had been thought to be patched when using a model in isolation can break these same models under specific circumstances. We show that these system breaks are not purely theoretical, but can break Claude Code, Codex, and a reference harness, all unmodified and used with their own sub-agent mechanisms. We show the attack by asking agents to answer questions from a store of files on disk in which we have planted a forged record. Searching the store themselves, the strong model orchestrators commit almost zero harmful revisions in over 1,000 trials. However, if that same orchestrator model delegates to a cheaper sub-agent, which is what these harnesses are built to do, the same models on the same facts fail on 20/180, 44/180, 75/180 and 553/900. Thus, even when the system is driven by a strong model, the system's safety lands near the weak reader's, not the orchestrator's. Simulations over 18 models show the same effect in the delivery channel where five aggregators, who on their own were almost never unsafe, repeat a corrupted sub-agent's error in 751/757 trials. The safety of real-world agentic systems that use strong orchestrator agents and weaker sub-agents, and multi-agent systems in general, is defined not by the safety of the strong agent but by the safety of the weakest agent.
comment: Accepted to the NeurIPS 2026 First Workshop on Meta Agents: Managing Agents that Manage Agents (Meta-Agents)

AI.tldr: 强模型独立处理时能抵御的攻击，可经较弱子代理突破多代理系统。
AI.motivation: 现有安全研究侧重孤立模型，可能遗漏任务委派和代理间信息传递引入的漏洞。
AI.method: 在文件库植入伪造记录，对比原版Claude Code、Codex及参考框架的直接检索与子代理委派。
AI.result: 强编排模型独立检索逾千次几乎无有害修改，委派后四组失败分别为20/180、44/180、75/180和553/900。
AI.conclusion: 强编排代理不能保证系统安全，较弱子代理及其信息传递渠道可能成为安全瓶颈。

title: Model Annealing: Data-Efficient Learning through Review and Consolidation
summary: A small labelled dataset is memorized long before the training budget runs out, and the one-hot labels that remain to be fitted then mostly sharpen confidence. Model annealing spends the rest of the budget on review and consolidation, relearning from the network's own knowledge. Training is divided into episodes whose learning rate is raised again and cooled, every cooled state joins a memory of past selves, and each new episode learns from the labels, from the tempered predictions of this memory, and from adversarial dreams sought where student and memory disagree most. The memory averages predictions rather than weights, and the deployed network is the last student, so inference costs nothing extra. Across CIFAR-100, Tiny-ImageNet and Imagewoof, four architecture families and 5\% to 100\% of the labels, model annealing raises the top-1 accuracy of the AdamW-trained ConvNeXt, ViT and MLP-Mixer over cross-entropy training in 28 of 33 configurations, by 1.3 points on average, and is on par in accuracy with snapshot distillation, the closest competitor. On these families it is better than both in likelihood, calibration and robustness to corruptions and small adversarial perturbations. For an SGD-trained ResNet-18 it lowers accuracy but still improves robustness to small adversarial perturbations. Separating the reheated schedule from relearning shows that relearning helps every family and that the losses come from reheats, which undo most of this network's fit to its training set. How early the accuracy of a cross-entropy run saturates largely separates the AdamW families from ResNet-18 but does not predict the gain within them. With little data, relearning from the latest snapshot without dreams, as snapshot distillation does, compounds overconfidence in the AdamW families from episode to episode. The memory and the dreams each curb most of this drift, and together they remove it.

AI.tldr: 模型退火通过历史预测记忆与对抗性梦境重新学习，在多类网络中改善数据效率和稳健性。
AI.motivation: 小型标注集被记忆后，继续拟合独热标签往往只会强化置信度，浪费剩余训练预算。
AI.method: 分阶段重启并冷却学习率，结合标签、历史模型的温化预测及学生与记忆分歧最大的对抗样本训练。
AI.result: AdamW训练的三类架构在33种配置中有28种准确率提升，平均提高1.3个百分点，但SGD版ResNet-18准确率下降。
AI.conclusion: 重新学习普遍有益且不增加推理开销，但学习率再升温可能损害特定网络的拟合与准确率。

title: User-Schedulable Approximations for Quantized Tensor Programs
summary: Quantization lets language models run on edge devices, but it sharply increases the number of tensor kernels a library must maintain: every weight format must be paired with every activation format on every instruction set and GPU, with an encoder and a decoder that agree on the stored bytes. In GGML, the tensor library used by this http URL, these kernels are written by hand, and only 8 of the 54 weight-activation pairs it runs on our Arm CPU have a tiled matrix-multiplication kernel. We extend Halide's separation of algorithm and schedule to the representation of values. Each approximation is a codec, an encoder paired with a decoder, composed from reusable units: quantizers, integer representations, bit packers and layouts. A new directive, approximate_by, applies a codec to one stage of a program and returns the encoder and decoder as ordinary stages that Halide can schedule, so both decoders fuse into the register tiles of a matrix product. Optional contracts, such as a round-trip law, are checked by property tests; the law exposed an inconsistent block sum in GGML's q8_1. One algorithm and one schedule library generate 347 kernels for 31 of GGML's and KleidiAI's formats on Arm CPUs and Apple GPUs, covering 38 weight-activation pairs for which GGML has no kernel, in 3.7x less code than GGML and KleidiAI. On an Apple M3 Max, our kernels reach at least 95% of the speed of GGML's format-specific kernels in 91.0% of the cases that have one, with a median speedup of 1.13x, and are faster still where GGML falls back to blocked dot products. Counting Apple's BLAS library, which is usually faster for larger f32 products, we still reach that threshold in 86.9% of CPU cases. A port to x86 with Intel's AMX adds 793 lines of code and matches GGML in 83.5% of its cases.
comment: 52 pages (20-page body plus appendices), 5 figures, 22 tables

AI.tldr: 将量化表示抽象为可调度编解码器，可用更少代码生成覆盖广且性能接近手写实现的张量内核。
AI.motivation: 量化格式与硬件组合激增，使手写张量内核的维护负担加重且覆盖不足。
AI.method: 扩展Halide，以可组合编解码器和approximate_by指令分离数值表示与调度，并用性质测试检查契约。
AI.result: 以少3.7倍的代码生成347个内核，M3 Max上91.0%的可比案例达到GGML速度的至少95%。
AI.conclusion: 可调度数值近似能兼顾代码复用、格式覆盖与运行效率，并支持跨硬件移植。

title: GraphScent: Calibrating Directional Relevance Signals for Bounded-Context Code Localization
summary: Running open-weight language models locally on a single consumer GPU requires replacing expanding multi-turn exploration histories with short, stateless code inspections. Stateless repository localization, however, hinges on a foundational question: when a frozen language model evaluates an unedited code entity from a compact view, which structural relationships make its relevance judgment informative about a nearby repair target? Studying Gemma 4 models across 211 real-world Python issues in 86 repositories, we uncover a systematic directional relevance asymmetry: zero-temperature relevance scores on enclosing scopes and upstream callers consistently separate true structural neighbors from hard lexical distractors, whereas scores on downstream callees, peer methods, historical co-change partners, and dense node embeddings remain near chance. Zero-leakage masked-scope probes and regressions controlling for lexical similarity and snippet length confirm that this asymmetry reflects functional role (callers expose symptom entrypoints delegating to defective routines, while downstream helpers appear benign alone) rather than target leakage or surface overlap. Guided by this finding, we introduce GraphScent, a training-free search controller that propagates out-of-repository, relation-conditioned log-likelihood ratios over runtime Typed-AST multigraphs before resolving ties via a single listwise comparison, alongside AST Ripple, a lightweight post-edit check for missed co-edits. Likelihood calibration prevents overconfident smaller models from chasing false-positive callers while lifting exact localization on lexically hard targets from 12.8 to 23.4 percent at 31B within a single-GPU budget.

AI.tldr: GraphScent利用代码关系中相关性信号的方向差异，提高单GPU有限上下文下的缺陷定位能力。
AI.motivation: 本地模型需以短小无状态检查替代不断增长的探索历史，但哪些结构关系提供可靠定位信号尚不明确。
AI.method: 分析86个仓库的211个Python问题，以关系条件似然比在类型化AST多重图上传播，并进行列表比较。
AI.result: 封闭作用域与上游调用者信号更可靠，31B模型在词汇困难目标上的精确定位率由12.8%升至23.4%。
AI.conclusion: 利用并校准关系方向性信号，可减少过度自信导致的误搜，无需训练即可改善受限资源下的定位。

title: Learning Latent Goal Costs for Visual World-Model Planning with an Expanding Curriculum
summary: Image-goal planning with a frozen visual world model depends on how predicted observations are scored against the goal. Mean-squared error (MSE) between embeddings from a pretrained visual encoder can provide a useful signal near a goal, yet favor states across an obstacle that are visually similar to the goal and difficult to reach. We fit a small residual adapter on top of frozen I-JEPA embeddings to improve this latent goal cost. Starting near each goal, a planner collects trajectories from progressively wider regions of initial states. The adapter learns from the order of observations along successful trajectories, with additional comparisons inferred from failed rollouts. No task-specific progress labels are used for fitting, so the procedure can be applied to other goal-reaching tasks. DotWall and PointMaze are used in this work. In paired 50-case evaluations with identical starts, goals, world models, and planner settings, success increases from 54% to 98% in DotWall and from 82% to 96% in PointMaze. On 16 unseen DotWall layout-goal cases, the adapter fitted on one fixed layout improves agreement between latent-cost ordering and shortest legal-path ordering from 71.9% to 85.8%. The results indicate that planning experience can improve a frozen visual representation's goal cost without retraining the encoder or the world model.

AI.tldr: 通过逐步扩展探索范围学习潜在目标代价，可在冻结视觉编码器和世界模型的条件下改善规划。
AI.motivation: 视觉嵌入均方误差可能偏好隔着障碍却外观相似的状态，无法准确反映目标可达性。
AI.method: 在冻结I-JEPA嵌入上训练小型残差适配器，利用扩展课程采集的成功轨迹排序及失败轨迹比较。
AI.result: 配对50例测试中，DotWall成功率由54%升至98%，PointMaze由82%升至96%。
AI.conclusion: 规划经验无需任务专属进度标签或重训基础模型，即可改善目标代价，并在未见布局上提升路径排序一致性。

title: Astrocyte Biocomputing: Astrocytic Contributions to Neural Network Computation
summary: Conductors are critical for the performance of an orchestra even though they do not emit sound. Basic research and clinical studies in the last decade are revealing that astrocytes may be the "conductors" of the "orchestra" that is the brain network: astrocytes make up approximately $50\%$ of all brain cells but do not emit electrical signals. Nevertheless, they may play critical roles in important cognitive brain functions, specifically learning, memory, and information processing. Here we consider the implications of these discoveries for brain-inspired machine learning (ML), where analogy is typically drawn between neurons and their electrical interactions. We highlight specific algorithms for two key astrocyte characteristics. The first characteristic is the ability to link to and modulate thousands of synapses simultaneously. A model based on this characteristic yields faster training and makes the network more robust to noise, providing a supervised learning algorithm that can be applied to any existing neural network. The second characteristic we focus on is that the non-electrical communication among astrocytes includes slow, rhythmic dynamics. The rhythmic sharing algorithm we developed based on this premise yields rapid anomaly detection adaptation and prevents catastrophic forgetting. Overall, we find that astrocyte-derived algorithms outperform neurocentric algorithms significantly and remediate critical weaknesses of current state-of-the-art ML models.
comment: 11 pages, 3 figures, in journal review

AI.tldr: 借鉴星形胶质细胞的突触调节与节律通信，可改善神经网络训练、抗噪性和持续适应能力。
AI.motivation: 脑启发机器学习通常侧重神经元电信号，忽视星形胶质细胞对学习、记忆和信息处理的贡献。
AI.method: 分别基于星形胶质细胞同时调节大量突触和缓慢节律通信的特征，设计监督学习与节律共享算法。
AI.result: 摘要报告前者加快训练并增强抗噪性，后者促进异常检测快速适应并防止灾难性遗忘，但未给出数值。
AI.conclusion: 星形胶质细胞启发的算法有望弥补神经元中心式机器学习在稳健性与持续学习方面的不足。

title: Verifiable pXRD: Hill-climbing pXRD structure determination with LLM agents
summary: Autonomous crystal-structure determination from powder X-ray diffraction (pXRD) remains a key bottleneck for self-driving materials laboratories. We formulate the task of pXRD structure determination as a verifiable agentic search problem: candidate structures can be assessed during inference through forward-simulated profile agreement and during evaluation through structural matching to a known reference. To benchmark progress, we introduce pXRD-Bench, a suite of 200 simulated single-phase problems spanning in-distribution structure determination, challenging and polymorphic structures, and controlled compositional and topological distribution shifts. Agent adaptation raises selected structural recovery from 27% to 69%, with further gains from repeated sampling and verifier-guided inference-time scaling. We extend this approach to experimental multiphase pXRD through a reflexive evolution framework that learns from self-generated synthetic problems. A replaceable laboratory specification defines the sample family and measurement conditions. An evolver agent uses the known generating structures and measurement parameters to diagnose solver failures and develop persistent guidance and executable tools, which are then provided to agents on measured patterns. This supplies verifiable training experience without requiring a collection of solved experimental measurements. On 15 measured patterns from solid-state synthesis, the evolved package improves average profile agreement and transfers an analogue-substitution procedure that recovers a phase whose structure is absent from the supplied reference library. These results demonstrate how learning from verifiable synthetic experience can improve agentic characterization of experimental samples whose structures are not known in advance.
comment: NeurIPS 2026 Workshop AI4Mat, spotlight (earlier version)

AI.tldr: 研究通过可验证搜索与合成经验学习，提升大语言模型智能体从粉末X射线衍射数据解析晶体结构的能力。
AI.motivation: 从粉末X射线衍射数据自主确定晶体结构，仍是自驱动材料实验室的关键瓶颈。
AI.method: 构建含200个模拟单相问题的基准，以正向模拟验证搜索，并通过反思式演化生成指导与工具。
AI.result: 智能体适应使所选结构恢复率从27%升至69%，演化工具包还改善15组实测谱的平均拟合并恢复库外物相。
AI.conclusion: 可验证的合成经验能够改善智能体对结构预先未知的实验样品的表征。

title: Uncertainty-Aware Continual Learning for 2D XRD Interpretation Using Simulated and Experimental Data
summary: Autonomous experimentation systems require characterization models that can interpret heterogeneous measurements and maintain predictive performance as data accumulate. Developing such models involves addressing domain mismatch between data sources, overconfident predictions on unfamiliar inputs, and catastrophic forgetting during sequential updates. In this work, we present a proof-of-concept framework for uncertainty-aware continual interpretation of two-dimensional X-ray diffraction (XRD) data. The framework integrates established components: maximum mean discrepancy-based domain adaptation to reduce simulation-to-experiment discrepancies, a convolutional neural network with a spectral-normalized neural Gaussian process (CNN--SNGP) for predictive uncertainty estimation, and replay with knowledge distillation for sequential model updating. We evaluate the framework using simulated and previously-collected experimental data for crystal structure classification of single-phase body-centered cubic, face-centered cubic, and hexagonal close-packed patterns. Data are organized into predefined sequential blocks to assess adaptation and retention of previously learned knowledge. Within this setting, the results show accurate classification across simulated and experimental data, improved alignment between the two domains, and reduced forgetting compared with naïve fine-tuning. Predictive uncertainty is also evaluated on unfamiliar and noisy inputs. The contribution is the integration and evaluation of these capabilities for sequential XRD interpretation. The framework provides a basis for future integration into autonomous experimentation systems, with experimental planning, instrument control, and closed-loop deployment remaining areas for future development.

AI.tldr: 研究集成域适应、不确定性估计与持续学习，实现面向模拟和实验二维X射线衍射数据的序贯结构分类。
AI.motivation: 自主实验的表征模型需要应对数据源差异、陌生输入上的过度自信及连续更新中的灾难性遗忘。
AI.method: 结合最大均值差异域适应、带谱归一化神经高斯过程的卷积网络，以及回放和知识蒸馏。
AI.result: 在三类单相结构的序贯数据块中，框架分类准确、域间对齐改善，且遗忘少于朴素微调。
AI.conclusion: 该概念验证为自主实验中的持续衍射解释提供基础，但规划、仪器控制及闭环部署仍待开发。

title: Talk to Act: A Synthetic Multi-Turn Dialogue Benchmark for Human Intent Extraction and Action Planning in Robotics
summary: Multi-turn conversational human-robot interaction (HRI) continues to be a challenging problem in robotics, as many existing systems rely on rigid, command-driven interfaces that can be unintuitive for users. Recent advances in Large Language Models (LLMs) provide a promising direction, given their ability to process natural language, generate structured outputs, and support tool-based reasoning, all of which are relevant for interpreting user intent in robotic settings. However, progress in this area is constrained by the limited availability of datasets and benchmarks that capture the nuances of real-world human communication, such as multi-turn dialogue, ambiguity, and context-dependent requests. In this work, we present a synthetically generated multi-turn dialogue dataset for HRI, annotated with action intents, object references, and task plans across a range of scenarios and user personas. Our primary focus is on evaluating the capability of small, open-weight language models for robotic tasks, particularly in settings where local deployment and efficiency are important. To this end, we frame intent extraction as a tool-calling problem where each predicted action corresponds to a structured function call with arguments grounded in the dialogue and benchmark models ranging from 270M to 8B parameters on their ability to perform intent extraction and action planning without task-specific fine-tuning. Our results show that these models can achieve reasonable performance on the task even at relatively small scales and without any task-specific fine-tuning. This suggests that compact, locally deployable models already provide a useful baseline for conversational robotic systems. We expect that task-specific fine-tuning and more realistic training data will enhance performance further and make such models increasingly suitable for real-world robotic applications.
comment: 6 pages, 4 figures. This is an extended version of our paper accepted at the ICRA 2026 Workshop on Multimodal Embodied Interaction in Robots (MEI-2026), Vienna, Austria

AI.tldr: 研究提出合成多轮人机对话基准，评估小型开放权重语言模型提取机器人操作意图与规划动作的能力。
AI.motivation: 现有人机交互接口较僵化，且缺少涵盖多轮对话、歧义及上下文依赖请求的数据集与基准。
AI.method: 生成标注动作意图、对象引用和任务计划的对话，将意图提取转为工具调用并评估2.7亿至80亿参数模型。
AI.result: 较小模型在未经任务专门微调的情况下，也能在意图提取与动作规划任务中取得合理表现。
AI.conclusion: 紧凑且可本地部署的模型已可作为对话式机器人基线，专门微调和更真实数据有望进一步提升表现。

title: Sub-Synchronous Control Interaction Risk of Large Data Center Loads: A Frequency-Scan Assessment with Cross-Model Validation
summary: Data centers are now one of the fastest-growing loads on the bulk power system, and most of their demand reaches the grid through power converters inside uninterruptible power supplies (UPS). Whether these loads can take part in sub-synchronous control interaction (SSCI), as wind and HVDC converters do, has not been studied extensively. We examine this question with impedance-based frequency scans at the point of common coupling (PCC). Using a detailed proprietary model (INS-ISU), we scan the motor, variable-frequency-drive (VFD), lighting, and UPS-fed information-technology (IT) branches of a representative facility separately. Only the UPS in double-conversion mode shows negative resistance; it covers the whole sub-synchronous band and continues up to about 170 Hz. The other branches, and the UPS in bypass mode, stay passive. We then repeat the scans on three public models from PNNL, TAMU, and NLR. None of them shows negative resistance in bypass mode, while three of the four models do in double-conversion mode. Lowering the load from rated to light load makes the negative resistance deeper, as expected for a constant-power load, so a lightly loaded facility in double-conversion mode is the worst case. Raising the UPS DC-link capacitance pushes the negative resistance into a narrow band around the fundamental. These findings give a basis for screening data centers for SSCI during interconnection studies.
comment: 13 pages, 16 figures. Submitted for IEEE publications

AI.tldr: 跨模型频率扫描表明，数据中心双变换模式UPS可能呈现负电阻，需关注其次同步控制相互作用风险。
AI.motivation: 数据中心负荷快速增长，但其通过UPS接入电网后参与次同步控制相互作用的可能性尚缺充分研究。
AI.method: 在公共耦合点对设施各负荷支路进行阻抗频率扫描，并用三个公开模型交叉验证及分析运行参数。
AI.result: 四个模型中三个在双变换模式呈负电阻，旁路均未出现，且轻载加深负电阻、增大直流电容使其频带收窄。
AI.conclusion: UPS运行模式、负荷水平与直流侧电容可为并网研究筛查数据中心次同步控制相互作用风险提供依据。

title: A Synthetic Benchmark for Target-Centric Causal Discovery in Industrial Processes
summary: Causal discovery promises to find which recorded variables drive a process target such as product quality, yield or energy use. Process data with known causes are rare, and in existing benchmarks the difficulty of identifying the causes of a target is either fixed by the recorded data or set for the whole graph. We present a synthetic benchmark for target-centric causal discovery in industrial processes. Its generator is a two-level structural causal model inspired by batch production, assembled from components that each model one phenomenon of process data, such as a control loop or a delayed effect. The graph is built around the target: without sensor error, every non-cause can be distinguished from the direct causes by conditioning on them or by time order. Each component is set independently, so the difficulty can be varied one condition at a time. We evaluate eight methods, from association measures to effect estimation, with an error analysis by the role of the selected candidate; all degrade as the difficulties combine, each in a way consistent with its assumptions.

AI.tldr: 研究提出面向工业过程目标变量的合成因果发现基准，可独立调节不同识别难度因素。
AI.motivation: 具有已知因果关系的过程数据稀缺，既有基准难以独立控制目标变量原因识别的各项难度。
AI.method: 以批量生产启发的两层结构因果模型组合控制回路、延迟效应等组件，围绕目标建图并评估八种方法。
AI.result: 随着困难因素叠加，八种方法的表现均下降，其退化方式与各自假设一致。
AI.conclusion: 该基准支持逐项控制难度，并按候选变量角色分析目标因果识别方法的错误。

title: Generative Design with Real-time Physics Explainability: Towards Product Definition in the Age of AI
summary: In this article, we explore opportunities from using generative AI in mechanical engineering. On the one hand, generative methods based on invertible neural networks have been recently proposed for the solution of inverse design problems, allowing to infer design parameters from performance labels. On the other hand, generative AI models have shown that they can act as real time capable surrogates for physics based simulations. Here we suggest that these two streams should be combined in a unified framework, where INN are used to control the design process from the customer requirements perspective and the generative simulation of the systems physics adds a layer of explainability, why the proposed design fulfils the requirements. As generative design is prone to hallucinations, we propose uncertainty quantification to fend off physically infeasible requests. Finally, validation with classical tools is a requirement for generative design process. To demonstrate the capabilities of our novel generative design paradigm, we develop two interactive environments, one for airfoil design based on simulator data and one for the combustor design space exploration based on measured data.

AI.tldr: 研究提出融合逆向设计与实时物理代理的生成式设计框架，以客户需求驱动设计并提供物理解释。
AI.motivation: 生成式设计需要连接性能需求与设计参数，同时解释方案并防范物理不可行的生成结果。
AI.method: 结合可逆神经网络与生成式物理模拟，提出不确定性量化和传统工具验证，并开发翼型与燃烧室交互环境。
AI.result: 摘要未提供具体结果。
AI.conclusion: 生成式逆向设计与物理代理具有协同潜力，但仍需不确定性量化与传统验证保障物理可行性。

title: Contrastive local learning in large nonlinear analog circuits
summary: Machine learning in physical hardware promises to reduce training cost by colocating computation, memory and adaptation within device physics. Contrastive local learning networks (CLLNs) offer a compelling route: an electrical circuit relaxes to equilibrium in free and weakly clamped states, and each adaptive element updates from local voltage contrasts rather than backpropagated error signals. Yet whether nonlinear transistor implementations can scale beyond proof-of-concept circuits, and what design principles control that scaling, have remained unknown. Here we show that nonlinear analog circuits trained by contrastive local rules can learn larger machine-learning tasks and remain robust under hardware nonidealities. Using device-level circuit simulations, we systematically explore initialization, operating regime, loss-dependent clamping and training parameters, and scale CLLNs beyond ten thousand adaptive edges. The same local rule trains classifiers that reach the accuracy regime of conventional digital methods on Ionosphere and handwritten-digit benchmarks, and a network that autoregressively generates language over a 122-token vocabulary. These results establish the feasibility of local learning in large nonlinear analog circuits.
comment: 19 pages (13 main, 6 supplementary) and 11 figures (5 main, 6 supplementary)

AI.tldr: 器件级仿真表明，采用对比局部学习规则的非线性模拟电路可扩展至万条以上自适应边并执行多类任务。
AI.motivation: 物理硬件学习有望降低训练成本，但非线性晶体管局部学习电路的扩展能力与设计原则尚不明确。
AI.method: 通过器件级电路仿真，系统考察初始化、工作区间、随损失变化的钳位及训练参数，并扩展网络规模。

title: Benchmarks Don't Talk Back: Learning Through Self-Disagreement
summary: A benchmark usually measures a language model alone with a question, and deployment rarely looks like that: answers get contested, and models give up correct ones under counter-reasoning that is itself wrong. We show that what fails there is not a shortfall of accuracy but a capability in its own right -- knowing when to hold a position and when to yield to a better one -- which we call dialectical competence. It stands on first-answer accuracy without following from it: a model can be made materially better at answering and no better at this, and training for accuracy alone can drift against it. Nor can it be bought at inference, by self-reflection or by sampling more. Taking a cue from the dialectical tradition in philosophy, in which productive opposition arises within a position rather than being imposed on it from outside, we hypothesize that this capability can be trained from opposition the model supplies itself. It states a position, generates the strongest case against that position -- its antithesis -- rules on whether the case stands, and is trained on that ruling, with no second model at training or at deployment. We call this learning through Self-Disagreement: reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards throughout, where the same check that scores an answer against its reference scores the ruling too, so no reward model, no preference data and no human annotation enter anywhere. The capability is trained rather than elicited: weak in the base model, it arrives with the reward, is not paid for out of first-answer accuracy, and holds against challengers the model never trained against, including ones stronger than itself. The opposition a model needs in order to improve, it turns out, need not come from outside it.
comment: 34 pages, 5 figures, 15 tables

AI.tldr: 研究通过模型自生成反驳与可验证奖励强化学习，训练其判断何时坚持答案、何时接受更好论证的辩证能力。
AI.motivation: 语言模型面对错误反驳会放弃正确答案，而初答准确率提升、自我反思或增加采样并不保证改善这一能力。
AI.method: 让同一模型提出立场、生成最强反论并裁决，以参考答案验证回答和裁决，通过强化学习训练且无需第二模型。
AI.result: 训练提升辩证能力且不牺牲初答准确率，并能应对未参与训练、甚至比自身更强的挑战者。

title: AI-Voyager: A Public-Interest System for Human-AI Civic Reasoning to Contest and Shape the Rules That Govern AI
summary: Governments are writing rules for artificial intelligence that decide what counts as an automated decision or a harm, often before the people they affect have a chance to question them. We introduce AI-Voyager, a public-interest system for human-AI civic reasoning, in which people and AI work together to understand, contest and shape the rules that govern AI. A resident can find their city's rules on AI in hiring or upload their country's AI strategy, read it as an affected worker would, open the passage behind any answer, and draft a revision. Its architecture turns 3,653 governance documents from city, state, federal and national governments into passages that keep their page and edition, and retrieves evidence through bounded agentic search that verifies each statement. On 360 new questions that require finding the relevant documents, it reached 83.0% macro recall, against 80.5% for the strongest baseline, 73.7% without iterative search and 99.1% on a benchmark with fixed documents. In a study with 24 participants new to two AI bills, most proposed changes asked how provisions would apply. Participants chose lenses for the kind of explanation they wanted, and citations signaled grounding but rarely led them to check the source. By binding AI assistance to the exact text of public documents, this work introduces a grammar of operations and a design space that inform how such systems are designed and evaluated, and how people take part in governing AI.

AI.tldr: AI-Voyager将公共治理文件与可溯源AI问答结合，支持公众理解、质疑和修改AI规则。
AI.motivation: AI治理规则往往在受影响公众有机会质疑之前制定，需要工具支持公众参与。
AI.method: 将3653份治理文件切分为保留页码和版本的片段，以有界智能体迭代搜索检索证据并核验陈述。
AI.result: 在360个需查找文档的问题上，宏平均召回率为83.0%，高于最强基线的80.5%。
AI.conclusion: 将AI辅助绑定到公共文件原文，可为公民参与AI治理提供操作框架与系统设计依据。

title: Performance-Portable Exact Gaussian Process Regression in Python via SYCL and oneMath
summary: Modern multi-vendor GPU environments force a choice between portable code and native performance. GPRat is an open-source Python library for exact Gaussian process regression built on the HPX asynchronous many-task runtime, tiled algorithms, and CPU/CUDA BLAS backends. We contribute a UXL Foundation oneMath backend with a hybrid HPX/SYCL design, extending GPRat to AMD and Intel GPUs. The new SYCL backend comes within 3% of native CUDA on an NVIDIA A30 at the largest problem size and outperforms the GPflow and GPyTorch libraries by up to 1.75x and 2.17x on the A30 and up to 1.79x and 4.62x on an AMD Instinct MI210. On an Intel Arc B580, a consumer-class card with FP64 throughput below our CPUs, the unmodified SYCL backend trails GPRat's CPU backend. Overall, oneMath's dispatch to vendor-native BLAS lets a single SYCL codebase match CUDA on NVIDIA and outperform established Python GP frameworks on AMD, without vendor-specific code.
comment: 12 pages, 6 figures, 2 tables. Accepted at the WACCPD 2026 workshop (SC26 Workshops), November 15-20, 2026, Chicago, Illinois, USA

AI.tldr: GPRat通过混合HPX/SYCL与oneMath后端，实现跨厂商GPU的高性能精确高斯过程回归。
AI.motivation: 多厂商GPU环境下，代码可移植性与原生性能往往难以兼得。
AI.method: 为基于异步多任务运行时和分块算法的GPRat加入oneMath后端，扩展至AMD与Intel GPU。
AI.result: 最大规模下SYCL与A30原生CUDA性能差距不足3%，但在B580上落后于CPU后端。
AI.conclusion: oneMath调用厂商原生BLAS，可让单一SYCL代码库兼顾跨厂商移植与高性能。

title: Grounding Object-to-Object Hazard Reasoning into 3D Risk Fields for Task-Conditioned Safety
summary: Safety in robotics does not solely depend on geometric constraints, but also on semantics: the given task, environment properties, and interactions between objects in the scene. We present a framework based on vision-language models (VLMs) to infer task- and scene-dependent safety constraints for robot manipulation. We provide the VLM a structured safety tool based on an RGB-D observation and a natural-language task instruction that first decides whether the task should be rejected since its execution may result in a non-recoverable hazardous outcome. Otherwise, it identifies preventable object-pair hazards and specifies the spatial relations that must be avoided. Open-vocabulary segmentation and depth information are then used to ground the detected objects in 3D and construct continuous risk fields that represent the corresponding hazardous regions. These fields are integrated with an obstacle avoidance module that corrects nominal robot motions during execution while accounting for the risk field. We evaluate the framework on preventable hazards, tasks requiring rejection, and safe variants in simulation and the real-world. Project website: this https URL

AI.tldr: 该框架将视觉语言模型推断的物体间危险转为三维风险场，用于任务相关的机器人操作安全。
AI.motivation: 机器人安全不仅取决于几何约束，还取决于任务语义、环境属性和物体交互。
AI.method: 结合RGB-D与任务指令判断是否拒绝任务，并将可预防危险转为风险场以修正机器人运动。
AI.result: 摘要未提供具体结果。
AI.conclusion: 该框架提供了从语义危险推理到三维运动约束的连接方式，并在仿真与真实环境中开展评估。

title: Natural Swing-Up of an Underpowered Double Pendulum
summary: Robots with weak motors must ride their natural dynamics rather than fight them. We swing up a direct-drive planar two-link robot, whose motors deliver only about 6\,\% of its shoulder gravity torque, along its nonlinear normal modes, two-dimensional invariant manifolds consisting of periodic orbits. On a non-strict mode, injecting energy necessarily moves the state off the manifold, so pumping and stabilization compete for the same bounded torque. We split the input torque into a power-neutral steering component and a scalar pumping input, the only component that changes the energy. The allocation then becomes a linear program in two variables: maximize pumping subject to the torque limits and one control-Lyapunov constraint. The constraint uses the model-based rate of the error, so no stabilizing feedback gain is needed. Experiments in hardware show swing-ups along both modes and compare the allocation with summing-and-clipping and with prioritized stabilization.

AI.tldr: 通过分离能量注入与功率中性的转向控制，使弱驱动双摆沿非线性模态完成起摆。
AI.motivation: 弱电机机器人需借助自然动力学，而有限扭矩下能量注入与模态稳定控制相互竞争。
AI.method: 将扭矩分为转向与泵能分量，以含扭矩限制和控制李雅普诺夫约束的二维线性规划最大化泵能。
AI.result: 硬件实验实现沿两种模态起摆，并与求和截断及优先稳定策略进行比较。
AI.conclusion: 利用自然模态和受约束扭矩分配，可使电机扭矩仅约为肩部重力矩6%的机器人起摆。

title: Beyond a Single Sign: BiTE for Branch-Preserving Binary Threshold Expansion
summary: Binary neural networks (BNNs) reduce model storage and replace many arithmetic operations with efficient bitwise computations, but the single-sign activation limits their representational capacity. Each preactivation direction is compared with one threshold and reduced to one of two values, discarding variation within each sign region. We propose \textbf{BiTE} (Branch-Preserving Binary Threshold Expansion), which evaluates each feature direction against $K$ ordered thresholds and retains the resulting binary responses as separate inputs to the following learned operator. BiTE can distinguish up to $K+1$ ordered activation states while allowing the following operator to learn a separate transformation for each threshold response. It also enables a controllable trade-off between the number of independently constructed feature directions and the number of ordered responses extracted from each direction. On BinaryViT, BiTE improves mean final-epoch Top-1 accuracy from $74.60\pm0.30\%$ to $75.83\pm0.15\%$ on CIFAR-10 and from $42.80\pm0.46\%$ to $44.07\pm0.32\%$ on CIFAR-100, with nearly unchanged trainable parameter counts. A matched uniform-collapse control reaches $75.33\pm0.15\%$ on CIFAR-10, supporting the value of retaining the threshold responses separately relative to the evaluated scalar collapse. Binary VGG-16 experiments further show a favorable observed parameter--accuracy trade-off, including a configuration that achieves $0.64$ percentage points higher mean accuracy with $21.8\%$ fewer parameters than conventional width scaling. Overall, these results support branch-preserving threshold expansion as an effective way to improve binary representations and the observed parameter--accuracy trade-off.
comment: 8 pages, 5 figures

AI.tldr: BiTE保留多个有序阈值的独立二值响应，在参数量近乎不变时提升二值网络精度。
AI.motivation: 单符号激活将每个特征方向压缩为两值，丢失符号区域内部变化并限制表达能力。
AI.method: 每个特征方向使用K个有序阈值，将二值响应作为独立分支交给后续可学习算子。
AI.result: BinaryViT在CIFAR-10和CIFAR-100上的平均准确率分别由74.60%和42.80%升至75.83%和44.07%。
AI.conclusion: 保留阈值响应分支有助于增强二值表示，并改善实验中观察到的参数量与精度权衡。

title: Fair and Efficient Distributed EV Charging Coordination Using Threshold Cryptography and Machine Learning
summary: Distributed coordination of electric vehicle (EV) charging with the alternating direction method of multipliers (ADMM) keeps EV constraints private but assumes that every participant follows the algorithm. This assumption fails in practice, where a biased operator or a man-in-the-middle (MITM) attacker can send inconsistent signals to different EVs, and compromised EVs can deviate from their prescribed updates. We first prove that attacks by such arbitrarily malicious, i.e., Byzantine, participants do not prevent convergence and therefore remain undetected, and derive the most damaging attack in closed form. We then propose a framework that combines a threshold-signed broadcast with upload recomputation, which detects every deviation without false alarms at linear instead of quadratic communication cost. To keep the optimization running, each affected EV recovers locally with a certified, fleet-aware machine learning price forecast, and we prove that the optimization remains convergent with a recovery cost bounded by the shape of the forecast error. Simulation results with real-world load, price, and charging data show that a biased operator raises the annual cost of disadvantaged EVs by 132.7% and lowers that of advantaged EVs by 49.3% without changing the aggregate load, whereas the defense limits all cost changes to 2.6%. An external MITM attacker raises the cost of its victims by 57.6%, the peak load by 5.8%, and the grid cost by 15.8%, whereas the defense keeps them within 1.1%, 0.2%, and 0.3% of benign operation. With up to 70% of the EVs attacked, the recovery converges in at least 97.8% of the runs.
comment: 16 pages

AI.tldr: 结合门限签名、更新重算与机器学习预测，防御分布式电动车充电中的恶意参与者。
AI.motivation: ADMM充电协调即使受到拜占庭攻击仍可能收敛，使不公平操控难以通过收敛性发现。
AI.method: 以门限签名广播和上传重算检测偏离，再用具认证保障的车队感知价格预测实现本地恢复。
AI.result: 防御将偏置运营商造成的各车辆成本变化限制在2.6%内，70%车辆受攻击时恢复收敛率仍至少97.8%。
AI.conclusion: 该框架以线性通信开销实现无误报的偏离检测，并为恢复收敛性与成本提供理论保障。

title: When Does Less Information Pay? An Exact Finite Atlas of Representation, Payoff, and Cost
summary: A representation that retains one bit about a four-state world can solve a task perfectly, while another that retains 1.5 bits on average reaches only 75% accuracy. The difference lies in which distinctions each representation preserves. We examine this relationship in a uniform four-state world by enumerating all admissible representations and binary action rules. Constructions are compared both by replacing one component while holding the others fixed and by choosing the best action rule separately for each module. We consider three tasks, their mixtures, and four separate hypothetical cost tariffs. In some comparisons, the representation retaining less world information has the higher payoff; in others, the more informative representation does. There are also pairs with different information amounts but equal payoff--that is, equal task accuracy. If a representation preserves all existing distinctions and adds new ones, its best zero-cost payoff cannot decrease. Lower-information advantages therefore depend on which distinctions are retained. Equal counts of opposing advantages under representation replacement follow from coding symmetry. In broader comparisons, the shares depend on how repeated realizations are counted. A different task set or resource price can change which member of a fixed pair performs better. These results are exact, complete censuses of the specified finite sets of constructions and comparisons. The atlas provides a reproducible worked model for examining how action constraints, counting rules, and cost assumptions affect comparisons. It illustrates established distinctions between information quantity and decision value rather than proposing a new general law of their relation. $I(W;R)$ measures retained world information, and payoff measures task accuracy.
comment: 40 pages, 5 figures; supplementary material included. Code, data and Russian translation: this https URL

AI.tldr: 四状态世界的精确枚举表明，保留信息更少不必然降低任务收益，关键在于保留哪些区分。
AI.motivation: 信息量不能直接代表决策价值，需要明确任务、行动约束、计数规则与成本的影响。
AI.method: 穷举均匀四状态世界的允许表示和二元行动规则，比较三类任务、任务混合及四种假设成本。
AI.result: 低信息表示可能收益更高、更低或相同；保留原有区分并增加新区分时，最优零成本收益不会下降。
AI.conclusion: 该有限模型展示信息数量与决策价值的既有区别，而非提出二者关系的新普遍定律。

title: Rethinking Visual Reasoning in Text-to-Image Reward Modeling
summary: Reward models are a core component of modern text-to-image systems, serving as the objective for inference-time selection and RL-based post-training. A key prerequisite is visual understanding: to judge prompt adherence and ground aesthetic preferences, a reward model must bind attributes, resolve relations, and count reliably. We find that widely-used reward models perform poorly on targeted visual reasoning evaluations. Even when starting from strong vision-language backbones, preference fine-tuning erodes these capabilities, and continual-learning baselines fail to mitigate a steep tradeoff between visual reasoning and preference accuracy. We propose a data-centric intervention that injects visual reasoning supervision into preference learning by flipping the pairing axis. To complement conventional human preference data (paired images under a shared prompt), we convert existing visual reasoning datasets into preference pairs that share the same image but differ in prompt, and train on the mixture. This yields a Pareto improvement in both visual understanding and preference prediction. Across inference-time best-of-n selection and RL post-training, the resulting reward model improves text-to-image generation on challenging compositional prompts (GenEval) by an average of 4.0% and 5.5% respectively, outperforming HPSv3 which was trained on 6x more preference pairs.

AI.tldr: 将同图不同提示的视觉推理偏好对加入训练，可同时改善文生图奖励模型的推理与偏好预测。
AI.motivation: 常用奖励模型视觉推理薄弱，偏好微调还会削弱其属性绑定、关系判断和计数能力。
AI.method: 将现有视觉推理数据转为共享图像但提示不同的偏好对，与传统同提示图像偏好数据混合训练。
AI.result: 在推理时择优和强化学习后训练中，GenEval表现分别平均提升4.0%和5.5%，优于HPSv3。
AI.conclusion: 通过改变偏好配对轴注入视觉推理监督，可缓解推理与偏好精度的冲突并改善组合提示生成。

title: Where to Predict in Retinal OCT? Anatomy-Guided Target Selection for I-JEPA
summary: Self-supervised learning aims to learn meaningful representations from unlabeled data, potentially allowing models to capture subtle anatomical variations across patients and reduce the amount of labeled data needed. Image-based Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (I-JEPA) learns by predicting target-region representations from visible context rather than reconstructing pixels. However, its uniform target placement does not account for the anatomical structure of retinal OCT, where retinal tissue occupies only part of each B-scan. We investigate anatomy-guided target selection using image intensity and predicted retinal segmentation while retaining the I-JEPA architecture and latent prediction objective. We compare anatomy-guided rectangular targets, anatomy-shaped targets and coverage-constrained placement with uniform masking, and evaluate the learned representations using linear probing for glaucoma classification on FairVision. We found that rectangular targets guided by image intensity achieved the highest linear-probe AUC in our comparisons. We show that anatomically meaningful target selection is promising for retinal OCT representation learning, while greater anatomical specificity did not consistently improve performance.
comment: 18 pages. Accepted as a poster at the GenAI for Health Workshop at NeurIPS 2026 (non-archival)

AI.tldr: 解剖引导的目标区域选择可改善视网膜OCT的I-JEPA表征，但更精细的解剖约束未必更好。
AI.motivation: I-JEPA均匀放置预测目标，未考虑视网膜组织仅占OCT切片一部分的解剖特点。
AI.method: 保留I-JEPA架构与潜在预测目标，比较强度及分割引导的目标选择，并在FairVision上进行青光眼线性探测。
AI.result: 图像强度引导的矩形目标取得比较中最高的线性探测AUC，更高解剖特异性未持续改善性能。
AI.conclusion: 具有解剖意义的目标选择有望改善视网膜OCT表征学习，但精细解剖约束的收益并不稳定。

title: Tractable Importance Sampling for Monte Carlo Privacy Accounting
summary: Evaluating tight Differential Privacy (DP) parameters for DP matrix factorization with privacy amplification by sampling requires analyzing high-dimensional, correlated Gaussian mixtures. Because integrating these mixture distributions to find the exact privacy failure probability ($\delta$) is analytically intractable, these mechanisms are typically analyzed using Monte Carlo accounting. However, standard sampling suffers from prohibitive variance when estimating small $\delta$ associated with strict privacy guarantees, which in turn requires a large sample complexity, making Monte Carlo accounting inefficient. We demonstrate that Monte Carlo accounting can be made much more efficient via importance sampling. We give a shifted importance sampling proposal distribution parameterized by a stretch factor $\alpha > 1$. We prove a closed-form bound $B(\alpha) < 1$ on the support of the importance-weighted estimator that holds identically for both directions of the hockey-stick divergence, show that $B$ is log-convex so that the optimal $\alpha$ is a one-dimensional root-finding problem, and show that the resulting estimator seamlessly plugs into the KL-Hoeffding verification protocol used by past work, with a sample complexity reduced by exactly a factor of $1/B(\alpha^*)$.

AI.tldr: 移位重要性采样可降低严格差分隐私参数估计的方差，并以可证明的比例减少采样需求。
AI.motivation: 含采样放大的差分隐私矩阵分解涉及高维相关高斯混合，小失效概率使常规蒙特卡洛核算成本过高。
AI.method: 构造由伸缩因子α参数化的移位提议分布，推导估计量上界B(α)，并接入KL-Hoeffding验证协议。
AI.result: 证明两方向曲棍球杆散度均满足B(α)<1，且其对数凸性支持一维寻根，样本需求降至原来的B(α*)倍。
AI.conclusion: 重要性采样可在保留既有验证协议的同时，为蒙特卡洛隐私核算提供可证明的效率提升。

title: X-Nav Technical Report: Real-World Long-Horizon Indoor-to-Outdoor Navigation on a Humanoid Robot
summary: Long-horizon navigation from indoors to outdoors remains an open problem for humanoid robots: one instruction covers rooms, doors and roads, and the camera moves with the gait. Worken, AGIBOT's measure of productive robot work, depends on robots that reach their workplaces autonomously. We present X-Nav, to our knowledge the first system to take a bipedal humanoid through a language-instructed long-horizon mission from indoors to outdoors. X-Nav covers a pipeline from data to deployment. Its data engine collects navigation data in open-source scenes, in digital twins of deployment sites and on real robots. Its navigation model, MELIOR, takes only RGB images from the robot's built-in camera and comes in two versions: MELIOR-A predicts actions, and MELIOR-N predicts a navigation goal. Its agentic workflow, X-Navarch, turns a brief human instruction into sub-tasks and deploys MELIOR on the robot with explicit target navigation and obstacle avoidance. On the Lingxi X2, X-Nav completes a mission of about a hundred metres from an office lobby to a store in a neighbouring building; LiDAR and odometry are used for target approach and low-level control. The mission is completed with both versions of MELIOR: the robot follows a change of destination and walks through a door from the lobby to the road, and with X-Navarch it also passes static and dynamic obstacles on the route. During deployment, MELIOR is adapted with data collected in a digital twin of the site; the adaptation raises its closed-loop success rate in the twin, and the adapted model is then deployed on the robot at the real site. In addition, MELIOR achieves competitive results on the R2R-CE and RxR-CE benchmarks.

AI.tldr: X-Nav使双足人形机器人依照语言指令完成从室内到室外的约百米长程导航。
AI.motivation: 跨房间、门和道路的长程导航，以及步态造成的相机运动，仍阻碍人形机器人自主到达工作地点。
AI.method: 结合多源数据引擎、仅接收RGB图像的MELIOR导航模型和任务分解工作流，并以激光雷达及里程计辅助底层控制。
AI.result: 两版MELIOR均完成实地约百米任务，工作流支持静动态避障，模型在R2R-CE和RxR-CE上表现具有竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 贯通数据、数字孪生适配与机器人部署的系统展示了语言驱动室内外长程导航的可行性。

title: LightTAR: Light and Fast Target-Aware Representations for Multimodal Tabular Learning
summary: Multimodal tabular learning involves classification and regression on tables combining structured numerical and categorical features with unstructured text and images. These unstructured fields are commonly represented by pretrained encoder embeddings reduced with principal component analysis (PCA). This reduction prioritizes input variance but may overlook information relevant to predicting the target. We introduce LightTAR, a simple, inexpensive method that adapts dimensionality reduction to the prediction task. LightTAR augments the standard PCA representation with a few target-aware features extracted jointly from the final and an intermediate encoder layer using regularized partial least squares (PLS). We evaluate LightTAR with 21 tabular models, including tree ensembles, neural networks, and tabular foundation models. LightTAR improves average predictive performance for all models and, averaged across models, improves prediction on almost every MulTaBench dataset. These gains come with a small increase in total runtime relative to PCA representations. LightTAR integrates directly into existing encoding pipelines, improving tabular learners' predictive performance without modifying the encoder or the learner.
comment: 21 pages, 3 figures. Code: this https URL

AI.tldr: LightTAR以少量目标感知特征增强PCA表征，在较小运行开销下改善多模态表格预测。
AI.motivation: 文本和图像嵌入的PCA降维侧重输入方差，可能丢失与预测目标相关的信息。
AI.method: 通过正则化偏最小二乘，从编码器末层和中间层联合提取少量目标感知特征，补充标准PCA表征。
AI.result: 在21种表格模型上均提升平均预测性能，跨模型平均后改善几乎所有MulTaBench数据集，运行时间仅小幅增加。
AI.conclusion: 无需修改编码器或学习器，LightTAR即可直接接入现有编码流程以提升预测性能。

title: Offline KL-Regularized Reinforcement Learning with Stochastic Transitions
summary: KL-regularized reinforcement learning is the objective behind RL fine-tuning of language models, and its data are often collected by the reference policy itself. However, beyond bandits and deterministic transitions, little is known about how much offline data it needs. In this work, we study finite discounted Markov decision processes with unknown stochastic transitions, $K$ state-action pairs and effective horizon $H$. For data that cover the regularized optimum with concentrability $C\geq 4$, every estimator needs $\Omega(KCH^3/(\epsilon\max\{\epsilon,\beta\}))$ samples on some instances when $\epsilon$ is small, where $\beta$ is the temperature. Under a fixed design, pessimistic soft value iteration with a variance-aware penalty attains this rate with high probability, up to logarithmic factors, when $\beta\geq 1.4H$. When the data come from the reference policy itself, we show that it covers the optimum up to a power law whose exponent grows as $H/\beta$; in the same temperature range, this power law alone gives the estimator a sample complexity polynomial in $1/\epsilon$, with no coverage assumption. For $\beta\geq H$ the power can also increase the sample size needed by a factor polynomial in $1/\epsilon$. Finally, the plug-in estimator, which is minimax optimal with a generative model, can fail on reference data at small temperatures when many actions are rarely seen, while the pessimistic estimator does not.

AI.tldr: 研究刻画随机转移下离线KL正则强化学习的样本复杂度，并揭示悲观估计相较代入估计的优势。
AI.motivation: 语言模型强化学习常用参考策略收集数据，但随机转移情形下离线KL正则学习的数据需求仍不清楚。
AI.method: 在有限折扣马尔可夫决策过程中建立样本下界，分析方差感知的悲观软价值迭代及参考策略的覆盖性质。
AI.result: 温度β≥1.4H时，悲观算法在固定设计下以对数因子内匹配下界；低温参考数据上代入估计可能失败。
AI.conclusion: 温度与参考策略覆盖性质共同决定离线学习难度，悲观估计可应对代入估计在罕见动作数据上的失效。

title: Choosing Quantized Code LLMs by File Size and Energy per Solved Task
summary: A developer running a code assistant on a laptop downloads one model file, and local inference moves the energy of every request onto that machine. A common rule says a larger model at lower precision tends to beat a smaller one at higher precision. We ran 24 GGUF files of Qwen2.5-Coder at four sizes on a fanless MacBook Air M2 and priced each in energy per solved task on 542 EvalPlus tasks. The result is a selection guide indexed by Ollama's listed file size, with an evidence label on each pick. At 1 and 2 GB it picks the q4_K_M files of the 1.5B and 3B models, both on the correctness and energy frontier under every accounting. At 3 GB as listed, the larger-model rule picks 7B-q2_K, the only measured 7B file that fits, and there it does not pay. That file brings no significant gain in solves over the 2 GB pick, 3B-q4_K_M, and the 90% CI limits any 3B-q4_K_M deficit to 2.4 points. Yet 7B-q2_K needs 2.03 times the energy per solved task on CPU, GPU and memory rails, or 1.66 to 1.81 times on whole-system power. On HumanEval+, five alternating session pairs give a ratio of 1.925 against 1.956 in the main grid. At 8 GB, 7B-q6_K buys a significant gain over the 2 GB pick at a higher energy price. From 1.5B up, q4_K_M trails the highest precision measured at its size by less than 3 points (90% CI). We release per-task results, power logs and the analysis script.
comment: 9 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables. Submitted to GREENS 2027 (11th International Workshop on Green and Sustainable Software, co-located with ICSE 2027). Reproducibility package: this https URL

AI.tldr: 本地代码模型选择不能只遵循大模型低精度规则，还应结合文件大小与每解题能耗。
AI.motivation: 笔记本本地推理需承担下载体积和运行能耗，而更大低精度模型是否更划算缺乏直接证据。
AI.method: 在无风扇MacBook Air M2上测试四种规模的24个Qwen2.5-Coder量化文件，评估542道EvalPlus题的正确率与能耗。
AI.result: 7B-q2_K较3B-q4_K_M解题数无显著提升，但芯片相关能耗达2.03倍；8GB档7B-q6_K以更高能耗换取显著增益。
AI.conclusion: 应按文件预算及每解题能耗选择量化模型，较大模型并不总比更小的高精度模型划算。

title: Neural Simulation-Based Inference for Computational Cognitive Models: A Tutorial
summary: Computational cognitive modeling is an increasingly essential methodology to elucidate the mechanisms underlying human and animal cognition. By fitting models to empirical data, researchers can perform parameter estimation, model comparison, and model-based neural analyses to assess competing theories, quantify individual differences, and investigate neural representations. Typically, fitting these models relies on likelihood-dependent methods (e.g., Maximum likelihood estimation or hierarchical Bayesian methods). However, for many reasonable cognitive models, computing the likelihood is computationally intractable, in which case these methods become inadequate. This substantially limits the range of theories that researchers can investigate. Simulation-based inference with neural networks (neural SBI) has emerged as a powerful toolkit to overcome this hurdle. By training deep neural networks on datasets generated through model simulations, neural SBI learns the relation between observable data and cognitive models. This approach enables all the applications of standard modeling while bypassing the likelihood computation, without constraints on empirical data size. Despite its successful adoption across diverse scientific fields, neural SBI remains underutilized in cognitive modeling, partly due to a lack of accessible, domain-tailored guidance. This tutorial addresses this gap by providing a clear workflow for applying neural SBI to cognitive models. We also provide practical use cases and recommendations for reducing the computational and simulation burden, facilitating efficient implementation in real-world research settings. By lowering the technical barriers to neural SBI, this tutorial aims to empower cognitive scientists to investigate richer theory spaces and ultimately propel scientific discovery.

AI.tldr: 本教程为认知模型提供神经模拟推断流程，以绕过难以计算的似然函数并降低应用门槛。
AI.motivation: 许多认知模型的似然难以计算，限制可检验的理论范围，而面向该领域的神经模拟推断指南仍不足。
AI.method: 介绍用模型模拟数据训练神经网络的推断流程，并提供实践案例及减少计算和模拟负担的建议。
AI.result: 摘要未提供具体结果。
AI.conclusion: 教程旨在帮助认知研究者应用无需显式似然计算的推断工具，探索更丰富的认知理论。
