title: More Agents, More Samples, or More Thinking? Untangling Coordination, Ensembling, and Test-Time Compute in Multi-Agent LLMs
summary: Evaluations of multi-agent language models often compare communicating architectures against a single greedy pass. This practice confounds coordination with sample multiplicity and inference compute. We synthesize nine primary empirical evaluations comprising 516 unique multi-agent configurations organized along a resource vector R with six dimensions and a baseline ladder with four categories. Against baselines with a single pass (Category A), multi-agent accuracy differences are negative overall and near zero when omitting the largest contributing study. When evaluated against baselines matched on sample count (Category B) or resource budget (Category C), multi-agent systems average -0.042 in accuracy, and multilevel random effects modeling on the log odds scale remains negative across sensitivity checks. Multi-agent accuracy equals or falls below the baseline in 74% of these comparable contrasts, and study means are nonpositive in almost all evaluated studies. Across studies reporting both baselines, moving from a greedy pass to a sampled baseline shifts accuracy differences by -0.038 on average. Because communication adds no information when agents share identical evidence, positive returns require partitioned evidence, external verification, or error diversity across models. We provide a reviewer checklist and accounting utilities.
comment: 43 pages, 11 figures, 13 tables. PACE Reviewer Checklist, evaluation utilities (pace CLI), and reproduction data at this https URL

AI.tldr: 综合九项评估发现，在匹配样本数或资源预算后，多智能体语言模型的平均准确率低于基线。
AI.motivation: 将通信式多智能体系统与单次贪心推理比较，会混淆协调收益、采样数量与推理算力的影响。
AI.method: 汇总九项实证评估的516种配置，按六维资源向量和四类基线整理，并开展多层随机效应及敏感性分析。
AI.result: 匹配样本数或资源预算后，准确率平均差为-0.042，74%的可比对照不优于基线，敏感性分析仍呈负效应。
AI.conclusion: 共享相同证据时通信本身不增加信息，正收益需要证据分工、外部验证或跨模型错误多样性。

title: Battery Energy Storage Sizing in PV Ramp-Rate Smoothing using Constraint-Aware Reinforcement Learning-Based Controller
summary: This paper presents a constraint-aware reinforcement learning (CARL) controller for battery energy storage system (BESS) sizing and photovoltaic (PV) ramp-rate smoothing. Rapid PV power fluctuations caused by cloud transitions can introduce operational and stability challenges in power systems. To mitigate these impacts, grid codes impose ramp-rate limits (RRL) on PV power injected to the grid. BESSs can support such grid codes by absorbing or supplying power during rapid variations. However, the extent to which BESSs can reduce PV-induced variability depends on (i) the BESS power and energy capacities; and (ii) the adopted controller. Thus, BESS sizing and controller design are coupled. Conventional moving-average control can increase battery usage due to filter-induced lag, while ramp-rate control is reactive and does not account for the long-term impact of actions on battery state of charge and future ramp events. Optimization-based methods can reduce BESS requirements by anticipating future PV variations, but their performance depends on accurate PV forecasts. To address these limitations, the CARL controller learns a causal state-feedback policy from historical PV data without requiring forecasts during deployment. Ramp-rate, converter-power, and state-of-charge constraints are incorporated into a causal feasibility interval that guarantees feasible actions by definition. A full-horizon input-convex neural network (ICNN)-based optimization is developed as a noncausal benchmark for the minimum achievable BESS requirements. Evaluation using three real-world PV datasets shows that, at a 10\%/min ramp-rate limit, CARL reduces peak BESS power by 8.7--10.4\% and energy capacity by 47.5--62.6\% relative to conventional ramp-rate control while maintaining the grid-codes compliance.

AI.tldr: 约束感知强化学习控制器在满足光伏爬坡率限制的同时降低储能功率与容量需求。
AI.motivation: 光伏波动要求储能平滑，但储能定容与控制策略耦合，传统方法存在滞后、短视或预测依赖。
AI.method: 从历史数据学习无需部署预测的因果策略，以可行区间约束动作，并构建非因果优化基准。
AI.result: 三组实测数据中，10%/分钟限制下峰值功率降低8.7%—10.4%，容量降低47.5%—62.6%，且满足并网规范。
AI.conclusion: 该控制器无需部署时预测即可保持约束合规，并较传统爬坡率控制显著减少储能需求。

title: LLM-Guided Cluster Lifecycle Management: Deciding When and How to Evolve Behavioral Clusters
summary: Behavioral clusters learned over user or item interactions drift as behavior evolves: some fragment into sub-behaviors, some converge, some disappear, and new patterns emerge. Two paradigms dominate the maintenance of evolving clusterings. Threshold triggers fire a pre-specified action when a hardcoded statistic crosses a cutoff; refit-and-track (MONIC-style) re-clusters every window and infers transitions from how the new clusters align with the previous window's. Both hardwire the decision into a threshold or a re-clustering rule. We study an alternative in which a large language model (LLM) makes the lifecycle decision in place. Given a threshold-free, whole-population view of the current cluster set (statistical health, labels, member texts, residual mass), the LLM decides per cluster whether and how to act (split, merge, retire, create, or no-action) without re-clustering. Because the useful signal channel depends on how informative the labels are, we fix a richness-conditioned policy in advance: statistics when label distinctiveness is low, fused statistics+semantics when it is high. On three public datasets spanning label richness (YooChoose 0.17, MOOC 0.50, News-Category 0.70), the policy-selected LLM mode obtains the highest F1 on all three, with far fewer interventions and stronger restraint than tuned threshold heuristics and a MONIC steelman (paired Wilcoxon p <= 0.003, bootstrap 95% CIs excluding zero). The gain is concentrated more in precision than recall. The useful modality shifts from statistics to semantics/fusion as richness rises. Semantics hurt on YooChoose, fusion is roughly neutral on MOOC, and the semantic channel is required on News. One base prompt template and one fixed policy serve all three datasets, whereas the tuned baseline collapses when moved between them. We treat this shift as a practitioner diagnostic observed on three datasets, not a validated law.
comment: 16 pages, 8 figures, 9 tables

AI.tldr: 大语言模型依据群体统计与语义信息管理行为簇生命周期，在三个数据集上提升决策质量。
AI.motivation: 行为簇随时间分裂、合并或消失，而阈值触发与逐窗重聚类将决策固化于预设规则。
AI.method: 让模型直接决定簇的拆分、合并、退役、新建或不操作，并按标签丰富度预先选择信息模态。
AI.result: 预设策略在三个公开数据集上均取得最高F1，干预更少，收益主要来自精确率提升。
AI.conclusion: 有效信息模态随标签丰富度变化，但这一趋势仅是三个数据集上的实践诊断，尚非验证规律。

title: TouchTwin: Scaling Human Touch Data via Real-to-Sim-to-Real
summary: Human demonstrations are becoming the main source of data for dexterous manipulation, and real-to-sim-to-real pipelines multiply each demonstration in simulation. These pipelines rebuild the interaction from vision, which recovers how the hand moves. Which fingers touch, when, and how hard remain unobserved, because a hand pose shows where each finger stops on the surface rather than how far it is driven to close. This gap is a force gap: on held-out recordings, a hand policy that imitates the observed pose grips with 0.31x the recorded force, and a policy trained on physics replays of vision-tracked poses grips with 1.55x. TouchTwin closes the gap with measured human touch. Each selected TouchScale recording, captured with head and wrist RGB-D cameras and an 880-taxel glove, is rebuilt in MuJoCo. Coding agents write the objects as physics-tested programs, and a per-subject tactile hand replays the interaction with the recorded touch setting the contact and the closing force of each finger. In simulation, a policy trained on touch-grounded replays grips at 0.99x the recorded force and succeeds in 20/20 trials on held-out recordings and 35/36 unseen perturbations; a contact predictor trained on them misses 13% of real contact frames, against 32% for vision-based replays. Each replay also seeds perturbed demonstrations with simulated contact and force labels, rendered as realistic video in new views and scenes.

AI.tldr: TouchTwin将实测人类触觉融入真实到仿真再到真实流程，改善灵巧操作数据中的接触与力度还原。
AI.motivation: 视觉重建仅恢复手部姿态，无法确定各手指的接触时机与闭合力度，导致抓握力偏差。
AI.method: 结合RGB-D与880触点手套记录，在MuJoCo中重建交互，并以触觉驱动个体化手模型回放和扰动扩增。
AI.result: 仿真策略握力为记录值的0.99倍，留出与扰动试验分别成功20/20和35/36，真实接触帧漏检率为13%。
AI.conclusion: 触觉锚定回放可缩小视觉重建的力差距，并生成带接触与力标签的扩增示范。

title: Safety Side Effects of Preventative Persona Steering: An Empirical Audit
summary: High-level behaviors such as sycophancy and hallucination correspond to directions in a model's activation space (Chen et al., 2025). These directions, known as persona vectors, can suppress undesirable traits either at inference time, subtracting the vector during generation, or through preventative steering, adding the vector during fine-tuning, so the optimizer never needs to encode the trait in weights, then removing the vector at evaluation. Chen et al. (2025) recommend preventative steering because it preserves Massive Multitask Language Understanding (MMLU) accuracy, but validations of this recommendation have measured capability alone. We primarily evaluate results on preventative steering of sycophancy and hallucination vectors on three models, measuring three safety benchmarks alongside trait expression, coherence, and MMLU. Our findings show that preventative steering still changes refusal behavior, but by an amount that depends on the trait and does not establish that preventative persona steering is safety-neutral, and steering methods should be evaluated on several safety benchmarks.
comment: 5 pages, 1 figure (6 charts), 1 table, accepted at NeurIPS 2026 Bialign Workshop

AI.tldr: 预防性人格引导虽旨在抑制不良特质，仍会改变模型拒答行为，不能据能力保持认定其安全中立。
AI.motivation: 预防性人格引导的推荐主要依据能力评估，尚未充分检验其安全副作用。
AI.method: 在三个模型上重点评估迎合与幻觉向量的预防性引导，同时测量三项安全基准、特质、连贯性和MMLU。
AI.result: 预防性引导仍改变拒答行为，且变化幅度取决于所引导的特质。
AI.conclusion: 现有结果不足以证明预防性人格引导安全中立，应使用多项安全基准进行评估。

title: AscendGYM: A Cost-Aware Kernel Optimization Benchmark for Real-World Workloads on Ascend NPUs
summary: Kernel optimization is essential for efficient large language model (LLM) training and inference on Ascend NPUs. Existing Ascend kernel benchmarks primarily focus on kernel generation, with less emphasis on the ability of agents to optimize existing implementations under input configurations drawn from real workloads. To address this requirement, we introduce AscendGYM, a benchmark whose initial suite comprises 48 kernels across three difficulty levels. Each kernel is paired with test cases whose data types and tensor shapes are collected from real-world training and inference tasks. Consequently, performance improvements on AscendGYM map directly to the corresponding workloads. In terms of usability, two evaluation modes are supported in AscendGYM: model evaluation and model-harness evaluation. The kernel optimization capabilities of both trained models and custom agents are allowed to be measured. It provides a complete execution environment that closely reproduces how Ascend kernels are invoked in practical pipelines. For model evaluation, it additionally includes a built-in harness equipped with search orchestration and experience accumulation. Finally, we propose a new metric, the Speedup-Token Score (STS), which quantifies performance gains relative to token cost. By jointly considering speedup and cost, STS enables the assessment of practical kernel optimization capability of a model or harness under an acceptable budget. AscendGYM is available at this https URL.
comment: 20 pages, 12 figures, 2 tables. Technical Report. Code available at this https URL

AI.tldr: AscendGYM以真实工作负载和词元成本衡量模型及智能体优化昇腾NPU既有内核的能力。
AI.motivation: 现有昇腾内核基准侧重生成，较少评估真实输入配置下对既有实现的优化能力。
AI.method: 构建含48个内核、三个难度等级的基准，提供两种评估模式、执行环境及兼顾加速与成本的STS指标。
AI.result: 摘要未提供具体结果。
AI.conclusion: 该基准支持在预算约束下评估贴近真实训练与推理负载的内核优化能力。

title: Finite speed Ornstein-Uhlenbeck-Kac processes and their applications in generative modeling
summary: We study the Ornstein-Uhlenbeck-Kac (OU-K) process, where instead of a Brownian motion, a finite-speed Kac process defines the driving process. The OU-K process can be analyzed through a rescaled, time-inhomogeneous Kac process, characterized by a switching rate from the Kac part, and a convergence rate from the Ornstein-Uhlenbeck (OU) part. The law of this inhomogeneous Kac process describes the solution of a wave equation, the Euler-Poisson-Darboux (EPD) equation. For Kac switching rates being multiples of the OU convergence rate, we can explicitly derive this EPD solution via the sum of (the derivative of) two Legendre polynomials, restricted between two Dirac points representing the wave fronts. Using the framework of piecewise-deterministic Markov processes (PDMP), we describe the conditional velocity fields of the OU-K process via our polynomial-law-formula. This allows us to apply the OU-K process in a generative flow model. Since the OU-K velocity fields prove to be bounded by the finite Kac speed, the usual time truncations of diffusion models become unnecessary. We demonstrate advantages over diffusion and flow matching models in terms of generation sharpness on singular data sets, while achieving competitive results on CIFAR-10 image generation.

AI.tldr: 研究以有限速度Kac过程驱动的OU-K过程，并将其有界速度场用于无需时间截断的生成模型。
AI.motivation: 探索有限速度随机过程的解析性质及其生成建模应用，以避免扩散模型常用的时间截断。
AI.method: 通过非齐次Kac过程及EPD方程分析OU-K过程，在特定速率关系下推导勒让德多项式公式与条件速度场。
AI.result: 所得速度场受Kac速度约束，模型在奇异数据上生成更清晰，并在CIFAR-10上取得有竞争力的结果。
AI.conclusion: OU-K过程为生成流提供有界速度场，在无需常规时间截断的同时展现生成应用潜力。

title: Joint World Action Models through Differentiable Trajectory Optimization
summary: Joint world action models (WAMs) generate future actions and states together, modeling world-action trajectories rather than actions alone. However, trajectory imitation does not ensure that these trajectories are task-effective or consistent with dynamics. We present \textbf{world action trajectory optimization (WATO)}, which optimizes generated actions and future states jointly for control. WATO uses both as references in a dynamics-constrained trajectory optimization problem and differentiates the task loss through the optimized trajectory to train the generator. This makes generated trajectories task-aware and dynamics-consistent while using trajectory optimization only during training. At deployment, WATO directly generates candidate trajectories and ranks them with a world model, without iterative trajectory optimization. Across $7$ visual control environments, WATO improves average success from $79.9\%$ for the imitation joint WAM to $91.7\%$, outperforming strong model-based, goal-conditioned RL, and generative control baselines. Compared with cross-entropy method (CEM), WATO is on average $11.5\times$ faster and uses $600.5\times$ fewer world model evaluations at deployment.
comment: 29 pages, 6 figures, 14 tables

AI.tldr: WATO通过可微轨迹优化训练联合世界动作模型，提高控制成功率并降低部署计算开销。
AI.motivation: 联合生成动作与未来状态的轨迹模仿，无法保证轨迹对任务有效或符合动力学。
AI.method: 以生成动作和状态为参考进行动力学约束优化，反传任务损失训练生成器，部署时直接生成并排序候选轨迹。
AI.result: 七个环境平均成功率由79.9%升至91.7%；较CEM部署快11.5倍，世界模型评估次数减少600.5倍。
AI.conclusion: 仅在训练时使用轨迹优化，可提升联合轨迹的任务有效性与动力学一致性，并实现高效部署。

title: Training-Free Acceleration of Multi-View 3D Transformers via Regime-Aware Attention Approximation
summary: Multi-view 3D transformers such as VGGT reconstruct a scene from a set of unposed images in a single forward pass, predicting camera poses, depth and 3D points, but the cost of their global attention grows quadratically with the num- ber of images. Accelerators borrowed from large language models assume that each token attends to only a few oth- ers; on these models they lose accuracy or gain little speed. We study the global attention of three multi-view transform- ers on seven datasets and find that every layer plays one of three roles: it averages over the whole scene, matches points across many images, or anchors on the first image, whose coordinates the outputs use. Building on this anal- ysis, we propose Regime-AWare ATTention Approximation (RAWATTA), a training-free method that runs attention in 8- bit precision and keeps 16-bit precision only in the layers where a worst-case calibration check requires it. Its fast set- ting, RAWATTA-Fast, also approximates attention in a few averaging and anchoring layers, while matching layers and the first image keep all their keys. On a 12 GB GPU at 50 im- ages, RAWATTA runs VGGT faster than the released code, mostly through our CUDA engine, and loses at most about one point of pose accuracy (AUC@3) on any dataset; RAWATTA-Fast is slightly faster and less accurate. Both fit 200 images, where the released code runs out of memory at 100.

AI.tldr: RAWATTA根据注意力层功能进行免训练混合精度近似，加速多视图三维重建并减少显存需求。
AI.motivation: 多视图模型全局注意力成本随图像数平方增长，而语言模型式稀疏加速难以兼顾精度与速度。
AI.method: 区分平均、匹配和锚定三类层，采用校准驱动的8/16位注意力，快速版进一步近似部分平均与锚定层。
AI.result: 12GB显卡处理50图时快于原版，姿态AUC@3最多约降1点；两版本均容纳200图，原版100图即显存不足。
AI.conclusion: 按注意力功能选择近似方式可改善速度与显存效率，快速版则以更多精度损失换取进一步加速。

title: A mesh-free deep energy method for phase-field modeling of thermally driven brittle fracture
summary: Phase-field simulation of thermally driven fracture requires resolving localized crack bands whose paths are unknown in advance and thermal boundary layers whose thickness evolves during the transient. Neural energy-based computations of thermal fracture have so far started from defects placed in advance. This paper proposes a mesh-free deep energy method based on multiresolution neural representations that predicts spontaneous crack nucleation, crack spacing, and selective crack propagation and arrest under transient thermal loading. Two networks, each with its own multiresolution encoding, represent the displacement and phase fields and the transient temperature, and the mechanical energy and the incremental functional of the backward Euler heat equation are estimated on integration points redrawn at every iteration. Restricting irreversibility to the crack set, carrying the optimizer state across load steps and decaying the learning rates within each step help prevent spurious damage accumulation. On two notched plates the initiation peak loads agree closely with an independent finite element reference. On a quenched glass strip under an analytical temperature field the crack path changes from straight to oscillatory and then to branched, with an oscillation threshold close to the linear stability prediction. Under a prescribed boundary temperature a quenched ceramic slab forms a crack array of the type observed in experiment, with a spacing close to that of a published benchmark. On the slab and a quenched annulus the arrays are denser than those of a finite element computation on the same material field. No crack paths, nucleation sites or crack-adapted meshes are prescribed.
comment: 48 pages, 18 figures, 15 tables

AI.tldr: 提出无网格深度能量方法，无需预设裂纹即可模拟瞬态热载荷下的自发开裂与裂纹演化。
AI.motivation: 热致断裂需解析未知裂纹路径和演变的热边界层，而已有神经能量方法依赖预置缺陷。
AI.method: 采用多分辨率双网络表示力学场与温度场，重采样积分点，并结合裂纹集不可逆约束和优化策略。
AI.result: 起裂峰值载荷、振荡阈值及裂纹间距接近参考结果，部分试件的裂纹阵列比有限元结果更密。
AI.conclusion: 该方法无需指定裂纹路径、成核位置或裂纹适配网格，即可预测热致裂纹成核、传播与止裂。

title: On the Utility of Pre-Trained Visual Representations for Policy Learning of Contact-Rich Insertion Tasks
summary: Visuomotor imitation learning has become a predominant paradigm for real-world robotic manipulation, yet it remains data-inefficient and brittle to task-irrelevant visual shifts. Pre-trained visual representations promise to ease this burden by distilling priors from internet-scale data, but the ``right'' representation for robotics remains unresolved: existing studies span broad but sparse task distributions and reach conclusions that vary and even conflict, pointing to strong task and setting dependence. We examine this question by bringing a magnifying glass to a common contact-rich manipulation task: insertion. We compare representations from widely used vision foundation models against an explicit contact-centric representation on two closely related insertion tasks, perturb each along controlled axes of occlusion and physical tolerance, and test whether conclusions transfer to the real world. Task dependence proves to be more subtle than previous, broadly scoped evaluations revealed: the best representation differs even between our near-identical tasks, and small changes shift trends in unpredictable ways. Despite this variability, results across simulation and real-world experiments demonstrate the distinct value of spatially-grounded, and in particular, contact-centric information for contact-rich policy learning, while underscoring how difficult it is to estimate such cues reliably under realistic visual complexity and sensor noise. We hope these findings motivate further study of representations in contact-rich manipulation, along with advances in contact perception and its integration into visuomotor policy learning.

AI.tldr: 接触密集型插入任务中，最佳视觉表征高度依赖具体设置，而接触信息具有独特价值。
AI.motivation: 视觉模仿学习数据效率低且易受无关视觉变化影响，预训练视觉表征的适用性仍缺乏一致结论。
AI.method: 在两个相近插入任务中比较基础视觉模型与接触中心表征，控制遮挡和物理容差并开展实机验证。
AI.result: 即使任务近乎相同，最佳表征也不同，微小设置变化会改变趋势，而空间接触信息在仿真和实机中均有价值。
AI.conclusion: 应加强复杂视觉与传感噪声下的接触感知研究，并探索其与视觉运动策略学习的融合。

title: Generated Evaluation Suites as Diversity-Driven Search for Real Agent Regressions
summary: Generating an evaluation suite from an agent's specification is diversity-driven search: a generator fills a descriptor space (requirements $\times$ personas $\times$ scenario kinds), and the suite it emits is an archive, then scored like a benchmark by its mean pass rate, which throws away the search's product. We inject 7 controlled defects into a $\tau^2$-bench agent across two domains. Coverage yields a ceiling: if a defect's traced footprint holds $b$ scenarios that pass at baseline, it can itself contribute at most $b/N$ to a suite of $N$. For 4 of 5 traceable defects that ceiling lies at or below the detection threshold $\theta = 0.10$, so no within-footprint effect can move the suite past it; in both domains the tool-removal defect destroys every covered scenario it can (exactly its ceiling) while the suite-level pass rate moves the other way. Defects split into two regimes: trace-aligned ones, where per-cell scoring recovers the tool-removal defect in full and reveals a second as a significant improvement, and trace-orthogonal ones, whose footprint is behavioural: forced escalation is detected in retail at a traced coverage of exactly zero. Diversity along the generator's own axes helps only where it aligns: at fixed suite size a happy-path-only suite detects nothing, while a kind-diverse one detects the orchestration defect in 5 of 20 draws. Evaluation archives should be scored per cell and should publish coverage as a first-class property.
comment: 9 pages. Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 EvoRobust Workshop

AI.tldr: 生成式智能体评测套件的平均通过率可能掩盖真实退化，应按覆盖单元评分并报告覆盖情况。
AI.motivation: 将多样性搜索生成的场景档案压缩为平均通过率，会丢失覆盖结构并削弱缺陷检测能力。
AI.method: 在两个领域的智能体中注入七种受控缺陷，分析覆盖上限、逐单元评分及场景多样性的检测效果。
AI.result: 五种可追踪缺陷中四种的覆盖上限不超过检测阈值，逐单元评分则完整检出工具移除缺陷。
AI.conclusion: 评测应采用逐单元评分并将覆盖率作为核心属性，且需关注工具轨迹之外的行为缺陷。

title: AI-guided robotic in situ fabrication of curvature- and tissue-adaptive wireless bioelectronics
summary: Personalized bioelectronic devices for wound therapy require not only conformal fabrication on complex body surfaces but also functional adaptation of their electrical characteristics to individual wound geometries. Here, we present an AI-guided robotic in situ printing platform for fabricating wireless wound electrotherapy devices directly on transparent wound dressings. The system integrates a 3D vision camera, a six-degree-of-freedom robotic arm, direct-ink-writing, and geometry-aware RF design optimization. AI-based wound segmentation is used to determine wound dimensions and local surface curvature, while the reconstructed three-dimensional geometry is incorporated into the electromagnetic design of the receiving coil and interdigitated electrodes. In contrast to conventional approaches that use surface geometry only for trajectory generation, the proposed method accounts for both anatomical curvature and tissue dielectric loading to compensate for geometry-induced shifts in resonant behavior. A printable silver ink was characterized in terms of rheology, dimensional reproducibility, electrical resistance, and electromechanical stability, and was used to fabricate multilayer wireless devices directly on curved polyurethane dressings. Wireless power transfer, impedance characteristics, and electric-field delivery were evaluated experimentally and numerically. Finally, robotic in situ fabrication was demonstrated on an anthropomorphic tissue-equivalent forearm phantom, where the measured dielectric properties of the phantom were incorporated into the RF optimization, enabling resonant operation near the target frequency of 25 MHz. This work establishes a perception-to-design-to-fabrication framework for geometry-adaptive wireless bioelectronics and provides a technological foundation for future physical-AI-enabled manufacturing of personalized on-body electrotherapy devices.

AI.tldr: 提出人工智能引导的机器人原位打印平台，实现适应曲率和组织介电特性的无线伤口电疗器件制造。
AI.motivation: 个性化伤口电疗器件不仅需贴合复杂体表，还需针对伤口几何调整电学性能。
AI.method: 融合三维视觉、伤口分割、六自由度机械臂和直写打印，将曲率与组织介电负载纳入射频优化。
AI.result: 平台在曲面敷料上制成多层无线器件，并在组织等效前臂模型上实现接近25 MHz目标频率的谐振。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立感知、设计到制造的一体化框架，为个性化体表无线电疗器件制造提供技术基础。

title: What LLM Agents See and What Users Say
summary: Before an LLM agent cancels a reservation or deletes a folder for a user, what stops it from acting on a false assumption: what its tools show, or what the user says? In this work, we study this gap with presupposition theory from linguistics: an agent may act only if each claim behind the act (e.g., one reservation fits the name) is seen to hold, answered by the user, or disclosed while the act can be undone. A simple bound shows that when lookups cannot tell one record from two, any agent acts without asking first as often with two records as with one. We then vary whether a search lists, counts, or omits a second match, and whether the user states a claim that a record refutes (e.g., "It is empty"). Under a role-only prompt, a count of a second record leaves most of 36 earlier agents acting on the one they see, whereas listing both stops most. When the user says a record such as a folder is empty, however, a count of its one item stops agents about as often as a listing, and stating the claim mostly cuts acting when it is false. The newest Claude and GPT models always open a counted second record, then never act. When we add a same-name, same-zip customer to a retail benchmark, a lookup returning that customer first led to wrong-account writes in about a quarter of conversations, and one that checks a street the user knows kept completion near the one-customer level. Safe writes therefore need lookups that list or check competing records, and evaluations that vary what tools show.

AI.tldr: 智能体能否避免基于错误假设执行操作，取决于工具如何呈现竞争记录及用户如何陈述前提。
AI.motivation: 取消预订或删除文件等操作可能建立在错误前提上，需要厘清工具信息和用户陈述对安全决策的影响。
AI.method: 基于语言学预设理论，改变搜索结果的列举、计数与遗漏方式及用户陈述，并测试同名客户场景。
AI.result: 列出竞争记录比仅计数更能阻止多数旧模型误操作，零售场景错误账户写入约占四分之一。
AI.conclusion: 安全写操作需要能列出或核验竞争记录的查询工具，评测也应系统改变工具可见信息。

title: CoTTAGE: An Explainable Judge for Text-to-Audio Generation
summary: Rapid progress in text-to-audio (TTA) generation demands reliable and explainable automatic evaluation. However, existing metrics fail to simultaneously deliver high correlation with human judgments and meaningful, audio-grounded explanations, forcing reliance on labor-intensive human evaluation that bottlenecks model development iteration. To address this, we propose CoTTAGE, a reasoning-based evaluator for text relevance (REL) and audio quality (OVL). Following a reason-then-predict paradigm, CoTTAGE first generates an audio-grounded rationale to diagnose errors before predicting scores. Supported by over 10K newly collected human OVL annotations, CoTTAGE is first trained via supervised fine-tuning and then refined with reinforcement learning using a Thurstone-based preference objective that converts sampled score distributions into pairwise preference probabilities and rewards agreement with rankings derived from human judgments. Across six benchmarks spanning REL and OVL, CoTTAGE achieves state-of-the-art correlation with human judgments while producing human-preferred explanations to accelerate TTA development.

AI.tldr: CoTTAGE先生成基于音频的解释再评分，在文本到音频评测中兼顾人类判断相关性与可解释性。
AI.motivation: 现有自动指标难以同时提供高人类判断相关性和有意义的音频解释，导致开发依赖耗时人工评测。
AI.method: 利用逾一万条新增人工音质标注进行监督微调，再以基于Thurstone模型的偏好目标开展强化学习。
AI.result: 在涵盖文本相关性与音质的六个基准上取得领先的人类判断相关性，生成的解释也更受人类偏好。
AI.conclusion: 先推理后评分的评测方式可兼顾可靠评分与错误诊断，为文本到音频模型迭代提供支持。

title: Binarization as an Attack Surface in Weightless Neural Networks
summary: Weightless Neural Networks (WNNs) are lightweight classifiers that binarize their inputs and learn by storing binary patterns in lookup memories, which makes them attractive for resource-constrained tasks such as intrusion detection. Because a small perturbation that crosses no binarization threshold leaves the binary input unchanged, WNNs may appear naturally robust to adversarial examples; a perturbation that does cross a threshold, however, can still change the prediction. We study this tension in WiSARD, the canonical RAM-based WNN, and in two variants that replace its memories with Bloom filters, Bloom WiSARD and BTHOWeN. A continuous perturbation reaches these classifiers only by crossing an encoding threshold, changing at least one binary tuple, and redirecting a memory query; we formalize this mechanism with a threshold-crossing bound and a response-margin certificate for standard Boolean WiSARD. Controlled MNIST experiments compare linear and data-driven thermometer encodings under model-agnostic sensitivity probes, a score-based Simulated Annealing attack, and surrogate-transfer attacks. Changing only the encoding while keeping each model otherwise fixed shows that encoding granularity can trade a small clean-accuracy loss for a large decrease in attack success. On the Bot-IoT, CICIDS, and UNSW-NB15 intrusion-detection datasets, adversarial perturbations lead WNN detectors to classify many attacks as normal traffic and to raise false alarms, even when their aggregate accuracy remains high.
comment: This paper appears at the Trustworthy Machine Learning Workshop (ARTMAN 2026) co-located with the IEEE Annual Computer Security Applications Conference (ACSAC 2026)

AI.tldr: 无权重神经网络的二值化并不天然保证对抗鲁棒性，编码阈值本身构成攻击入口。
AI.motivation: 不跨越阈值的扰动不会改变二值输入，但跨阈值扰动仍可能改变预测，需明确其鲁棒性边界。
AI.method: 分析WiSARD及两种布隆过滤器变体，建立阈值跨越界和响应间隔证书，并测试不同编码与攻击。
AI.result: 调整编码粒度可用小幅准确率损失换取攻击成功率大降，入侵检测中仍出现攻击漏报与正常流量误报。
AI.conclusion: 二值编码是关键攻击面，整体准确率较高也不能证明无权重网络检测器具备对抗安全性。

title: Classifier-Guided Latent Diffusion for Small-Molecule Generation
summary: Diffusion models have emerged as a promising class of generative models for molecular design because of their ability to learn complex chemical distributions and support conditional or guided generation. In this work, we investigate a latent diffusion pipeline for property-guided small-molecule generation. The proposed framework represents canonicalized SMILES strings using a frozen ChemBERTa encoder, trains a Transformer-based decoder to reconstruct SELFIES strings from molecular latent embeddings, and learns an unconditional denoising diffusion model in the ChemBERTa latent space. To enable property-directed generation, a differentiable latent property predictor is used to guide the diffusion sampling process. Generated SELFIES strings are converted to SMILES, validated using RDKit, and evaluated using molecular validity, uniqueness, novelty, and predicted property scores. We study guidance toward two drug-relevant binary endpoints: blood--brain barrier permeability and inhibition of human $\beta$-secretase 1. The results suggest that latent diffusion over pretrained molecular embeddings can generate chemically valid and novel molecules while enabling controllable steering toward desired molecular properties.

AI.tldr: 基于预训练分子嵌入的潜在扩散模型可生成有效且新颖的小分子，并引导其趋向目标性质。
AI.motivation: 分子设计需要学习复杂化学分布，同时实现面向药物相关性质的可控生成。
AI.method: 冻结ChemBERTa编码器，训练SELFIES解码器和潜在去噪扩散模型，以可微性质预测器引导采样。
AI.result: 针对血脑屏障通透性和人β分泌酶1抑制的实验表明，该方法能生成有效、新颖且性质可调的分子。
AI.conclusion: 预训练分子嵌入上的潜在扩散为面向目标性质的小分子生成提供了可行路径。

title: Imitation Policies Learn a Proprioceptive Anchor: A Predictive Law for Perception Noise and Its Closed Loop Cost
summary: Imitation policies for robot manipulation are often trained on noisy object positions, and they learn to discount the noisy reading. We show how much they discount it, and why. Because demonstrators steer toward the object, the robot's own state carries information about where the object is. A trained policy combines this proprioceptive anchor with the reading and weights the reading by $\alpha = V/(V + s^2)$, where $s^2$ is the reading noise and $V$ the anchor's error variance. $V$ belongs to the learner and is far smaller than a linear model of the demonstrations implies, which is why classical errors-in-variables (EIV) regression overestimates $\alpha$. Measured once, $V$ predicted ten held-out sensitivities across two robomimic tasks, two learners and four new noise levels, with mean absolute error 0.025 against 0.37 for classical EIV, and a parameter-free bias test rules out the simpler explanation that the policies just overestimate the noise. The discount does not carry over to deployment, where the policy produces its own state: closed-loop sensitivity to a persistent reading offset exceeded $\alpha$ in all 15 policies that passed the registered gates, although the stricter registered prediction, that all would follow the offset fully, held for 8 of them. Post hoc, lower $\alpha$ went with lower success, steeply for diffusion, and a registered prospective test confirmed this for diffusion on Can at two new noise levels: the measured $\alpha$ predicted success before any rollout, within 0.03 (95% intervals $\pm 0.08$), although training noise predicts it equally well. Every test was registered before its data, including the classical benchmark that failed, and all other analyses are labelled post hoc; all results are in simulation with synthetic Gaussian noise.
comment: 18 pages, 4 figures

AI.tldr: 模仿策略借助本体感觉锚点折减感知噪声，但训练中的低敏感度不等于部署时的闭环鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 解释机器人模仿策略如何折减带噪物体位置读数，以及这种折减对闭环控制成功率的影响。
AI.method: 建立读数权重α=V/(V+s²)的预测规律，并在仿真中以预注册实验检验敏感度与闭环代价。
AI.result: 敏感度预测误差为0.025，经典方法为0.37；全部15个合格策略的闭环偏移敏感度均超过α。
AI.conclusion: 本体感觉锚点解释了训练中的噪声折减，但相关部署风险结论仅经合成高斯噪声仿真验证。

title: EViDS: An Environment--Vehicle Dynamics Integrated Simulation Platform for Intelligent Chassis Development
summary: The development of intelligent chassis increasingly requires the integration of environmental and perception information with high-fidelity vehicle dynamics to support environment-aware intelligent chassis control. However, existing autonomous-driving simulators and professional vehicle-dynamics tools are generally developed for different purposes, making it difficult to integrate environmental information, vehicle dynamics, and chassis algorithms. This paper proposes EViDS, an Environment-Vehicle Dynamics Integrated Simulation Platform for Intelligent Chassis Development. EViDS integrates CARLA-based environment and sensor simulation with CarSim-based high-fidelity vehicle dynamics. Reference-pose-based state alignment and multi-rate interaction maintain spatial and temporal consistency, while ray-casting-based tire-road interaction transfers environmental information to the vehicle-dynamics model. Scenario configuration, synchronized data acquisition, and algorithm interfaces further support intelligent chassis development. The platform is evaluated through environment-dynamics interaction tests with vehicle-dynamics consistency comparisons, together with intelligent chassis applications. Results show that EViDS preserves vehicle-dynamics characteristics, reliably transfers environmental information, and supports online closed-loop intelligent chassis control, providing a unified simulation basis for environment-aware intelligent chassis development and validation.

AI.tldr: EViDS融合环境感知仿真与高保真车辆动力学，为环境感知型智能底盘提供统一开发平台。
AI.motivation: 现有自动驾驶仿真器与专业车辆动力学工具用途不同，难以统一环境信息、动力学和底盘算法。
AI.method: 集成CARLA与CarSim，通过参考位姿对齐、多速率交互和射线投射轮胎路面交互保持一致性。
AI.result: 测试显示平台保持车辆动力学特性、可靠传递环境信息，并支持在线闭环智能底盘控制。
AI.conclusion: EViDS可为环境感知型智能底盘的开发与验证提供统一仿真基础。

title: Feasibility of Pareto-Improving Damping Control of Forced Oscillations: The Active-Power Case
summary: Damping control of a forced oscillation may reduce amplitudes at certain locations while increasing them elsewhere. This paper introduces Pareto improvement as a criterion for assessing such control: at least one nodal oscillation amplitude decreases, while none increases across all other nodes. The analysis considers active-power forcing sources and active-power control injections in connected swing networks with positive inertia and damping. Necessary conditions for Pareto improvement feasibility are derived from the normalized nodal responses. It is proven that for every network with a single oscillation source and a single actuator, at least one positive forcing frequency is shown to preclude Pareto improvement, regardless of the amplitude and phase of the control input. A three-node counterexample shows that this limitation does not persist with multiple actuators. PSS/E simulations of a 6-bus benchmark system and a modified IEEE 39-bus system validated the analysis. These findings suggest the value of assessing control effects across the network and further investigating multi-actuator damping control.

AI.tldr: 单振荡源、单执行器网络必存在无法实现全节点帕累托改善的正频率，多执行器可能突破此限制。
AI.motivation: 强迫振荡阻尼控制可能降低部分节点振幅却增大其他节点振幅，需要评估全网控制收益。
AI.method: 以至少一节点振幅下降且其他节点不增为准则，在有功激励与控制的摆动网络中推导必要条件。
AI.result: 证明单源单执行器的不可改善频率必然存在，并以三节点反例及两套系统仿真检验分析。
AI.conclusion: 阻尼控制应评估全网影响，并进一步研究多执行器实现帕累托改善的可能性。

title: Learn then Bet: Learning Interpretable Rules for Reliable Agent Intervention
summary: Autonomous agents now run for hundreds of steps with little or no human supervision. In practice, practitioners use runtime monitors such as turn limits and keyword filters to decide when a run should be stopped, upgraded, or assisted. However, these heuristics may stop runs that would otherwise succeed or allow failing runs to continue. To address this limitation, we introduce LeBet (Learn then Bet), a statistical learning framework that derives its learning objective from sufficient conditions for valid and powerful intervention. In particular, LeBet learns an interpretable OR-of-AND monitor and accumulates evidence through a fixed betting statistic, intervening when the evidence reaches a prescribed threshold. Under finite within-class exchangeability and leave-one-out stability, we derive finite-sample guarantees for false-positive control (validity) and detection power conditional on the training data, using the same trajectories for learning and calibration without assuming independent and identically distributed trajectories. To address the intractable combinatorial optimization problem in our learning formulation, we use stochastic local search that leverages the monitor's Boolean structure to propose rule edits aimed at improving empirical separation. On SWE-bench Lite with Ministral 3 8B, the learned monitor saves $34.46\%$ of input-plus-output tokens and increases output precision from $18.33\%$ to $21.59\%$. The empirical false-positive rate is $13.64\%$. Our results show how to formalize the learning problem over interpretable rule sets with statistical conditions and establish training-conditional guarantees for reliable intervention based on partial histories.

AI.tldr: LeBet学习可解释规则并积累投注统计量，在特定统计条件下为智能体运行干预提供有限样本保证。
AI.motivation: 轮次限制和关键词过滤等运行监控规则可能误停成功任务，或放任失败任务继续消耗资源。
AI.method: 学习析取合取规则监控器，以随机局部搜索优化规则，并在固定投注统计量达到阈值时干预。
AI.result: 在SWE-bench Lite上节省34.46%的词元，输出精确率由18.33%升至21.59%，误报率为13.64%。
AI.conclusion: 在类内可交换性与留一稳定性条件下，同一批轨迹可用于学习和校准，并获得训练条件化干预保证。

title: Provable Cross-Modal Transfer of Hierarchical Concept Structure in CLIP Embeddings
summary: Contrastive vision-language models such as CLIP are trained to align images and text, not to represent taxonomies. Yet empirical studies show that CLIP embeddings exhibit hierarchical structure aligned with the hierarchy of semantic concepts. A theoretical characterization of why such hierarchy emerges from a non-hierarchical objective remains open. In this paper, we formalize this phenomenon as Hierarchical Angular Separation (HAS), a geometric property whereby each non-leaf concept embedding is more similar to its descendants than to off-branch concepts. Empirically, we show that HAS holds approximately in raw images and randomly initialized CLIP image embeddings, while in text embeddings it holds approximately only after contrastive learning. To theoretically explain this asymmetry, we analyze an unconstrained features model in which the image embeddings are fixed and only the text embeddings are trained. At the global minimizer, the text-side HAS violation percentage at each node is at most the image-side HAS violation and near-violation percentage. The key mechanism is the hierarchical co-occurrence structure of image-text pairs, which biases text embeddings toward root-centered image prototypes. For a linear contrastive loss, we derive a closed-form solution that makes this mechanism explicit. We extend the analysis to the InfoNCE loss and establish analogous guarantees under sufficient regularization. Synthetic experiments validate the theory and show that HAS is transferred even beyond the regimes covered by our analysis.
comment: NeurIPS 2026

AI.tldr: 论文从理论上说明，对比学习可借助图文共现结构将图像中的概念层级迁移到文本嵌入。
AI.motivation: CLIP虽未直接学习分类体系，却呈现语义层级结构，其形成机制缺乏理论解释。
AI.method: 定义层级角分离性质，在固定图像嵌入模型中分析线性对比损失及充分正则化的InfoNCE损失。
AI.result: 全局最优时，文本侧各节点的层级违规比例不超过图像侧违规与近违规比例之和，合成实验支持该理论。
AI.conclusion: 图文层级共现使文本嵌入偏向以根为中心的图像原型，从而促成跨模态层级结构迁移。

title: Pattern-Based Matrix Analysis Under Permutations
summary: Low-rank approximation captures one important notion of matrix simplicity: a matrix is simple if it is well described by a low-dimensional linear model. This paper studies a complementary notion. We consider matrices that become structurally simple only after permuting rows and columns, so that their mass concentrates in a prescribed geometric pattern such as a band, block-diagonal, arrowhead, or related form. We introduce a pattern distance that measures how close a matrix is to a given pattern after optimal reordering, giving a common framework for structural problems such as latent ordering, community detection, and bandwidth minimization. The problem is NP-hard in general; we derive an alternating algorithm based on Linear Assignment subproblems. We further introduce a pattern-plus-low-rank decomposition that combines permutation-structured fitting with a low-rank residual, whose permutation step is pattern fitting on the residual; its gains across pattern families persist at a matched parameter budget and are substantially reduced under a density-matched random-mask control. We evaluate the framework on synthetic recovery tasks, real correlation and graph adjacency matrices, and transformer attention heads, showing that a single universal algorithm recovers qualitatively different forms of matrix structure.
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 (The Fortieth Annual Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems)

AI.tldr: 论文以最优行列重排后的模式距离刻画矩阵结构，并结合低秩残差统一恢复多类几何模式。
AI.motivation: 低秩近似难以描述只有经过行列置换后才呈现带状、块对角等结构的矩阵。
AI.method: 定义置换下的模式距离，用线性指派子问题构造交替算法，并提出模式加低秩分解。
AI.result: 算法在合成矩阵、真实相关与邻接矩阵及注意力头中恢复多类结构，等参数预算下分解收益仍存在。
AI.conclusion: 置换模式为低秩分析提供互补视角，可用统一算法处理潜在排序、社区发现等结构问题。

title: Aligned, Conflicting, or Unspecified? A Diagnostic Benchmark for Multimodal Time Series Forecasting
summary: Artificial Intelligence of Things (AIoT) systems increasingly combine sensed time series with external text such as expert reports and news, yet how reliably models use text that agrees or conflicts with the sensed history remains unclear. We introduce the first real-world diagnostic benchmark organized by text-history relationship: 1,762 text-window pairs across sensor telemetry (Weather), web-service traffic (Wikipedia), and market data streams (Finance), each labeled Aligned, Conflicting, or Unspecified by whether the text's direction agrees with the historical trend, opposes it, or is not stated. Across ten pretrained models evaluated zero-shot, we investigate text selection and combination under text-history relationships (RQ1) and error diagnosis and horizon-scaled revision control (RQ2). For RQ1, we compare two types of text on paired Weather windows: one directly forecasts temperature changes, while the other describes related weather conditions, such as winds and fronts. Under Aligned, the first type yields the lowest error for most models. Under Conflicting, it increases most models' error above the no-text baseline; we therefore add only its stated magnitude and timing to the second type. Compared with either type alone, this combination lowers mean absolute scaled error (MASE) for six models and raises directional accuracy (DA) for seven. For RQ2, an error decomposition attributes the error increase to oversized revisions, and a training-free rule that limits them outperforms forecasts both with and without text for the four models with this trade-off, lowering MASE by 4.49%-21.98% and raising DA by 2.99%-9.71%. Our dataset is available at this https URL.
comment: Accepted at IEEE AIoT 2026 Workshop

AI.tldr: 该基准按文本与历史趋势关系诊断多模态预测，发现冲突文本可能导致过度修正，限制修正幅度可改善表现。
AI.motivation: 感知时间序列结合外部文本日益普遍，但模型如何利用一致或冲突文本仍不清楚。
AI.method: 构建涵盖天气、维基流量和金融的1762对文本窗口，零样本评估十个模型，并测试文本组合与免训练修正规则。
AI.result: 限制修正幅度使四个存在权衡的模型MASE降低4.49%—21.98%，方向准确率提高2.99%—9.71%。
AI.conclusion: 文本与历史的关系及预测修正幅度是多模态时间序列预测可靠性的重要诊断维度。

title: OCTAVE: A Capability-Resolved Benchmark for End-to-End HTML5 Game Generation
summary: Complete game generation requires agents to coordinate rules, interactions, states, and presentation over a long development process. A single aggregate score obscures which capabilities are implemented and which requirements remain unmet. We present OCTAVE, a benchmark for complete HTML5 game generation organized around eight Capability Dimensions, with 180 tasks and 1,800 Evaluation Requirements drawn from real player requests, commercial-mechanics reconstruction, and human expert design. It covers PC Web, Mobile Web, 2D, and 3D. Requirements distinguish Completeness, assessing publicly specified core implementation, from Richness, assessing hidden, deeper system relationships. Static source-code judgments provide requirement-level diagnosis across capabilities and task conditions. Evaluation of 11 model-harness combinations yields 33.2% Completeness and 32.5% Richness; 19.9% of generation records are static gate failures or missing artifacts. Excluding same-model self-evaluation, even the best combination remains below 50% on both public and hidden requirements. Richness is not harder than Completeness under every task condition. Systems perform relatively better on Core Rules and Numerical Design, while AI/NPC and Feedback and Game Feel show more prominent gaps. Requirement difficulty offers coarse stratification but is only weakly negatively correlated with pass rates. A limited human cross-check finds that requirements judged satisfied by humans but failed by the automated evaluator are the main direction of disagreement. OCTAVE extends evaluation beyond aggregate scores to diagnosis localized by requirement, capability, and task condition.

AI.tldr: OCTAVE以八类能力和逐项需求评估完整HTML5游戏生成，揭示现有系统在实现完整性与深层关系上的不足。
AI.motivation: 单一总分掩盖游戏生成过程中哪些能力已实现、哪些具体需求仍未满足。
AI.method: 构建180项任务和1800条评估需求，区分公开完整性与隐藏丰富性，并以静态源码评估11种模型框架组合。
AI.result: 完整性与丰富性分别为33.2%和32.5%，19.9%的生成记录静态门检失败或缺失产物。
AI.conclusion: 逐需求评估可定位能力短板，但有限人工复核显示自动评估存在将已满足需求判为失败的偏差。

title: Agent-written heuristics versus commercial solvers on unsolved job-shop benchmark instances
summary: Commercial solvers are the standard tool for difficult scheduling problems. We study whether a frontier large language model, used as a coding agent with open-source tools only, can match them in quality and speed. We report every run, and independent checkers verify every schedule. On the 100,000-operation job shop tai_100_1000_1, an agent-written solver reached 525,515, below OptalCP, Hexaly, and CP Optimizer. Unchanged, it improved all ten instances of the family and closed two. With equal budgets on the same workstation, it ended 0.0-1.8% above the lower bound, against 2.6-5.8% for CP Optimizer and 2.4-4.4% for Hexaly. On the Behnke-Geiger flexible job shops, an agent-written tabu search improved 11 of 32 open instances. With two transport robots, an agent-written solver improved seven of ten MKT instances. New lower bounds show that four published MKT values cannot be attained on the distributed instance files. Agent-run improvement campaigns closed eight further instances.
comment: 27 pages, 4 figures, 14 tables. Submitted to International Transactions in Operational Research. Data, schedules, checkers and code: this https URL

AI.tldr: 仅用开源工具的语言模型编程智能体编写调度启发式算法，在多个未解基准上改进纪录并优于商业求解器。
AI.motivation: 检验前沿语言模型编程智能体能否在困难调度问题上匹配商业求解器的质量与速度。
AI.method: 智能体编写车间调度启发式算法，在同机等预算下对比商业求解器，并由独立检查器验证全部调度。
AI.result: 十个同族实例均获改进且两个被解；等预算下距下界为0.0%—1.8%，低于两款商业求解器。
AI.conclusion: 智能体编写的启发式算法在所测调度基准中具有竞争力，且智能体主导的改进活动进一步解决了八个实例。

title: Representational Geometry as a Diagnostic for Adversarial Robustness
summary: Adversarial training is a common technique for making neural networks more robust to small, intentionally crafted input perturbations, and robustness is commonly measured through accuracy under attack. By exploring inter-network representations across different adversarial training objectives, we can analyze whether multiple networks organize their latent representations similarly. We study Multilayer Perceptrons trained on MNIST under three adversarial training regimes and compare the resulting population training dynamics and geometry to those of a vanilla network. We use M-PHATE to embed data samples across training epochs and examine how the geometry of the data changes during training under adversarial objectives. On penultimate-layer representations we measure displacement between clean and perturbed points, distributional distance through maximum mean discrepancy, and nearest-neighbor recovery. Our visualizations and quantitative analyses show that adversarial training leads to structural changes in how networks organize internal data representations, and robust accuracy and representational stability can rank the same defenses in opposite ways. These findings support a discussion of re-evaluating how practitioners approach the auditing of model robustness by treating latent representations and their training trajectories as diagnostic artifacts across sets of networks.

AI.tldr: 对抗训练改变网络内部表征几何，而鲁棒准确率与表征稳定性可能对同一防御给出相反排名。
AI.motivation: 仅用受攻击准确率衡量鲁棒性，难以揭示不同对抗训练目标如何塑造内部表征。
AI.method: 比较MNIST上三类对抗训练与普通多层感知机，用M-PHATE及位移、分布距离和近邻恢复分析表征。
AI.result: 对抗训练引起表征组织的结构变化，且鲁棒准确率与表征稳定性对防御方法的排名可能相反。
AI.conclusion: 潜在表征及其训练轨迹可作为跨网络鲁棒性审计的诊断依据。

title: Orbit-AWARE: From Onboard AI Deployment to Sustainable In-Orbit Intelligence
summary: The growing role of space computing in time-critical satellite services makes the long-term reliability of onboard artificial intelligence (AI) a mission-level requirement. Model drift can undermine this reliability through critical-observation suppression or noncritical priority flooding, displacing both mission information and evidence for model correction. To address this drift-induced evidence displacement, this article presents Orbit-AWARE, a safeguard-first lifecycle management (LCM) architecture. A comparison of existing approaches motivates cooperative Data, Cognitive, and Trust Planes for continuous monitoring, event-triggered agentic orchestration, and deterministic governance. The architecture retains a model-independent sample stream before degradation is confirmed and coordinates evidence selection and exchange for diagnosis and ground-assisted adaptation. Candidate updates are verified before control over data disposition is restored. In an xBD-based emergency Earth observation (EO) case study, Orbit-AWARE delivers 14.3\% more critical observations and achieves 8.3\% higher sustainable mission utility than the Rule-Based Drift Loop under a common 10\% downlink budget. Finally, we discuss future research directions for extending LCM through task-aware reliability assessment, memory- and tool-enabled onboard agents, and evidence-centric space networking. This work makes evidence availability and recovery authorization explicit design objectives for dependable onboard AI services.
comment: 10 pages, 4 figures, 2 tables, submitted to IEEE Wireless Communications

AI.tldr: Orbit-AWARE以证据保留和更新授权为核心管理星载AI生命周期，提高应急观测收益。
AI.motivation: 模型漂移可能压制关键观测或淹没优先级，同时挤占任务信息与模型纠错所需证据。
AI.method: 通过数据、认知和信任平面保留独立采样流，协调证据交换与地面辅助适配，并在恢复控制权前验证更新。
AI.result: 在xBD应急地球观测案例的10%下行预算下，关键观测增加14.3%，可持续任务效用提高8.3%。
AI.conclusion: 将证据可用性与恢复授权明确纳入设计，有助于提升星载AI服务的长期可靠性。

title: Frequency-Security-Aware Real-Time Economic Dispatch with Data Center UPS Flexibility for Inertia and Primary Frequency Response Services
summary: The increasing penetration of renewable energy and the rapid growth of AI data centers are introducing significant challenges to power system frequency security. There is an urgent need to identify grid-compatible resources capable of providing fast frequency support. This paper proposes a frequency-security-aware real-time economic dispatch (RTED) model that enables data center (DC) uninterruptible power supply (UPS) systems to provide steady-state power balancing, inertia response, and primary frequency response (PFR) services. Specifically, tractable analytical frequency-security constraints are derived and incorporated into the RTED framework through second-order cone programming (SOCP) formulation. The proposed model jointly optimizes energy, reserve, and inertia to minimize system operation cost while preventing under-frequency load shedding (UFLS). Numerical validation on a modified IEEE 39-bus system demonstrates that the proposed RTED model with UPS flexibility can economically support system operation and significantly improve frequency security under active-power deficit disturbances.

AI.tldr: 将数据中心UPS的功率平衡、惯量和一次调频能力纳入实时经济调度，可兼顾经济性与频率安全。
AI.motivation: 可再生能源渗透率与AI数据中心规模增长加剧频率安全挑战，需要可快速支撑频率的兼容资源。
AI.method: 推导可处理的频率安全约束，以二阶锥规划联合优化能量、备用与惯量，降低成本并防止低频减载。
AI.result: 改进IEEE 39节点系统验证表明，UPS灵活性可经济地支持运行，并显著改善有功缺额扰动下的频率安全。
AI.conclusion: 数据中心UPS可作为频率支撑资源，通过实时调度提升系统运行经济性与安全性。

title: Open-World Scene Deocclusion
summary: Recovering the complete appearance of occluded objects from a single image is a fundamental problem for scene understanding and image editing. Real-world scenes are challenging due to clutter, complex spatial occlusions, and diverse object categories. Existing methods often struggle when occlusion involves background surfaces or objects that are not explicitly detected, and fail to resolve the cyclic occlusion dependencies that frequently occur in natural scenes. We introduce a training-free, open-world scene deocclusion framework that recovers the full amodal appearance of detected or user-selected objects from a single RGB image, decomposing the scene into depth-ordered RGBA layers that are geometrically plausible, semantically faithful, and visually consistent with the visible scene. Extensive experiments show that our approach improves scene-level deocclusion, producing coherent and realistic reconstructions in real-world settings. Code will be available on the project page: this https URL
comment: 10 pages, 7 figures, Accepted at WACV 2027

AI.tldr: 提出无需训练的开放世界场景去遮挡框架，从单张图像恢复对象完整外观并生成深度排序图层。
AI.motivation: 现有方法难以处理背景或未检测对象参与的遮挡，以及自然场景中循环的遮挡依赖。
AI.method: 从单张RGB图像恢复已检测或用户选定对象的完整外观，将场景分解为深度排序的RGBA图层。
AI.result: 广泛实验表明，该方法改善场景级去遮挡，在真实场景中生成连贯且逼真的重建。
AI.conclusion: 无需训练的开放世界框架能够改善复杂真实场景中的对象完整外观恢复。

title: Co-Sight Harness: Externalized Control Assets and Deterministic Enforcement for Long-Horizon Business Agents
summary: Long-horizon business workflows fail in two ways: errors accumulate as a chain of activities lengthens, and the knowledge an activity needs is written in a different vocabulary from the user's request. We study whether such workflows can be made reliable without changing the language model. Our method keeps the backbone fixed and moves the workflow definition, state and domain knowledge into versioned control assets outside the model. A state machine and machine-checkable acceptance gates enforce these assets during execution; an independent auditor grades the resulting trace. The assets are updated only after a regression check and human approval .We evaluate the method on three deployed workflows exceeding 200 steps. On Domain A, a 120-case end-to-end evaluation set shows unattended completion rising from 50% to 100%, retrieval recall from 56% to 91.67%, and end-to-end latency dropping from 440 to 159 minutes, with scenario-analysis recall rising from 45% to 93%. Two other domains were taken over by teams that did not write the assets, one in four days and one in seven days. A controlled ablation separates the two failure sources. The code is available at this https URL.

AI.tldr: Co-Sight Harness保持语言模型不变，通过外置控制资产与确定性执行提升长流程业务智能体可靠性。
AI.motivation: 长流程业务容易累积错误，且用户请求与活动所需领域知识的词汇差异会妨碍检索。
AI.method: 将流程、状态和知识外置为版本化资产，以状态机、验收门和独立审计约束执行，并经回归检查与人工批准更新。
AI.result: 领域A的120例评估中，无人完成率从50%升至100%，检索召回率从56%升至91.67%，耗时降至159分钟。
AI.conclusion: 在三个超过200步的部署流程中，外置控制资产支持可靠执行，且两个领域可由非原作者团队接手。

title: An AI-enabled high-resolution chlorophyll-a forecasting model that outperforms the operational global biogeochemical system
summary: Surface chlorophyll-a concentration is a key indicator of marine phytoplankton variability, and short-term forecasts of its distribution provide advance information for marine ecosystem monitoring and management. However, interactions between physical transport and biological processes complicate chlorophyll-a forecasting, and simulating these coupled processes with conventional numerical models imposes substantial computational demands. Here we introduce ChlCast, an AI model that generates daily forecasts of surface chlorophyll-a concentration over a 10-day horizon at approximately 4-km resolution between 60$^\circ$S and 60$^\circ$N. ChlCast combines factorized spatiotemporal convolutions with a multiscale architecture to learn from historical chlorophyll-a fields and climatological information. Compared with the operational 0.25$^\circ$ Copernicus global ocean biogeochemical forecasting system, ChlCast reduces mean absolute error and root mean square error by 70.74% and 47.63%, respectively, against satellite-derived Level-4 chlorophyll-a fields, and by 35.03% and 13.07% against independent BGC-Argo in situ observations. Coastal case studies further show that the 4-km forecasts retain coastal gradients and localized concentration maxima that are weakened by coarse-grid averaging. These results demonstrate the potential of observation-driven deep learning for high-resolution forecasting of surface chlorophyll-a variability at the near-global scale.

AI.tldr: ChlCast以约4公里分辨率预测未来10天近全球表层叶绿素a，误差低于业务化全球生物地球化学系统。
AI.motivation: 物理输运与生物过程耦合使叶绿素a预测复杂，传统数值模拟计算成本高。
AI.method: 结合分解式时空卷积与多尺度架构，学习历史叶绿素a场和气候态信息，生成南北纬60度间的逐日预报。
AI.result: 相较业务系统，卫星参照下MAE和RMSE降低70.74%和47.63%，独立实测下分别降低35.03%和13.07%。
AI.conclusion: 观测驱动深度学习具有近全球高分辨率叶绿素a预报潜力，并能保留沿海梯度与局地浓度峰值。

title: RaFL: An Empirical Study of Random Filter Losses for Image Reconstruction
summary: Pixel losses train image reconstruction networks toward a point statistic of the target distribution, often averaging away fine textures under uncertainty. Perceptual losses alleviate this issue using pretrained features, but those features are inherently domain-specific. We study a random filter loss (RaFL) that compares prediction and target through filters with random weights, avoiding both pretrained features and task-specific loss engineering. RaFL combines random convolutions, random Fourier features, and random wavelet filters, automatically balancing their contributions through gradient-norm matching, eliminating manual loss-weight tuning and grid search. We systematically investigate three design choices: filter family, weight resampling schedule, and weight initialization. Based on validation PSNR and stability across random seeds, we select the configuration that uses all three filter families, redraws filters every optimization step, and employs Gaussian initialization. We evaluate RaFL on three 2D and two 3D image reconstruction tasks. RaFL outperforms a pixel loss on three tasks and matches it on two, and demonstrates stable performance across random seeds on all five tasks. RaFL adds less than 2% to the backbone's forward FLOPs and no inference cost, requiring $182\times$ fewer loss FLOPs than a VGG19 perceptual loss. These findings suggest that RaFL is a simple, tuning-free, and domain-agnostic loss objective for 2D and 3D image reconstruction.

AI.tldr: 随机滤波损失RaFL无需预训练特征或手调权重，在二维与三维重建任务中以低开销匹配或优于像素损失。
AI.motivation: 像素损失容易平均掉细纹理，而依赖预训练特征的感知损失具有领域局限性。
AI.method: 融合随机卷积、傅里叶特征与小波滤波，以梯度范数匹配平衡贡献，并每步重采样高斯初始化滤波器。
AI.result: 五项任务中三项优于、两项匹配像素损失；新增前向计算低于2%，无推理开销，损失计算量为VGG19的1/182。
AI.conclusion: RaFL在所测任务中跨随机种子表现稳定，是一种简单、免调参且不依赖领域预训练特征的重建损失。

title: QCAP-VQA: Question-Conditioned Capped Prior-Mass Supervision for Medical Visual Question Answering
summary: Medical visual question answering models can answer correctly without attending to the anatomy that the question names. Automatic region priors allow spatial supervision without expert masks, but they are noisy, and it is unclear how strongly they should shape attention and how their effect should be verified. We present QCAP-VQA, which supervises a subset of cross-attention heads with a question-conditioned prior built from ranked segmentation proposals. Its capped prior-mass objective penalizes insufficient attention inside the prior only below a threshold. We evaluate attention against SLAKE structure boxes that play no role in training, separating attention on the named anatomy from how attention shifts between questions about the same image. QCAP-VQA matches the accuracy of a baseline without spatial supervision (84.26% vs. 84.23%), and every evaluated prior-supervised model places more attention on the annotated structures. Over a 64-fold range of regularization strength, the capped objective keeps prior mass between 0.67 and 0.77, whereas a pooled region-mass objective drives it to 0.97 and loses accuracy. The cost lies in question conditioning: as the constraint widens or strengthens, attention shifts agree less with the expert-defined contrast. Across 13 configurations, prior-referenced and expert-referenced evaluation rank the models in largely opposite order (Spearman correlation of -0.87), and the capped models it favors track the prior's own errors. Because clinical use of medical visual question answering requires answers grounded in the queried anatomy, supervision from automatic priors should be judged against independent anatomical references.

AI.tldr: QCAP-VQA以封顶先验质量约束改善解剖区域注意力，但自动先验可能削弱问题条件化能力。
AI.motivation: 医学视觉问答可能答对却未关注所问解剖结构，而自动区域先验的监督强度与评估方式尚不明确。
AI.method: 用问题条件化分割先验监督部分交叉注意力头，仅在先验内注意力低于阈值时惩罚，并以独立结构框评估。
AI.result: 准确率为84.26%，接近基线84.23%；先验监督增加解剖区域注意力，但先验与专家评估排名相关性为−0.87。
AI.conclusion: 自动先验监督应以独立解剖参照检验，避免将追随先验误差误判为更可靠的问题定位。

title: Cross-Linguistic Acoustic Biomarkers of Cognitive Impairment Across Interactive and Single-Speaker Speech Tasks
summary: Multilingual dementia detection is essential for scalable and equitable screening. In recent years, automated speech analysis has emerged as a promising approach for supporting dementia detection by enabling non-invasive and scalable assessment of cognitive function. However, existing studies that use automated speech analysis often rely on one type of task, such as picture description, and use black-box models. These studies often neglect the role of task and language. To address these gaps, we performed a cross-linguistic and cross-task acoustic analysis that integrates a conversational dataset with structured speech tasks across four languages (Spanish, Mandarin, English, Japanese). We applied statistical, linguist-/clinician-guided, and machine learning model-based feature selection to derive compact acoustic feature sets while maintaining classification performance. This enabled systematic comparison of cognitive impairment-relevant features across datasets and tasks. Our results revealed that acoustic features did not generalize uniformly across tasks and languages. Temporal features remained robust across all datasets, consistently capturing timing disruption regardless of language or task. In contrast, speech rate showed strong task dependence -- emerging as informative mainly in single-speaker tasks with externally anchored content and pacing, but becoming less reliable when speech content was highly individualized. Pitch-related features further exhibited language-specific patterns, favoring chroma-related features in tonal languages (e.g., Mandarin) and F0-related features in non-tonal languages. These findings caution against indiscriminate pooling of heterogeneous speech data and underscore the need for interpretable, context-aware approaches to multilingual dementia detection using automated speech analysis.
comment: 7 pages, 1 figure, 5 tables. Accepted for publication in Proc. 48th Annual International Conference of the IEEE Engineering in Medicine and Biology Society (EMBC 2026)

AI.tldr: 跨四种语言及多类语音任务的分析显示，认知障碍声学标志物的适用性受到任务与语言影响。
AI.motivation: 现有自动语音痴呆检测多依赖单一任务和黑箱模型，忽视语言及任务差异。
AI.method: 整合西班牙语、普通话、英语和日语的对话及结构化任务，以统计、专家指导和机器学习筛选声学特征。
AI.result: 时序特征跨数据集稳健，语速主要适用于内容与节奏有外部锚定的独白任务，音高相关特征呈语言差异。
AI.conclusion: 多语言痴呆检测应采用可解释且考虑语境的方法，避免不加区分地混合异质语音数据。

title: A Tumour-Aware Multimodal Framework for Explainable Prediction of IDH Mutation in Gliomas from Multi-Sequence MRI
summary: Accurate prediction of isocitrate dehydrogenase (IDH) mutation status is essential for glioma diagnosis, prognosis, and treatment planning. Although recent deep learning approaches have demonstrated promising performance, many rely on whole-brain feature extraction and provide limited interpretability. This study proposes a tumour-aware multimodal framework for explainable, non-invasive prediction of IDH mutation status from multiparametric magnetic resonance imaging (MRI). The proposed framework integrates four MRI sequences (T1, T1CE, T2, and FLAIR), tumour subregion segmentation, quantitative radiomic descriptors, and clinical information within a unified deep learning architecture. An ablation study was conducted to evaluate the contribution of tumour-aware learning, radiomic features, and clinical variables. Model performance was assessed using multiple complementary evaluation metrics, including accuracy, precision, recall, F1-score, balanced accuracy, receiver operating characteristic analysis, confusion matrix evaluation, and Grad-CAM visualisation. Experimental results demonstrated that the proposed multimodal framework consistently outperformed the baseline MRI-only model, with the Clinical Fusion model achieving the strongest overall predictive performance. The integration of tumour-aware learning, radiomic descriptors, and clinical information progressively improved classification performance, while Grad-CAM visualisations indicated that the model predominantly focused on biologically relevant tumour regions. These findings suggest that tumour-aware multimodal feature integration enables accurate, interpretable, and non-invasive molecular profiling of gliomas and provides a promising foundation for future clinical decision support in precision neuro-oncology.
comment: 45 pages, 12 figures, 4 tables. Preprint of an article submitted for consideration in International Journal of Information Technology & Decision Making (World Scientific)

AI.tldr: 肿瘤感知多模态框架融合多序列MRI、影像组学和临床信息，实现可解释的胶质瘤IDH突变预测。
AI.motivation: IDH状态对胶质瘤诊疗重要，但现有深度学习方法常依赖全脑特征且可解释性有限。
AI.method: 统一融合四种MRI序列、肿瘤亚区分割、定量影像组学与临床信息，并通过消融实验及Grad-CAM评估。
AI.result: 多模态框架持续优于仅MRI基线，临床融合模型总体表现最佳，Grad-CAM显示其主要关注生物学相关肿瘤区域。
AI.conclusion: 肿瘤感知的多模态融合有望支持准确、可解释且无创的胶质瘤分子分型与临床决策。

title: Ego2Flow: Benchmarking the Traffic-System Impact of Autonomous Driving on Maps Distilled from Real-World Roads
summary: End-to-end autonomous driving is predominantly evaluated through ego-vehicle safety and task completion. Its deployment in urban traffic, however, creates sustained interactions among vehicles whose collective effects remain insufficiently evaluated. We introduce Ego2Flow, a closed-loop benchmark for assessing the traffic-system impact of autonomous driving on maps distilled from real-world cities. To construct realistic 3D urban environments for sustained closed-loop traffic simulation, we develop an agent-guided map distillation framework that integrates real-world maps and observations with complementary geographic information. Through an iterative feedback mechanism and a traffic information graph that jointly guide scene generation, the framework preserves lane topology, critical road geometry and decision-relevant visual conditions while simplifying nonessential details and completing unobserved regions. Using our proposed framework, we generate and publicly release six CARLA maps from the Argoverse 2 dataset, covering the corresponding real-world regions and enabling paired comparisons of driving behavior under real and simulated observations. On these maps, Ego2Flow evaluates how autonomous driving policies affect traffic efficiency, safety, stability and energy consumption across diverse road structures. Compared with existing construction methods, our framework achieves the lowest average displacement error between planning outputs from paired real and simulated observations. We further benchmark representative driving policies to characterize their system-level impact on urban traffic. Project Page: this https URL.

AI.tldr: Ego2Flow利用真实道路蒸馏地图，闭环评估自动驾驶对城市交通系统的影响。
AI.motivation: 现有端到端自动驾驶评估侧重自车安全与任务完成，缺乏对持续车辆交互及集体影响的评估。
AI.method: 以智能体引导、迭代反馈和交通信息图蒸馏真实地图，构建CARLA环境并评估效率、安全、稳定性与能耗。
AI.result: 公开了源自Argoverse 2的六张CARLA地图，配对真实与模拟观测的规划输出平均位移误差低于现有构建方法。
AI.conclusion: 该基准支持在真实道路对应的模拟环境中比较驾驶策略，并分析其交通系统级影响。

title: Federated Soft Poly-Level Learning Over a Distributed Network with Guaranteed Convergence
summary: Multi-level learning/optimization, e.g., bilevel optimization, has been recognized for its versatile applicability across a broad array of domains, spanning from signal processing to machine learning. However, most existing works focus on bilevel and trilevel optimization. In contrast, multi-level optimization problems involving four or more hierarchical levels, which we term poly-level learning (PLL) problems, remain largely this http URL addition, in practical PLL, data may be distributed across multiple nodes over a distributed network. Nevertheless, extant studies on PLL predominantly focus on the non-federated setting, necessitating the collection of data to central servers and thereby posing potential privacy risks. To this end, we propose a Federated Poly-Level Learning (FPLL) framework over a distributed network to tackle the PLL problems with soft constraints in a federated manner. FPLL hinges on a novel non-linear cut, i.e., $L$-cut, for the level-wise relaxation to the PLL problems. Additionally, the proposed federated algorithm is designed with adjustable parameters that allow for a flexible trade-off between its computational complexity and performance efficiency, enabling users to tune it according to specific application requirements. We also carry out non-asymptotic analysis to derive the iteration complexity for the proposed FPLL to achieve the $\epsilon$-Pareto stationary point. Extensive experiments have been undertaken to elucidate the superior efficacy of the proposed method.
comment: Accepted at IEEE Transactions on Networking

AI.tldr: FPLL以非线性逐层松弛实现分布式联邦多层级学习，并提供收敛复杂度保证。
AI.motivation: 四层及以上优化研究不足，现有方法多集中收集数据，难以适应分布式场景并存在隐私风险。
AI.method: 提出基于非线性L-cut逐层松弛的软约束联邦框架，以可调参数权衡计算复杂度与性能效率。
AI.result: 推导了达到ε-Pareto驻点的非渐近迭代复杂度，实验显示方法有效性优于比较方法。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为分布式网络中的软约束多层级优化提供了具有理论保证的联邦求解途径。

title: A Spectral Framework for Universal Proxy Regularization in Model Merging
summary: Model merging constructs multi-task models without expensive joint training but often suffers from parameter interference. Some solutions mitigate this by constraining finetuning using data from the other tasks to be merged, violating the core independence and privacy assumption of model merging. Recent work offers preliminary empirical evidence that a universal, task-agnostic proxy distribution can substitute for such data, but leaves open when and why it suffices. To this end, we propose a \textit{Spectral Framework for Universal Proxy Regularization}, which characterizes the relationship between a proxy distribution and the distribution of other tasks to be merged through spectral coverage ($\alpha$) and leakage ($\beta$). Based on the framework, we derive a unified parameter interference bound: smaller $(\alpha, \beta)$ provably yields lower parameter interference through better spectral alignment. To exploit such a proxy, we augment the training objective with a proxy regularizer. Evaluating this regularizer during fine-tuning requires a concrete mechanism. We study three instantiations, including (J) an exact evaluation via Jacobian-vector products, (F) a frozen curvature approximation using the Fisher information matrix, and (O) an output-drift formulation that constrains the model's functional deviation on the proxy directly. We prove that all three coincide under the NTK linearization, where existing analyses of such regularizers stop, and go further to characterize standard non-linear fine-tuning, bounding how far each instantiation departs from its linearized reference and obtain a three-way hierarchy, zero for (J), proxy-independent for (F), and proxy-quality-scaling for (O). Empirical validation on the commonly used vision-language model CLIP confirms these theoretical predictions.

AI.tldr: 谱框架解释通用代理数据如何降低模型合并中的参数干扰，并刻画三类代理正则化的差异。
AI.motivation: 使用其他任务数据约束微调违背模型合并的独立性与隐私假设，而通用代理何时有效尚缺理论解释。
AI.method: 以谱覆盖和泄漏刻画代理质量，推导干扰界，并分析雅可比向量积、冻结Fisher曲率和输出漂移三种实现。
AI.result: 三种实现在NTK线性化下等价，非线性偏离界呈不同层级，CLIP实验验证了理论预测。
AI.conclusion: 代理的谱对齐质量决定干扰控制效果，该框架为无需其他任务数据的合并正则化提供理论依据。

title: ERA: Error-Resistant Autonomous Object Navigation with Predicted Depth
summary: Depth and 3D foundation models can predict geometry from RGB images, allowing zero-shot object navigation without a depth sensor. However, when predicted depth is mapped as if it came from a sensor, view-dependent errors accumulate in the map, remove exploration goals, and end the search before the agent can observe and correct them. We propose ERA, a training-free object navigation system that replaces the depth sensor with depth predicted from RGB images and poses. ERA follows a paradigm we call Move with Error: movement provides new views that correct map errors, and the corrected map enables further movement. It realizes this paradigm with revisable occupancy and with exploration from reachable viewpoints, which continues the search when no frontier remains, and verifies the target across views before stopping. On three benchmarks, ERA achieves state-of-the-art performance among training-free methods without depth sensors. Its map and exploration components also raise VLFM's success from 10.8% to 61.7% under the same predicted depth. We further deploy ERA on a real robot.

AI.tldr: ERA通过可修订地图与持续探索，缓解预测深度误差导致的无深度传感器目标导航失败。
AI.motivation: 将预测深度当作传感器测量建图会积累视角相关误差，消除探索目标并过早终止搜索。
AI.method: 采用免训练导航系统，以RGB和位姿预测深度，通过可修订占据地图、可达视点探索及跨视角目标验证纠错。
AI.result: 在三个基准上达到无深度传感器免训练方法的最优表现，并使同等预测深度下VLFM成功率由10.8%升至61.7%。
AI.conclusion: 运动获取的新视角可纠正地图并维持探索，ERA还完成了真实机器人部署。

title: HarmonyText: Harmonious Scene Text Editing via Reverse-to-Refined Pair Synthesis and Region-Decoupled Frequency Learning
summary: Natural language-guided, mask-free scene text editing aims to modify text in real-world images using only textual instructions, yet remains challenged by unreliable pseudo-GT supervision, over-smoothed text generation, and the absence of GT-free evaluation. Existing methods often rely on imperfect pseudo-targets with background discrepancies, while standard MSE-based velocity regression tends to suppress high-frequency details, leading to blurred text boundaries and weakened local textures. To address these issues, we propose HarmonyText, a mask-free scene text editing framework with region- and frequency-aware supervision. HarmonyText introduces Region-Decoupling Optimization (RDO), which aligns edited text regions with pseudo-targets while anchoring preserved regions to the source image, and Cascaded High-Frequency Texture Guidance (CHFTG), which applies cascaded wavelet-domain constraints to preserve sharp boundaries and fine-grained textures of textual content. We further propose Reverse-to-Refined Pair Synthesis (RePair) to construct STE25K, a high-quality 25K paired dataset, and introduce a GT-free evaluation protocol with Color Distribution Divergence and a Harmony Assessment Model. Extensive experiments show that HarmonyText outperforms existing methods in text editing accuracy, background fidelity, color consistency, and perceptual harmony.
comment: 11 pages, 7 figures. Accepted to SIGGRAPH Asia 2026 Conference Papers

AI.tldr: HarmonyText结合区域解耦与高频监督，提升自然语言引导的无掩码场景文字编辑质量。
AI.motivation: 现有方法受伪目标背景误差、均方误差回归导致的文字模糊，以及缺少无真值评估的限制。
AI.method: 结合区域解耦优化与级联小波高频约束，以反向到精修配对合成构建STE25K，并提出无真值评估协议。
AI.result: 实验显示，该方法在文字编辑准确性、背景保真度、颜色一致性和感知和谐度上优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: 区域与频率感知监督结合高质量配对数据，可提升无掩码场景文字编辑的清晰度与整体协调性。

title: Logically Consistent Accurate Forecasts
summary: Agentic forecasting systems based on large language models (LLMs) are now competitive with expert human forecasters, but these systems still suffer from a critical limitation: the inability to produce forecasts that are logically consistent. For example, forecasts for related events often fail to satisfy the axioms of probability, which in turn implies that related forecasts cannot simultaneously be correct and undermines their utility for decision makers. Enforcing consistency is not trivial -- naive approaches (e.g., projection onto the set of consistent forecasts) can degrade accuracy. We argue that the key to overcoming the apparent tradeoff between consistency and accuracy lies in the reasoning which supports each forecast. We finetune a supervisory language model that leverages this reasoning to jointly reconcile inconsistencies while improving the accuracy of related forecasts. On ForecastBench, our method improves the Brier score of a retrieval-augmented GPT-5.1 forecaster by 9.3% while reducing measures of structural inconsistency by 82-90%. We interrogate our method via a comprehensive series of baselines and ablations, and find that no alternative method matches our gains in consistency and accuracy simultaneously.
comment: NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Foundation Models for Temporal Systems (FMTS)

AI.tldr: 利用预测推理微调监督语言模型，可同时提升事件预测的逻辑一致性与准确性。
AI.motivation: 语言模型预测常违反概率公理，而简单强制一致性可能损害准确性。
AI.method: 微调监督语言模型，利用各预测的推理过程联合协调相关预测中的不一致。
AI.result: 在ForecastBench上，Brier分数改善9.3%，结构不一致性指标降低82%至90%。
AI.conclusion: 预测推理有助于兼顾一致性与准确性，所测替代方法均未同时达到其提升幅度。

title: State-of-Charge Targets for Storage Participation in Two-Settlement Markets: Reliability, Price, and Compensation Impacts
summary: As energy storage assumes a larger role in electricity systems, market operation must coordinate its use across time to support reliability during periods of system stress.
