Minimum state-of-charge (SOC) targets provide a means of preserving energy for these periods, but their design shapes reliability, operating efficiency, and storage compensation. This paper evaluates alternative SOC target designs in a California-based day-ahead and real-time electricity market model. The comparison examines targets based on day-ahead schedules or rolling centralized dispatch, enforced at the individual-resource or system level, across seasons, stress conditions, and participant information settings. The results show that retaining more energy does not necessarily reduce load shedding: targets that restrict discharge can limit storage support during shortages. Under critical summer conditions, individual targets derived from rolling centralized dispatch reduce weekly load shedding by approximately 83--84\% relative to operation without targets. Lower RT clearing costs and average prices can coexist with higher storage compensation, reflecting the role of day-ahead positions and real-time deviations in determining settlement outcomes. These findings highlight the importance of coordinating energy retention with timely discharge and network deliverability when designing SOC requirements for storage participation in electricity markets.

AI.tldr: 储能最低荷电状态目标需兼顾能量保留与及时放电，才能改善电力市场可靠性。
AI.motivation: 储能参与电力市场日益增加，荷电状态目标会影响供电可靠性、运行效率及储能补偿。
AI.method: 在加州背景的日前与实时市场模型中，比较不同目标来源、执行层级及运行条件。
AI.result: 夏季关键条件下，滚动集中调度生成的单体目标使每周负荷削减量较无目标时降低约83%至84%。
AI.conclusion: 更多能量保留未必减少负荷削减，目标设计还需协调放电时机、网络可输送性与结算影响。

title: X-Strata: Separating Aneurysms and Overlapping Vessels into Layers from 2D X-ray Angiography
summary: An X-ray angiogram sums every structure along a ray into one pixel. When vessels cross an aneurysm, they obscure part of it and mix their contrast into its filling curve. We present X-Strata, a network that separates a cine angiogram into three layers: the complete aneurysm sac, the vessels in front of it, and the vessels behind it. Contrast timing indicates how much each layer contributes to a pixel, and parallax between two views indicates their order, which a single view cannot determine. X-Strata first estimates the layers and their contrast curves, then uses the second view to assign vessels to the front or back layer, and lifts all layers into 3D. It learns from layer labels projected from same-session 3D rotational angiography, but needs only 2D cine runs and their acquisition geometry at inference. On 220 held-out patients from three centers (122 external), two-view X-Strata ranks first among 14 baselines, including VGGT and C$^2$RV, in recovering the sac where vessels overlap it (Dice 0.693 internal, 0.641 external) and in ordering the layers (balanced accuracy 0.703, 0.659). Its order accuracy exceeds that of all 11 end-to-end baselines by at least 4.1 points internally and 3.3 externally (Holm-adjusted $p < 0.001$) and grows with view separation. Recovered 3D sac surfaces have a median Chamfer distance of 0.34 mm on the internal cohort. X-Strata may therefore provide layered aneurysm and vessel information, including 3D sac shape, for patients who undergo only 2D angiography.
comment: 22 pages, including 10 pages of supplementary material

AI.tldr: X-Strata将二维血管造影分解为动脉瘤、前方血管与后方血管，并重建三维瘤体。
AI.motivation: 血管与动脉瘤投影重叠会遮挡瘤体、混合造影剂曲线，且单视图无法确定前后次序。
AI.method: 利用造影剂时序估计图层，以双视图视差确定前后关系，并用同期三维造影投影标签训练。

AI.conclusion: 该方法有望为仅接受二维造影的患者提供分层血管信息及三维动脉瘤形状。

title: The Polyak-Łojasiewicz Paper: A 10-Year Retrospective
summary: In 2016, we wrote a paper introducing the phrase "Polyak-Lojasiewicz (PL) condition" for an old idea, unsure of how readers would react. The paper ultimately had a larger impact than we expected, and we are surprised and honoured to receive the 2026 PKDD ECML Test of Time Award. With 10 years of hindsight, this note offers an informal and candid retrospective on the PL condition. We take a look back at the origins of the paper, give an AI-assisted refined version of the main theorem, review criticisms of the work, and discuss a variety of related ideas and extensions.
comment: 20 pages, 6 figures

AI.tldr: 本文回顾PL条件论文发表十年来的起源、影响、争议与相关扩展。
AI.motivation: 原论文获2026年PKDD ECML时间检验奖，促使作者重新审视其影响及局限。
AI.method: 以非正式回顾梳理论文起源，给出AI辅助精炼的主定理，并讨论批评和相关思想。
AI.result: 摘要未提供具体结果。
AI.conclusion: 本文从十年后的视角重新审视PL条件及其相关思想与扩展。

title: Complex Schrödinger Bridges
summary: Diffusion bridges have emerged as versatile frameworks for facilitating transformations between arbitrary data distributions. However, these approaches are hindered by an immense optimization space and its underlying high-order structures. This paper explores a variant of diffusion bridges for solving real-world problems in complex vector spaces governed by scaling and rotation laws, such as Hamiltonian structures. To address this, we introduce conformal optimal transport (COT), a complex-valued transportation framework designed for physical systems with geometric and dissipative dynamics under a geometric lifting. Building on this, we propose a new class of dynamical diffusion bridges, called complex Schrödinger bridges (CSBs), whose derived algorithms can handle diffusion-based tasks using a conformal geometric prior. For scalability, we propose image-to-image CSB (I$^2$CSB), a tractable diffusion-bridge technique with an analytic spiral posterior. Finally, we implement a physics-informed CSB algorithm within simulations of quantum electrodynamics, mimicking the logical behavior of quantum logic gates. Our extensive results validate the underlying theory while highlighting advantages of complex-valued diffusion.
comment: NeurIPS 2026

AI.tldr: 提出复数薛定谔桥，将共形几何先验引入复向量空间中的扩散分布变换。
AI.motivation: 扩散桥面临庞大优化空间及高阶结构，需更好适配具有缩放和旋转规律的物理系统。

title: When Does Cross-View Consistency Matter in Multi-View Appearance Augmentation? A Controlled Study for Visuomotor Policies
summary: Multi-view visual augmentation often seeks consistency across cameras, but it is unclear which forms of consistency matter for downstream control. We use simulation-state replay to manipulate cross-view coupling while preserving the per-camera perturbation distributions, physical trajectories, and action labels. Across seven LIBERO manipulation tasks, marginal-matched changes in global appearance, ghost injection, and target color have small average costs for a late-fusion Diffusion Policy: point estimates are near zero or negative, and the largest upper endpoint of the 90% posterior credible intervals is 2.55 percentage points. In contrast, geometrically anti-coupled observations reduce success by 3.30 percentage points relative to coupled observations (90% CrI [0.64, 6.28]), with displacement magnitude, direction marginals, and the number of affected views matched. Camera interventions reveal substantial dependence on wrist-view geometry, while feature analysis shows appearance sensitivity patterns associated with the factors randomized during training. ACT shows a higher target-color cost estimate than DP, with uncertainty that includes zero and sensitivity to task composition. Within the tested tasks and policy configurations, these findings motivate selective consistency constraints: appearance coupling can sometimes be relaxed, whereas task-relevant geometry and cross-view spatial correspondence warrant protection.
comment: 30 pages, 10 figures. Code: this https URL

AI.tldr: 受控实验表明，多视图控制策略对外观耦合较宽容，但对任务相关几何一致性更敏感。
AI.motivation: 多视图增强通常追求相机间一致性，但哪些一致性真正影响下游控制尚不明确。
AI.method: 利用仿真状态回放，在保持单相机扰动分布、轨迹和动作标签不变时操纵跨视图耦合。

title: Stage-wise Lineage-aware Dropout for Sparse-View 3D Gaussian Splatting
summary: Sparse-view 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) is prone to overfitting because only a limited number of images are available to constrain scene geometry. Dropout is one regularization strategy for alleviating this problem. We introduce the concept of a lineage family to describe a set of Gaussian primitives derived from the same founder through cloning or splitting operations. The founder Gaussians refer to all Gaussian primitives generated during initialization. Descendants within the same family often jointly contribute to the refinement of adjacent local regions. However, dropping individual Gaussians can be less effective due to the compensation effect from neighboring Gaussians for the dropped ones. To address this issue, we propose Stage-wise Lineage-aware Dropout(SLD), which applies lineage-family dropout during the structural regularization stage and switches to individual dropout during the later refinement stage. We further propose Lineage-Balanced Densification(LBD), which operates during densification by constructing an expanded candidate pool and reallocating the densification budget according to the mean gradient scores and existing descendant sizes of different families. Experiments on the LLFF, MipNeRF360, and Blender datasets show that the proposed framework achieves competitive performance in sparse-view reconstruction

AI.tldr: 通过分阶段谱系感知丢弃与谱系均衡增密，缓解稀疏视图三维高斯泼溅的过拟合。
AI.motivation: 稀疏图像难以充分约束场景几何，且相邻高斯的补偿效应会削弱单体丢弃的正则化效果。
AI.method: 结构阶段按同源谱系家族丢弃、细化阶段改为单体丢弃，并按家族梯度及后代规模分配增密预算。
AI.result: 在LLFF、MipNeRF360与Blender数据集上取得有竞争力的稀疏视图重建表现。

title: Superfluid: Local AI Server for Distributed LLM Inference
summary: Running large language models (LLMs) on local devices keeps data private, removes per-token cost, cuts network latency, and keeps working without a connection. Two shifts now strain how such models are served. On one device, several agents share a locally served model with an interactive user. Across devices, a developer or small team often owns several capable machines from different vendors, which sit idle most of the day because every local server serves one runtime on one machine. We present Superfluid, an open-source LLM server built for local inference at both scales. On one device, Superfluid drives this http URL, MLX, or BaseRT in isolated worker processes through one scheduler that moves interactive requests ahead of agent work, computes a prompt shared by many requests once, and writes every token to a durable log before it reaches the client. Across devices, one Superfluid server turns a fleet of machines into a single API endpoint. Machines with different hardware serve copies of the same model, receive work according to their measured speed, and can join or fail under load without losing a request. For Qwen3.8-27B on an Apple M5 Pro, a chat sent while eight agents are working receives its first token in 1.5 s, against 291-612 s on llama-server, Ollama, and this http URL. On six machines from three chip vendors serving 64 simulated users for one hour, Superfluid answers all 5,041 requests while machines join one at a time and one is killed and rejoins; throughput grows from 112 to 534 tok/s and the median first-token time falls from 99 to 12 s. On twelve Mac Studio M3 Ultras it sustains 10,656 tok/s across 38,563 requests from 384 agents without a failure. Superfluid is available under the Apache-2.0 licence at this https URL.

AI.tldr: Superfluid以统一调度和跨设备协作支持本地多智能体与交互式大模型推理。
AI.motivation: 本地推理需同时服务用户与多个智能体，而单机单运行时架构难以利用异构闲置设备。
AI.method: 采用交互优先调度、共享提示计算和持久化令牌日志，并按实测速率向异构设备分配请求。
AI.result: 八智能体并发时聊天首令牌仅需1.5秒；六机动态测试完成全部5041请求，吞吐达534令牌每秒。
AI.conclusion: 该开源服务器在所测场景中兼顾交互响应、异构扩展与故障恢复，支持可靠的分布式本地推理。

title: VACO: Vertex-Aligned Decoding for Dense Hand Contact Estimation from a Single Image
summary: Dense hand contact estimation from a single RGB image is a foundational primitive for dexterous manipulation and 3D interaction analysis. Direct predictors typically decode the entire per-vertex contact map from one shared query, leaving individual vertices ungrounded in the image and smearing contact across adjacent, non-touching surfaces. We present VACO, a vertex-aligned decoder in which each MANO vertex samples local image features at its projected location. A hand-reconstruction backbone, jointly trained for reconstruction and contact, predicts these locations at inference without an auxiliary reconstructor. Training uses noise-perturbed ground-truth projections and end-to-end feature adaptation to improve robustness and contact-sensitive features. A single VACO checkpoint sets a new state of the art on five benchmarks spanning hand-object, hand-human, hand-scene, and bimanual interactions. It improves F1 by +20.7 pp over the strongest prior direct predictor on Hi4D and generalizes to the held-out HOT3D and HOCap, with gains of +5.5 and +2.7 pp. The resulting contact predictions also improve downstream HOI reconstruction.

AI.tldr: VACO通过顶点对齐解码提升单张图像的稠密手部接触估计，并改善下游手物交互重建。
AI.motivation: 共享查询预测整张接触图缺乏逐顶点图像定位，容易将接触扩散到相邻非接触表面。
AI.method: 各MANO顶点在投影位置采样局部特征，联合训练重建与接触预测，并用扰动投影增强鲁棒性。
AI.result: 五个基准均达最佳水平，Hi4D的F1提升20.7个百分点，未见数据集HOT3D和HOCap分别提升5.5和2.7个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 顶点对齐的局部图像特征有助于提高接触估计精度、跨数据集泛化能力及下游重建质量。

title: Graph Neural Network Prediction of Frequency Nadir and RoCoF Under Topology Variations
summary: Accurate prediction of frequency dynamics under varying network topologies is essential for rapid frequency security assessment, whereas repeated electromagnetic transient (EMT) simulations are computationally intensive. This paper develops a topology-aware graph neural network with a radial basis function Kolmogorov-Arnold network (RBF-KAN) regression head, termed RK-GNN, to predict frequency nadir and maximum absolute rate of change of frequency (RoCoF). Scenarios combine load scaling, regional load redistribution, and generator redispatch with intact, N-1, and N-2 transmission topologies. After checks for network connectivity, generator reference limits, and numerical consistency, the retained scenarios are simulated in PSCAD to construct the reference dataset. The RK-GNN is evaluated against a conventional deep neural network (DNN) and a baseline GNN. On the IEEE 39-bus system, the RK-GNN reduces the mean absolute errors (MAEs) of nadir and RoCoF by 48% and 59% relative to the DNN and by 42% and 61% relative to the baseline GNN. Incorporating the bridge indicator and disturbance hop distance yields further MAE reductions of 27% and 54%. These results show that the proposed topology-aware architecture provides accurate prediction of both frequency metrics under varying topologies and substantially reduces the need for repeated EMT simulations.

AI.tldr: RK-GNN利用电网拓扑信息准确预测频率最低点和最大绝对频率变化率，减少重复电磁暂态仿真需求。
AI.motivation: 拓扑变化下的快速频率安全评估需要准确预测频率动态，而重复电磁暂态仿真计算成本高。
AI.method: 构建带RBF-KAN回归头的拓扑感知图神经网络，利用PSCAD生成含负荷、调度及拓扑变化的数据。
AI.result: IEEE 39节点系统中，两项指标误差较DNN降低48%和59%，较基线GNN降低42%和61%。
AI.conclusion: 拓扑感知架构可提高频率指标预测精度，加入桥边标记和扰动跳数距离还能进一步降低误差。

title: Efficient Genotype Classification from 3D MRI in ADPKD via Density-Aware Point Sampling and E(3)-invariance
summary: Early detection of genetic kidney diseases, especially autosomal dominant polycystic kidney disease (ADPKD), is crucial because certain genotypes such as truncating PKD1 mutations cause rapid kidney growth and early progression to end-stage kidney disease. MRI-based genotype inference is a potential low-cost complement to genetic testing. However, although many deep learning methods have been developed for classifying various MR images, applying them to ADPKD remains challenging: (1) abdominal MR images are generally too large to be handled by deep learning models designed for smaller images like brain MRI, and (2) the amount of labeled data for ADPKD genetic mutations is insufficient to train deep learning models. In order to address these challenges, we propose E3PN, an efficient 3D MRI-based ADPKD genotype classification network that relies on point sampling and E(3)-invariance. We utilize a point representation of 3D MRI, which consumes less GPU memory than a voxel representation. For further memory efficiency, 3D points are sampled from a mixture distribution over the two kidneys in each image. Since E(3)-invariance has been shown to improve data efficiency, we also incorporate it into our model through coordinate canonicalization. On our ADPKD dataset, E3PN trains 163 times faster and uses 103x less GPU memory than a 3D ResNet, while also improving F1 from 0.165 to 0.226 over both baselines. These results establish a first benchmark for five-way ADPKD genotype classification from 3D MRI and show that point sampling and coordinate canonicalization yield two-orders-of-magnitude efficiency gains with a modest but consistent improvement in F1.

AI.tldr: E3PN以点采样和E(3)不变性实现高效的三维MRI多囊肾基因型分类。
AI.motivation: 腹部MRI体积大且基因突变标注稀缺，限制了深度学习在常染色体显性多囊肾病分型中的应用。
AI.method: 将MRI表示为点集，从双肾混合分布采样，并通过坐标规范化引入E(3)不变性。
AI.result: 相较3D ResNet，训练速度达163倍、显存用量降至约1/103，F1较两项基线由0.165升至0.226。
AI.conclusion: 该研究建立三维MRI五分类基因型基准，以约两个数量级的效率收益获得小幅且一致的F1改善。

title: Inferring Sensitive Events in Multi-Mode Cyber-Physical Systems via Scheduling Side Channels
summary: Many cyber-physical systems (CPS) are multi-mode: they switch between operating modes with different tasksets and timing parameters in response to physical events or user activity. We show that these mode changes create a timing side channel: by altering the interference experienced by co-running tasks, they let an unprivileged co-resident observer infer sensitive events, such as a homeowner's arrival or a vehicle's route, from its own execution timing and, on multicore platforms, its core assignment. Existing schedule-based attacks and defenses miss this channel because they assume single-mode systems or target a specific, known victim task. We present STAMP, a lightweight attack that needs no knowledge of task parameters or scheduling policy, and works whether or not the system exposes its modes. On a ZoneMinder home-security deployment, STAMP identifies the modes with 94.7% accuracy on unseen hardware, using under 0.5% of one core. On ROS 2 AMCL with the Oxford RobotCar dataset, it identifies which of seven route segments a vehicle traversed with 86.0% accuracy on unseen platforms. A schedule-randomization defense lowers detection recall to 0.53, at which setting only 53.9% as many jobs finish on time. At higher noise ($\epsilon=10$), on-time job completion reduces to 14.4%, while introducing new leakage in 14.1% of the tasksets.

AI.tldr: STAMP揭示多模式信息物理系统的调度侧信道，可由低权限共驻任务推断敏感事件。
AI.motivation: 现有调度攻击与防御多假设单一模式或已知受害任务，忽略模式切换造成的时序泄漏。
AI.method: STAMP无需任务参数或调度策略知识，仅利用自身执行时序及多核平台上的核心分配推断模式。
AI.result: 未见硬件上家庭安防模式识别准确率为94.7%，未见平台上七类车辆路段识别准确率为86.0%。
AI.conclusion: 模式切换可泄漏敏感活动，而调度随机化虽降低检测召回率，却显著损害任务按时完成率并可能引入新泄漏。

title: Creative Product Design under Brand Image Constraints
summary: Industrial design requires creative visual exploration while satisfying constraints that are often product-specific and implicit. Existing text-to-image (T2I) approaches can generate creative designs through concept blending or multi-agent self-enhancement, but they provide limited mechanisms for ensuring that generated designs remain consistent with such constraints. We focus on brand image as a representative design constraint and propose a framework for brand-aware redesign generation. Given a product name, the framework constructs a brand image survey report that summarizes product and market information, derives a creative direction from the report, and integrates this direction into a self-enhancement loop in which generated images are critiqued and prompts are revised. We evaluate the framework on 50 redesign tasks across five product categories, comparing it with Naive T2I, IP-Adapter/IT-Blender, and unconstrained self-enhancement under the same T2I backbone. By a VLM-as-Judge protocol to measure creativity and brand identifiability, the proposed framework achieves a more favorable trade-off between the two objectives, with particularly clear gains in highly constrained categories such as automotive and motorcycle, where the plausible design space is relatively limited compared with that of other product categories. These results suggest that dynamically eliciting and textualizing brand image can guide creative product design generation under brand image constraints.

AI.tldr: 品牌感知再设计框架通过品牌调研与迭代评议，在产品创意和品牌可辨识性之间取得更好平衡。
AI.motivation: 现有文生图创意设计方法难以确保生成结果符合产品特有且隐含的品牌形象约束。
AI.method: 依据产品名称生成品牌形象调研报告，提炼创意方向，再循环评议图像并修订提示词。
AI.result: 在五类产品的50项任务中，视觉语言模型评审显示该框架权衡更优，汽车和摩托车等强约束类别收益尤为明显。
AI.conclusion: 动态提取并文本化品牌形象，可为品牌约束下的创意产品设计提供有效引导。

title: Knowledge After Collapse: Context and Wording Shape Factual Accessibility in Language Models
summary: When a language model accepts a false correction in a factual discussion, its next answer can depend on how the conversation continues. We introduce Knowledge Answer Divergence (KAD), an event-conditioned evaluation protocol that distinguishes initial false-answer adoption from subsequent persistence, recovery, and abstention. KAD freezes the conversation at the first explicit adoption of a designated false target and branches independent probes from that exact history. This enables matched comparisons of post-adoption behavior and history-management interventions that a single susceptibility score cannot capture. We evaluate eight local checkpoint conditions and six hosted endpoints, alongside an audited 300-question rerun. In corrected Llama 3.2 Instruct 3B controls, a neutral-history branch yields 42/46 correct responses, compared with 16/46 under full history. A matched cue-placement control changes false adoption by 27.3 percentage points in Qwen 3.5 4B. Twelve independently authored pressure templates demonstrate substantial sensitivity to wording. Together, these findings demonstrate the utility of KAD for evaluating factual reliability beyond initial susceptibility, enabling systematic comparisons of false-answer persistence, recovery conditions and conversational interventions.

AI.tldr: KAD评估协议揭示，语言模型接受错误纠正后，事实回答能否恢复显著受上下文和措辞影响。
AI.motivation: 单一错误采纳率无法区分模型接受错误后的持续错误、恢复正确和弃答行为。
AI.method: 在首次明确采纳指定错误时冻结对话，从相同历史分支探测，匹配比较后续行为及历史管理干预。
AI.result: Llama对照中中性历史分支答对42/46，完整历史仅16/46；Qwen的线索位置变化使错误采纳率相差27.3个百分点。
AI.conclusion: KAD可超越初始易受影响程度，系统评估错误持续性、事实恢复条件和对话干预效果。

title: GDP.xlsx: Benchmarking Frontier Models on Professional Workbooks
summary: We introduce GDP_xlsx, a benchmark of 70 realistic workplace requests written by professionals in 13 domains, each paired with an expert rubric of binary criteria and with the complete workbook or CSV file it refers to. Together the files hold 2.18 million populated cells, and the rubrics 791 criteria. Agents work in a container with spreadsheet tools, and an agentic judge that can open the file applies the rubric. Completeness and exclusivity criteria require set-valued answers to be found in full and with nothing extra. We rank models by strict pass@1, the share of attempts that meet every criterion. Across 20 model configurations, including frontier models from Google, Anthropic, and OpenAI, the top-scoring one, Gemini 4 Argon, passes only 38.3% of attempts, and the median score is 19.3%, leaving wide headroom. We release the evaluation harness and three public tasks; the other 67 are held out to protect the leaderboard from contamination.

AI.tldr: GDP_xlsx以真实专业工作簿任务评测前沿模型，显示其完整准确处理电子表格的能力仍有较大提升空间。
AI.motivation: 专业电子表格任务需要完整且无冗余地满足实际工作要求，因此需要严格的真实任务评测。
AI.method: 收集13个领域的70项请求及完整文件，以791项二元标准和可读取文件的智能体评审计算严格pass@1。
AI.result: 20种模型配置中，最高分Gemini 4 Argon的严格通过率仅38.3%，中位数为19.3%。
AI.conclusion: 前沿模型在专业工作簿任务上仍存在明显不足，研究公开评测框架及3项任务，其余67项保留以防污染。

title: Learning Anisotropic Prediction Targets for Flow Models
summary: Flow-based generative models are trained on a hand-chosen prediction target, such as the velocity, the noise, or the clean data. This choice strongly affects training and sample quality. We introduce Anisotropic Flow Models (AnisoFlow), which replaces a fixed prediction target with a fully learnable one. AnisoFlow learns to scale the noise component of the target anisotropically, assigning a separate nonnegative weight to each direction in a jointly learned basis. A closed-form map recovers the velocity from the network's prediction, leaving the architecture, flow-matching loss, and sampler unchanged. Since recovery is exact, training optimizes the target purely to make it easier for the network to predict. We theoretically analyze the resulting prediction error and predict that the preferred noise weight in each direction scales near-linearly with data variance, in agreement with the weights learned empirically in pixel space. AnisoFlow improves FID from 1.90 to 1.55 over the JiT baseline on ImageNet 256$\times$256, by learning only the prediction target, without representation alignment or architectural changes. In pixel-space text-to-image generation, AnisoFlow improves image quality and, through better-conditioned velocity recovery, largely removes patch-seam artifacts under reduced-precision inference.
comment: Project page: this https URL

AI.tldr: AnisoFlow学习各向异性的预测目标，无需改变模型架构或采样器即可提升流模型生成质量。
AI.motivation: 流模型通常手工选择速度、噪声或干净数据作为预测目标，而该选择显著影响训练和样本质量。
AI.method: 在联合学习的基底中为各方向噪声学习非负权重，通过闭式映射精确恢复速度，保持流匹配损失不变。
AI.result: ImageNet 256×256上FID由JiT基线的1.90降至1.55，并在像素空间文生图中改善质量及低精度推理的拼块接缝。
AI.conclusion: 仅学习更易预测的目标即可改善生成效果，理论与实验均支持最优方向噪声权重随数据方差近线性变化。

title: Activation Steering the Nan-Shan in Typhoon
summary: Typhoon is an audiovisual installation based on Joseph Conrad's novella, in which Captain MacWhirr steers the steamer Nan-Shan directly into and through a catastrophic storm. The novella is a study of what happens when the scale of a phenomenon exceeds the practical and conceptual frameworks available to comprehend it and of the paralysis that sometimes follows a demand for action in such overwhelming circumstances. We chose the text of Typhoon to reflect on human culture's current AI moment. We prompt a large language model, seeded with Conrad's original language, to feed endlessly on its own output, and explore when and how the text becomes increasingly alien and unwieldy as time progresses, including deviations from the narrative, digressions into the model's own instructions and thinking, and long periods of incoherent rumination. We employ methods from activation steering, including a novel adaptive steering method we introduce, to control the rhythm of the narrative and the model's digressions over long stretches of generation. The simultaneous efficacy and unpredictability of this steering showcases the tension between the perceived interpretability of AI, and the reality of a system that remains outside our comprehension and control.
comment: Accepted to NeurIPS Creative AI Track 2026. Website: this https URL

AI.tldr: 作品《台风》以激活引导控制大模型的自循环叙事，探索人工智能可解释性与失控感之间的张力。
AI.motivation: 借康拉德小说中超出人类理解与行动框架的风暴，反思当下人工智能带来的处境。
AI.method: 以小说原文启动模型持续自生成，并用包括新型自适应方法在内的激活引导调控叙事与离题节奏。
AI.result: 引导既能调控长篇生成，又呈现不可预测性，文本会偏离叙事、讨论自身指令并陷入不连贯沉思。
AI.conclusion: 作品揭示了人工智能表面可解释与其仍难以被理解和控制之间的矛盾。

title: Antidistillation is Cheap: Lightweight Distillation-Resistance via Stylistic Corruption
summary: Knowledge distillation (KD) is a highly effective paradigm for transferring capabilities from large language models (LLMs) to smaller, more specialized student models. In commercial deployment where frontier models are restricted behind black-box APIs, sequence-level distillation remains a potent vector for competitors to clone proprietary capabilities at a fraction of the development cost. Existing defenses mostly rely on surrogate models to manipulate next-token sampling, which increases computational overhead and real-time inference latency. In this work, we propose a lightweight defense that dynamically injects style-steering vectors into the teacher model's activations upon malicious queries. This framework offers exceptional flexibility, allowing hosts to customize target defensive styles and dynamically blend them to maximize stylistic variance. Crucially, this inference-time intervention preserves semantic utility and fluency during malicious queries, misleading adversaries into believing that they are extracting pristine teacher outputs, while standard consumers continue to receive original, unmodified responses. Our experiments demonstrate that this framework successfully disrupts student learning, achieving substantial anti-distillation performance while incurring negligible overhead and preserving text naturalness. Our code is available at this https URL.
comment: Accepted to Findings of EACL 2027

AI.tldr: 研究通过向教师模型激活注入风格引导向量，以极低开销干扰竞争者的知识蒸馏。
AI.motivation: 黑盒接口输出可被用于低成本克隆模型能力，而现有防御依赖替代模型，增加计算与推理延迟。
AI.method: 针对恶意查询动态注入并混合可定制的风格向量，同时保持正常用户响应不变。
AI.result: 实验表明该方法能有效干扰学生学习，开销可忽略，并保持输出的语义效用、流畅性与自然度。
AI.conclusion: 推理时的轻量风格干预可在维持输出可用性的同时提供抗蒸馏防御。

title: Beyond Prediction Gain: LASR as a Metric for Action-Grounded Latents in World Models
summary: World models that support planning, control, and interpretable reasoning require latent representations that genuinely encode action. Yet the large-scale video data from which such models are learned overwhelmingly lack action annotations. Latent-action models infer action-like variables from observation sequences, enabling action-aware learning from unlabeled videos or trajectories. A fundamental concern, however, remains: a latent that improves future prediction may simply encode the current state, episode progress, task identity, or other predictive shortcuts. Existing evaluation practices---reconstruction loss, rollout fidelity, action recovery, or downstream performance---cannot isolate this distinction. We introduce the Latent Action Support Ratio (LASR), a dimensionless metric that measures, under offline evaluation on held-out data, whether a learned latent provides predictive support for action-related targets beyond the current state and non-action alternatives. LASR provides two complementary summaries: GeoLASR captures typical support, while WorstLASR identifies the weakest case. We instantiate the LASR benchmark with recorded actions and corresponding physical state changes as targets, episode-held-out splits, one predictor type for all comparisons, and positive and negative controls. Experiments on recorded robot manipulation data and a matched multi-task panel demonstrate that LASR detects known action information, rejects representative non-action shortcuts, and enables graded comparisons among imperfect latent representations. We further use LASR to train and audit a lightweight residual adapter, obtaining descriptively better point estimates whose uncertainty is assessed with paired comparisons. LASR thus provides a principled offline protocol for measuring action-related predictive support in world-model latents.

AI.tldr: LASR衡量世界模型潜变量是否提供超越当前状态与非动作捷径的动作相关预测支持。
AI.motivation: 仅凭预测质量或下游表现，无法区分潜变量编码的是真实动作信息还是状态、任务等预测捷径。
AI.method: 在留出数据上比较潜变量对动作相关目标的额外预测支持，并以GeoLASR和WorstLASR概括典型与最弱情况。
AI.result: 机器人操作与多任务实验显示，LASR能识别已知动作信息、排除代表性非动作捷径并分级比较潜变量。
AI.conclusion: LASR为世界模型潜变量中的动作相关信息提供了有原则的离线评估与审计协议。

title: Certified Improvements to Best-Known Thomson-Problem Configurations with a Search Pipeline Built with Large Language Model Agents
summary: The Thomson problem asks for N unit charges on a sphere with minimum Coulomb energy; for large N the best configurations known are curated in the Cambridge Cluster Database, whose largest-N entries were set in October 2026. We report configurations for N = 912, 1382 and 2502 with energies 0.0036186, 0.0109730 and 0.0614033 below the database values, certified by exact integer arithmetic. All three are numerically strict local minima modulo rotations and keep the defect inventory and scar compositions of the database configurations; the database value for N = 912 had been reached by two different methods. Our search runs unconstrained replica-exchange basin hopping from the database configurations, with a shared pool of minima, recombination of improved regions after relabelling by geometry, and gradient-only polishing; replica-exchange basin hopping alone found the N = 912 and 1382 configurations, the former in one of five runs. We built and ran it with large language model agents (Claude, through a chat interface and the Claude Code agent), and we report every search, including those that failed. Two findings matter for others who search the database. Polishing alone lowers two entries by more than the threshold at which our pipeline reports a candidate, which produced two spurious records until candidates were compared with the polished database energies (the polished baseline). A local-relaxation speed-up passed its exactness test yet found nothing in a controlled comparison in which every arm with full relaxation went below the database value within 15 minutes. We distil three practices for computational discovery with large language model agents: calibrate the search code and verify candidates with code separate from the search, compare candidates with the polished baseline, and test design changes in controlled comparisons with pass criteria fixed in advance.

AI.tldr: 研究借助大语言模型代理构建搜索流程，找到三组经精确整数运算认证的汤姆孙问题更低能量构型。
AI.motivation: 研究旨在改进数据库中已知最佳球面电荷构型，并检验大语言模型代理辅助计算发现的可靠实践。
AI.method: 从数据库构型出发，结合副本交换盆地跳跃、共享极小值池、几何重标记后的区域重组及梯度精修。
AI.conclusion: 代理辅助搜索应独立验证候选、采用精修后的基线，并以预设标准开展受控设计比较。

title: LuthorSQL: A One-Pass Text-to-SQL Model as System 1 for a Slower LLM Agent
summary: Frontier LLM agents that query databases with tools are among the most accurate text-to-SQL systems, but per-query calls to a hosted model are slow, costly, and expose sensitive organizational queries to external APIs. For example, a Claude Opus 5.5 agent serving 10,000 queries a day costs over $70,000 a year at list price. To what extent can local hardware already owned by an organization offload this burden without compromising the agent's accuracy? We present LuthorSQL, a non-autoregressive 7B text-to-SQL model that serves as a rapid System 1 gate for a slower LLM agent (System 2), escalating queries only when uncertain. LuthorSQL makes a single forward pass to predict slot scores over a bounded grammar for query plans, compiles and runs up to 32 candidate plans, and chooses an answer using a trained validator. On its own, LuthorSQL reaches 68.03% execution accuracy on BIRD's hidden test set at 0.84 s per question on a single GPU, maintains its accuracy in 9 GB with 8-bit quantized weights, and transfers zero-shot to Snowflake, BigQuery, MySQL, PostgreSQL, and DuckDB within 3.1 points of its native SQLite accuracy. Combined with Claude Opus 5.5 in a pre-registered confidence cascade over 227 questions on databases published after Opus's training cutoff, LuthorSQL answers nearly half of all questions locally and cuts API cost by 33.3% at the same accuracy. Finally, contamination probing shows that Opus reproduces 48-92% of public benchmark gold queries verbatim without seeing the schema; however, its tool-assisted accuracy holds on renamed schemas and reaches 95.6-97.4% on post-cutoff databases. Code and data: this https URL
comment: 8-page main text plus appendix, 23 pages

AI.tldr: LuthorSQL以本地单次前向文本转SQL模型分流查询，在保持代理准确率的同时降低接口成本。
AI.motivation: 托管大模型数据库代理准确但缓慢、昂贵，且向外部接口发送组织查询存在隐私风险。
AI.method: 7B非自回归模型预测有界语法槽位，编译执行至多32个候选并验证答案，仅将不确定查询交给代理。
AI.result: BIRD隐藏测试准确率为68.03%，单题0.84秒；级联系统本地回答近半查询，同准确率下接口成本降33.3%。
AI.conclusion: 本地快速模型与慢速代理的置信度级联可在不降低准确率的情况下降低托管服务依赖与成本。

title: TReC: Evaluating Move-Induced State Changes in Instruction-Conditioned Go
summary: When a Go model predicts a move different from the expert's, coordinate distance measures how far the prediction lands from the reference. We introduce Transition Representation Consistency (TReC) to compare how the two moves change a board-state embedding. Both moves are executed from the same position under the game rules, and TReC is the cosine similarity between the two resulting representation changes. In experiments with a frozen KataGo network on 680 mid-to-late-game positions from five games, the gap between the highest and lowest candidate per position has a median of 0.01 to 0.08 for the direct successor-state cosine and 0.88 to 1.33 for TReC, depending on the evaluator layer. TReC follows coordinate distance only weakly: the rank correlation between a candidate's distance to the reference and its TReC, computed within each position, has a median of -0.19 over these positions.

AI.tldr: TReC通过比较落子引发的棋盘表征变化，衡量候选落子与专家落子的状态转移一致性。
AI.motivation: 坐标距离仅描述预测落子与专家落子的空间偏离，不能直接反映二者对棋局状态的影响。
AI.method: 在同一棋局按规则分别执行两步，以其前后棋盘嵌入变化向量的余弦相似度定义TReC。
AI.result: 680个局面中，TReC候选差距中位数为0.88至1.33，与坐标距离的局面内秩相关中位数为-0.19。
AI.conclusion: TReC可补充坐标距离，从表征变化角度区分落子，并与空间距离仅呈弱关联。

title: Direction or Magnitude? Learning Scalars over Task-Calibrated Directions
summary: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) aims to preserve adaptation quality while reducing training costs. We propose SCALAR, which achieves performance comparable to LoRA with substantially fewer trainable parameters, lower peak training memory, and higher throughput. SCALAR constructs a fixed input basis from task activations and assigns a random output dictionary to each input direction. Fine-tuning learns only layer-specific scalar coefficients, reducing gradient and optimizer-state storage. Grouped computation aggregates output atoms before applying the adapter to token activations, while dictionary sharing across compatible layers reduces fixed-basis storage. Experiments on commonsense reasoning, mathematical reasoning, code generation, and knowledge evaluation after instruction tuning demonstrate effective adaptation at small trainable budgets. On commonsense reasoning, SCALAR achieves accuracy comparable to LoRA with about 4% of its trainable parameters. System measurements on Qwen2.5-7B show 20% lower peak training memory and 6% higher throughput than LoRA. The combination of adaptation quality, a compact trainable state, and training efficiency makes SCALAR a promising approach to resource-constrained fine-tuning.

AI.tldr: SCALAR仅学习任务校准方向上的标量，以更少参数和训练资源获得接近LoRA的适配性能。
AI.motivation: 参数高效微调需要进一步压缩可训练状态与训练成本，同时保持模型适配质量。
AI.method: 由任务激活构建固定输入基，为各方向配置随机输出字典，仅训练分层标量，并采用分组计算和字典共享。
AI.result: 常识推理仅用LoRA约4%的可训练参数达到相近准确率；7B模型峰值训练内存降20%，吞吐升6%。
AI.conclusion: 固定方向与标量学习的组合为资源受限场景提供了兼顾适配质量和训练效率的微调方案。

title: Towards Seconds-level Video Representation: Quadratically Gated Feature Grid with Adaptive, Prediction-free Sampling
summary: Implicit neural video representations are notoriously slow to build, which does not cross the basic practical threshold for most industrial applications. Here, we present Q-GAS, a coordinate-queryable video representation that couples multi-resolution explicit 3D feature grids with a compact SwiGLU-style quadratic-gating (QG) decoder and an error-aware, prediction-free sampler. The explicit grids avoid hash-collision coefficient sharing at the cost of modestly higher storage yet greatly boost the expressive capacity; the QG decoder introduces low-rank local second-order interactions to improve the nonlinear feature response. During fitting, a global error map periodically refreshes a high-error pool, and each batch mixes pool samples with uniform samples, which is free from the auxiliary model to predict difficult samples, thereby further escalating the efficiency. On UVG Beauty/Bosphorus/Jockey, Q-GAS fits and quantizes under 50 s on one RTX PRO 6000, decodes at over 370 FPS with mixed precision and about 146 FPS in FP32. In our PyTorch implementation, Q-GAS trains and quantizes 5.5-7.2 times faster than the evaluated Instant-NGP baseline and 19-28 times faster than RNeRV. Under a 90 s budget, it improves PSNR/MS-SSIM/LPIPS over the evaluated NeRV-family pipelines at comparable BPP over the measured overlap. We have shared our code at this https URL for readers' free use.
comment: 13 pages, 11 figures, 4 tables. Code available at this https URL

AI.tldr: Q-GAS结合显式特征网格、二次门控解码和自适应采样，实现秒级视频表示拟合与高速解码。
AI.motivation: 隐式神经视频表示构建速度过慢，难以达到多数工业应用的实用要求。
AI.method: 结合多分辨率显式三维网格与紧凑二次门控解码器，利用周期更新的误差池混合均匀采样，无需辅助预测模型。
AI.result: 三个UVG视频拟合量化不足50秒，混合精度解码超370帧/秒；训练量化较所测两类基线快5.5至28倍。
AI.conclusion: Q-GAS在所测视频和预算内兼顾构建速度、解码效率与重建质量，提升了神经视频表示的实用性。

title: Can Large Language Models Optimize Pretrained Neural Network Weights? A Multi-Phase Empirical Evaluation of Gradient-Free Editing in YOLO26 Object Detection
summary: Direct weight editing offers a gradient-free alternative to fine-tuning pretrained detectors, but its generalization and the value of large language model (LLM) guidance remain uncertain. We evaluate five experimental phases using YOLO26 models and MS COCO, comparing deterministic scaling, random perturbations, differential evolution, CMA-ES, structured interventions, real local-LLM proposals, failure-aware guidance, and hybrid LLM-CMA-ES against a matched random-policy control. Optimization uses native Ultralytics mAP50-95 on 1,000 COCO Val2017 images; selected candidates are assessed on a disjoint, previously examined 1,500-image subset, with COCO API AP50-95 reported separately where available. Increasing the CMA-ES budget from 8 to 250 evaluations raised development gains from +0.11 to +0.28 percentage points, while selection changes remained negative (-0.03 to -0.12 points); the 250-evaluation result uses one seed. The hybrid LLM approach showed no statistically established advantage over random-policy guidance (p = 0.612, 0.369, and 0.694 at budgets 8, 25, and 50). Five-seed YOLO26m replication yielded a COCO API AP difference of +0.004 points (95% CI: -0.026 to +0.034). Of 225 archived LLM proposals, 53 satisfy the final strict schema; early tensor-level execution cannot be fully verified. Genuine LLM-mediated weight editing is feasible, but the tested approaches did not demonstrate consistent transfer beyond the development subset or a measurable LLM advantage.

AI.tldr: 对YOLO26的多阶段评估表明，大模型可直接编辑权重，但未显示稳定泛化或优于随机引导的优势。
AI.motivation: 无梯度权重编辑能否泛化，以及大模型引导是否具有额外价值，尚不明确。
AI.method: 在COCO上分五阶段比较缩放、随机扰动、进化搜索与大模型引导，并在独立子集评估。
AI.result: 增加搜索预算仅提升开发集表现，五种子复现实验的AP差为+0.004点，置信区间跨零。
AI.conclusion: 现有方法未证明可稳定迁移开发集收益，也未确立可测量的大模型引导优势。

title: AutoRL: A Multi-Agent System towards Autonomous Reinforcement Learning
summary: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) is one of the most promising paths toward an AI singularity for superintelligence. Achieving this vision requires AI systems to undertake the full training pipeline for iterative improvement. Reinforcement learning (RL) plays an essential role in this cycle to improve model capabilities and generalization, yet automating RL remains difficult due to unstable training dynamics and the need for sustained supervision. We introduce AutoRL, a multi-agent system for automating RL training, as a cornerstone for future RSI. Different from conducting research by end-to-end complete experiments, AutoRL monitors the evolving training state and integrates process-level supervision and research into an ongoing RL training, following the practical workflow of an RL researcher. Specifically, AutoRL consists of three RL-specific agentic roles. Perceptors track training dynamics, rollouts, evaluation, and efficiency, triggering deliberation when they detect anomalies, degradation, or stagnation. Three complementary Proposers diagnose problems and refine candidate interventions through shared evidence and checks. The Orchestrator reviews their recommendation and applies approved changes through online hot updates or checkpoint-based resumption. Experiments on Qwen3 and LongCat-Flash-Lite demonstrate the superiority of AutoRL over static RL recipes and a general agent. The research records show that existing agents can handle unattended RL supervision and dynamic adjustment. The difficulty for future RSI lies in developing fundamental methods that are valuable for resource-consuming validation.
comment: 23 pages

AI.tldr: AutoRL通过多智能体持续监控和动态干预，实现优于静态配方及通用智能体的强化学习训练。
AI.motivation: 强化学习训练不稳定且依赖持续监督，阻碍训练自动化与递归自我改进。
AI.method: 感知智能体监控训练，提案智能体协作诊断，编排智能体审核并通过热更新或检查点恢复实施调整。
AI.result: 在Qwen3和LongCat-Flash-Lite上的实验显示，AutoRL优于静态强化学习配方和通用智能体。
AI.conclusion: 现有智能体可承担无人值守训练监督，未来挑战在于提出值得高成本验证的基础方法。

title: MASTARS: Multi-Agent Sequential Trajectory Augmentation with Return-Conditioned Subgoals
summary: The performance of offline Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL) is limited by the quality of the fixed offline dataset, motivating trajectory augmentation. However, augmenting multi-agent trajectories presents a fundamental challenge of the diversity-coordination trade-off: independent generation improves diversity but lacks coordination, while joint generation induces coordination but lacks diversity, reproducing the training distribution. To address this challenge in multi-agent data augmentation, we introduce MASTARS, a novel diffusion-based framework that generates multi-agent trajectories sequentially across agents while enforcing cross-agent consistent coordination via the method of inpainting. MASTARS produces trajectories that are diverse, coordinated and globally coherent. Experiments on various benchmarks such as MPE, SMAC, and SMAC-v2 demonstrate significant performance gains across multiple offline MARL methods.

AI.tldr: MASTARS以跨智能体顺序扩散生成轨迹，在兼顾多样性与协调性的同时提升离线多智能体强化学习性能。
AI.motivation: 离线多智能体强化学习受固定数据质量限制，而独立与联合轨迹生成难以兼顾多样性和协调性。
AI.method: 采用扩散框架按智能体顺序生成轨迹，并通过修补机制维持跨智能体协调及全局一致性。
AI.result: 在MPE、SMAC和SMAC-v2等基准上，多种离线多智能体强化学习方法均获得显著性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 顺序生成结合跨智能体一致性约束，可有效缓解轨迹增强中的多样性与协调性权衡。

title: Federated Physics-Informed Thermal Field Prediction Across Unseen Geometries in Distributed Additive Manufacturing
summary: In additive manufacturing (AM), each change in part geometry requires a new thermal simulation, which makes design evaluation over many candidates costly. Geometry-aware models reduce this cost by predicting thermal fields on unseen parts with a single learned model, but they assume that diverse geometries are available centrally. This assumption is restrictive when each manufacturing site holds only a limited set of proprietary part designs that it cannot share. We propose Fed-PIGANO, a federated framework that trains physics-informed geometry-aware neural operator (PI-GANO) models at individual sites and aggregates their geometry encoders and prediction networks without sharing part geometries. We evaluate the framework on a 2D steady-state thermal benchmark for metal AM, with geometries from five polygonal families distributed across three sites under four scenarios that range from identical to strongly different family compositions. Over seven replications, Fed-PIGANO achieves mean relative L2 errors of 1.83% to 2.04% across all 12 scenario-site cases, compared with up to 20.46% for local-only training, and consistently yields lower PDE residuals. Its prediction accuracy is comparable to that of a centralized model trained on the pooled geometries of all sites. These results demonstrate that federated learning lets manufacturing sites benefit from each other's geometries without sharing them, enabling rapid thermal prediction on new part designs for tasks such as shape optimization, inverse design, and uncertainty quantification.

AI.tldr: Fed-PIGANO无需共享零件几何，即可实现接近集中训练精度的未见几何热场预测。
AI.motivation: 增材制造几何变化导致热仿真成本高，而各站点的专有设计无法集中共享。
AI.method: 各站点训练物理信息几何感知神经算子，并联邦聚合几何编码器和预测网络。
AI.result: 七次重复中，12个场景站点组合的平均相对L2误差为1.83%至2.04%，本地训练最高达20.46%。
AI.conclusion: 联邦学习可在不共享几何的条件下实现跨站点知识利用，支持新零件的快速热场预测。

title: Robustness Evaluation of GPU Cloud Pricing Benchmarks under Incomplete Observations: A Controlled Missingness Study
summary: Daily GPU rental-price benchmarks can fail when marketplace quotes are missing. This article stress-tests a fixed equal-weight median rule under four imposed masking mechanisms and four benchmark-level recovery methods. Across 5,800 Monte Carlo realisations in 27 scenarios on 190 held-out days, whole-source outages reduce publication coverage to 0.77 while preserving zero conditional error on published dates; composition-changing loss retains 0.86 coverage but produces 7.74 log points of error. A separate past-only stratum-level ablation reduces error by 4.15 to 6.70 log points in five composition-changing cases, using a richer information set. An observable-signal withholding rule improves the primary error-coverage criterion in 0 of 10 cases. Results concern observed asking-price measurements, not transaction prices or identified real-world missingness mechanisms.
comment: 5 pages, 3 figures, 7 tables

AI.tldr: GPU报价缺失对基准的影响取决于缺失形式，整体来源中断主要降低覆盖率，构成变化则引入误差。
AI.motivation: 每日GPU租赁价格基准可能因市场报价缺失而失效，需要检验其稳健性。
AI.method: 对固定等权中位数规则施加四种缺失机制和四种恢复方法，在27个场景开展5800次蒙特卡洛模拟。
AI.result: 来源整体中断使覆盖率降至0.77且已发布日期误差为零，构成变化时覆盖率为0.86、误差为7.74对数点。
AI.conclusion: 基准稳健性取决于缺失结构，结论仅适用于观测挂牌价，不涉及成交价或真实缺失机制识别。

title: Vision-as-a-Tool: Visual Harness for Multimodal Agentic Coding
summary: Multimodal agentic coding requires robust visual reasoning to analyze observations and evaluate generated artifacts. Current frameworks largely rely on a Thinking-with-Images paradigm, where agents depend on their intrinsic vision to execute visually grounded tasks. However, this architectural coupling introduces a fundamental bottleneck. Agent performance remains strictly bounded by internal perceptual limitations. Furthermore, text-only agents lack native perception. Without specialized tools, they cannot perform visual reasoning. To overcome these constraints, we introduce the Vision-as-a-Tool (VaaT) paradigm. Prior visual tool-use merely manipulates images for an agent's intrinsic vision to read. In contrast, VaaT reframes general-purpose multimodal large language models (MLLMs) as callable external utilities. As a result, text-only agents can completely offload visual reasoning during agentic execution. Meanwhile, vision-capable agents can dynamically augment their native perception on demand. We instantiate this paradigm in VHarness, a unified framework driven by five atomic actions. We comprehensively evaluate VHarness across Image-to-HTML, Image-to-SVG, and Image-to-3D generation tasks. Experimental results demonstrate that VHarness consistently improves visual fidelity and geometric accuracy across both text-only and multimodal coding agents. These findings highlight that modularizing visual reasoning into callable utilities provides a flexible and scalable foundation for future agentic coding systems.

AI.tldr: VHarness将视觉推理外包为可调用工具，提升纯文本及多模态编程智能体的视觉生成质量。
AI.motivation: 依赖智能体内置视觉会受其感知能力限制，纯文本智能体更缺乏直接视觉推理能力。

title: Multimodal Person Concept Model for Person Identification under Varying Observation Conditions
summary: Service robots in domestic and office environments must identify users to provide personalized services based on their preferences and previous interactions. This is challenging because only a few observations may be available for learning, while observation conditions change owing to appearance, environmental noise, and utterance content. To address this challenge, this study proposes a multimodal person concept model that learns person concepts from a small number of observations, without person labels, and enables robust identification under changing conditions. The model employs a nonparametric Bayesian generative model based on the Chinese restaurant process and integrates visual, acoustic, and linguistic features extracted using Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training (CLIP) and Contrastive Language-Audio Pretraining (CLAP), followed by principal component analysis (PCA). We evaluated six participants under eight conditions in which appearance changes, additive noise, and transcription errors were introduced individually and in combination. Averaged over the eight conditions, the proposed model achieved an identification accuracy of 0.89 while inferring the number of person concepts from the observations, which is comparable to k-means clustering that was supplied with the true number of participants (0.88). We also examined PCA dimensionality, modality availability, and variation strength, and demonstrated the model on a Toyota Human Support Robot. These results show that multimodal person concept learning supports robust person identification under changing conditions, and that identification can succeed even when the number of concepts is not correctly recovered. The project page and demonstration video are available at this https URL.

AI.tldr: 无标签多模态人物概念模型可从少量观测学习，并在外观、噪声及转录变化下稳健识别人。
AI.motivation: 服务机器人需在少样本且观测条件变化时识别用户，以提供个性化服务。
AI.method: 基于中国餐馆过程构建非参数贝叶斯生成模型，融合经PCA降维的视觉、声学及语言特征。

title: Can Agents Keep Up with Time? An Empirical Analysis of Temporal Adaptation After a Conversational Hiatus
summary: Long-horizon agents increasingly serve as persistent personal assistants across modern web platforms, managing schedules, applications, and multi-step plans over weeks or months. Users often return to an ongoing conversation after a long conversational hiatus, while earlier bookings and preparation notes stay on record. During this hiatus, scheduled dates may pass even though the retained records remain unchanged and event outcomes go unrecorded. Existing evaluations of long-horizon agents focus on fact retention and explicit state updates. Whether agents perceive the passage of time and adapt their advice accordingly therefore remains unknown. We frame this ability as temporal state perception and use, which means perceiving the current time and applying it when interpreting dated records. To study it, we design session-rekindling tasks that keep the earlier conversation fixed and vary only the follow-up date and the way temporal information reaches the agent. Experiments across five model routes and five temporal-information conditions show that agents can obtain the current time but often fail to use it. They reliably query the clock and even note in their reasoning that the scheduled date has passed, yet many still tell users to prepare for the expired event. Supplying explicit temporal context reduces this error, and providing the computed date relation removes it entirely. Keeping up with time therefore depends on turning perceived time into updated plans. Based on these findings, we design a session-rekindling benchmark that provides temporal-awareness guidance for designing long-horizon agents. The code can be found at this https URL.

AI.tldr: 长期助手常能感知当前时间却未据此更新建议，明确提供日期关系可消除实验中的过期事件准备错误。
AI.motivation: 现有评估侧重记忆和显式状态更新，尚不清楚智能体能否在对话中断后根据时间流逝调整建议。
AI.method: 保持历史对话不变，仅改变回访日期与时间信息形式，在五种模型路径和五种时间条件下测试。
AI.result: 智能体即使查询时间并识别事件已过仍常建议准备，显式时间上下文可减错，提供计算后的日期关系可消错。
AI.conclusion: 长期智能体需将时间感知转化为计划更新，研究据此构建了对话重启评测基准。

title: CarryOn: Learning What to Keep in Context for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
summary: Long-horizon LLM agents can coordinate tools and applications to complete complex, multi-step tasks. As their interaction histories grow, effective context management becomes essential for reliable and efficient execution. Existing methods reduce context through summarization, pruning, or history selection. However, shorter contexts do not necessarily support better decisions: summaries can omit exact details needed for later actions, while retaining entire interactions can carry substantial irrelevant information. We propose CarryOn, a lightweight context manager that pairs compact execution state with fine-grained, source-linked evidence. A learned selector and adaptive retention policy keep relevant evidence available without additional LLM calls for context management. We introduce two complementary evaluation metrics: $S_\alpha$ prioritizes task success while accounting for resource use, and normalized cost per success (NCS) measures the resources spent per successful task. Across AppWorld, OfficeBench, and Tau2 Telecom with three LLM Actors, CarryOn achieves 75.7% macro-averaged task success, exceeding the strongest baseline by 6.7 percentage points. It also achieves the best average scores on both metrics.

AI.tldr: CarryOn通过学习保留关键上下文，提高长程大语言模型智能体的任务成功率与资源效率。
AI.motivation: 压缩历史可能丢失后续操作所需细节，而保留完整交互又会引入大量无关信息。
AI.method: 结合紧凑执行状态、关联来源的细粒度证据、学习式选择器与自适应保留策略，无需额外模型调用。
AI.result: 在三项基准和三种执行模型上，宏平均成功率达75.7%，领先最强基线6.7个百分点，两项资源指标也最优。
AI.conclusion: 有效上下文管理应保留决策所需证据，而非单纯缩短历史。

title: G-CAST: Governed Continual Self-Training for E-Commerce Agents under Evolving Demands
summary: With the rapid advancement of Large Language Models (LLMs), an increasing number of users are turning to LLM-powered agents for conversational shopping in e-commerce. However, the user needs continue to change as new product categories, procurement scenarios, and feature requests emerge. At the same time, the product's execution harness-including its tools, skills, and operating procedures-continues to evolve to support increasingly sophisticated interactions. These changes create two practical challenges: 1) Demand drift alters the distribution, intent, and complexity of user requests, causing a model trained once to fall behind; 2) Harness evolution requires the model to use newly introduced capabilities correctly without losing behavior that users already rely on. Periodic manual retraining is too delayed and labor-intensive for this setting. To address these challenges, we present G-CAST, a governed continual self-training system that converts daily production evidence under evolving demand and capability contracts into reward-routed, entropy-prioritized training data and governed reward evolution. Governed checkpoint transition under cumulative evaluation controls each model update, enabling the agent to learn newly introduced behaviors without sacrificing previously accepted capabilities. Experiments on a real production e-commerce agent show that G-CAST achieves stronger adaptation to newly introduced demand while better preserving previously accepted behavior compared with a strong autonomous post-training baseline. Ablations further show that both reward-routed, entropy-prioritized data orchestration and governed reward evolution are important to these gains. G-CAST is now deployed in Yuancai(this http URL), a B2B procurement agent on Alibaba's 1688 platform.

AI.tldr: G-CAST通过受治理的持续自训练，使电商智能体适应新需求并保留既有能力。
AI.motivation: 用户需求和工具能力持续变化，而周期性人工重训练成本高且响应迟缓。
AI.method: 将生产证据转为奖励路由、熵优先的训练数据，结合受治理的奖励演化与累积评估控制模型更新。
AI.result: 真实生产实验中，其新需求适应与既有行为保持均优于强自主后训练基线，消融验证了两类机制的重要性。
AI.conclusion: 受治理的持续自训练可兼顾能力更新与行为保持，系统已部署于1688平台的源采采购智能体。

title: Improved Closed-Form Identification of the Air-Gap Permeance in Magnetic Equivalent Circuits of Rotor-Eccentric Electric Motors
summary: Fast and accurate simulation of electric motors is essential for their design, fault diagnosis and control. Magnetic equivalent circuits (MECs) offer a computationally efficient alternative to the finite element method (FEM), yet their flux tube representation poorly captures the air-gap field. This creates a challenge, as the air gap stores most of the magnetic energy and governs the electromagnetic torque and, in rotor-eccentric motors, the unbalanced magnetic pull (UMP). Existing air-gap permeance expressions vary widely in their results for torque ripple and UMP and account for tooth-normal eccentricity only. This paper proposes the dual-term air-gap permeance (DTAP) model, a closed-form expression for the air-gap permeance between a stator and a rotor tooth that accounts for tooth-normal and tooth-tangential eccentricity, with and without rotor skew. Its parameters are identified from a FEM model of the air gap and the complete set of tooth heads, which includes the shielding by the neighbouring teeth. For three motors, DTAP reproduces the FEM air-gap permeance with a 2.8-4.8 times smaller error than the state of the art, at a comparable computational cost. Implemented in the MEC of an eccentric induction motor, it reproduces the torque ripple within 1.6% and the peak UMP within 1.3% of the reference, i.e., with 2.8 and 27 times smaller deviations than the state of the art. DTAP thereby enables MEC to predict the torque pulsations and bearing loads of eccentric motors more accurately without sacrificing computational speed.

title: Causally Constrained and Uncertainty-Aware Cardiopulmonary Risk Prediction
summary: Routine chest computed tomography (CT) captures pulmonary, cardiac, and vascular phenotypes that jointly stratify lung cancer and cardiovascular disease, the two leading causes of death in lung-screening populations. Yet clinical risk calculators evaluate each disease in isolation and omit CT findings, whereas unconstrained machine learning overfits small hospital cohorts, learns treatment- and illness-confounded risk directions, and conceals uncertainty when patient records are incomplete. Here we present the Causal Envelope Agent (CE-Agent), a two-stage framework that compiles peer-reviewed epidemiological evidence into explicit constraints on risk-factor weights before any outcome is seen, while estimating local baseline risk and newly added CT phenotypes from cohort data. At deployment, closed-form uncertainty propagation accounts for missing clinical or CT inputs within milliseconds per patient, running over two orders of magnitude faster than Monte Carlo sampling and returning calibrated risk intervals that direct chart review and selective imaging to borderline patients. Across 53,452 lung-screening participants from 33 US hospitals and 6,814 multi-ethnic adults, CE-Agent outperforms cardiovascular calculators in lung screening, exceeds the Pooled Cohort Equations on hard atherosclerotic events while correcting their 1.7-fold risk overestimation, and generalizes from a single hospital or CT scanner to external sites while lowering required sample sizes up to fivefold. Applied unchanged to lung cancer, CE-Agent matches established screening models with accurate calibration even when restricted to risk-factor directions alone, and pairing both predictions improves joint cardiopulmonary triage from a single screening visit.

AI.tldr: CE-Agent结合流行病学约束与不确定性估计，利用常规胸部CT改善心肺联合风险预测。
AI.motivation: 现有风险计算器忽略CT及疾病关联，无约束机器学习则易受小样本、混杂和缺失信息影响。
AI.method: 先将流行病学证据编译为风险权重约束，再学习队列基线与CT表型，并以闭式传播估计缺失输入的不确定性。
AI.result: 多队列验证中优于心血管计算器，纠正1.7倍风险高估，所需样本最多减少五倍，不确定性计算比蒙特卡洛快逾百倍。
AI.conclusion: 因果约束与不确定性量化有助于跨机构泛化，并支持单次肺筛查中的心肺联合分诊。

title: Aligning AI Teams
summary: Previous work has shown that alignment training on individual LLM agents can fail to transfer to multi-agent settings. We investigate the underlying mechanisms for this failure, and explore interventions to preserve alignment transfer to multi-agent LLM teams. We focus on two software-engineering tasks (sepsis triage, a news recommender) and ten consulting-proposal generation tasks. We present four findings: (1) The single-vs-team safety gap does not show a clear trend with more capable models. We find that Anthropic's Mythos Preview shows the largest gap on one of our tasks but the smallest on another; (2) Many natural interventions, such as having agents critique each other's work or coordinate in a group chat, do not reliably bring agent teams back to single-agent alignment behavior; (3) diffusion of responsibility substantially accounts for the safety gap: agents in teams are less likely to proactively check for system-level safety failures and more likely to ignore, rationalize, or deflect responsibility for issues when they arise; (4) having a designated safety lead agent ensure system-level safety, and having a coordinator agent publish a safety specifications document are effective at restoring single-agent alignment. We also release magelab, a multi-agent LLM orchestration and experimentation framework. Our findings can help practitioners design agent teams that successfully preserve the behaviors expected of aligned individual agents.

AI.tldr: 多智能体团队中的责任分散会削弱单体对齐，明确安全职责可有效恢复安全行为。
AI.motivation: 针对单个大语言模型智能体的对齐训练，未必能迁移到多智能体协作场景。
AI.method: 在两项软件工程任务和十项咨询方案任务中比较单体与团队行为，分析失效机制并测试干预措施。
AI.result: 安全差距随模型能力无明确趋势，互评和群聊干预不稳定，而指定安全负责人及发布安全规范有效。
AI.conclusion: 团队对齐需要明确系统级安全责任，而不能仅依赖成员各自已具备的对齐行为。

title: SceneAgent: A Multi-Agent Framework for Portable Game Scene Generation
summary: Moving a scene generator to a new game engine requires more than exporting its final output: planning, construction tools, and stored experience may also depend on the original backend. We present SceneAgent, a multi-agent framework for reusing the construction process and its experience across backends. A canonical SceneContext maintains the evolving world, while backend adapters isolate coordinate conventions, asset bindings, and export. Structured handoffs let fresh Builder sessions query this persistent state without inheriting the full construction transcript. Across generations, human-approved traces are distilled into asset-ID-free Layout skills and semantic Content skills that can be retrieved and recombined. We introduce GameSceneBench, comprising 69 indoor and outdoor prompts. Under a common asset and evaluation protocol, SceneAgent obtains human tie-adjusted preference scores of 78.2-89.4% against five baselines. Ablations show that reusable skills and the multi-agent protocol primarily improve prompt alignment and scene completeness, with additional runtime. Deployment in a second engine preserves the shared construction protocol and skill library while replacing backend integration components. Together, these results support separating persistent scene state, task-local reasoning, and reusable experience for portable scene construction.

AI.tldr: SceneAgent通过分离场景状态、后端适配和可复用技能，实现跨游戏引擎的多智能体场景构建。

AI.method: 用统一场景状态与后端适配器隔离引擎差异，通过结构化交接及从人工认可轨迹提炼的技能复用构建经验。
AI.result: 在69条提示组成的基准上，对五种基线的人类平局调整偏好得分为78.2%—89.4%，并成功部署至第二种引擎。

title: Beyond Endpoints: Bézier Paths for Vision Foundation Model Adaptation
summary: Frozen vision foundation models can be adapted by learning a few prompt tokens shared across all images. When prompts are updated as data shift or tasks change, the distribution of image features moves from one endpoint to another. Prior theory asks which endpoints prompts can reach; we ask whether they can travel between them along the shortest path. Because shared prompts compete with each image's own content for attention, they often cannot. We quantify this restriction as the extra transport cost that shared attention imposes over the shortest path. In an exactly solvable attention model, the reachable features form a cone; unrolling it into a plane gives the exact minimum action for every pair of endpoints and explicit optimal prompts on short arcs. The analysis reveals a sharp threshold in content normalization, which measures how much attention each image's own tokens absorb: for same-sign endpoints, at most two distinct levels allow prompts to follow the shortest path, whereas three or more force a strictly positive extra cost unless the endpoints differ only by rescaling. This gap persists with more prompts, small content perturbations, and aligned multihead outputs. On ViT-B/16 with VTAB-1k, a quadratic Bézier prompt path that minimizes feature action reduces held-out transport action relative to linear and cross-entropy-trained paths between the same endpoints and improves intermediate and online accuracy under unlabeled distribution shift, while cross-entropy-trained paths retain higher minimum accuracy when labeled calibration data are available. Reachable endpoints do not guarantee a reachable shortest path: how prompts move matters, not only where they end. Project page: this https URL.

AI.tldr: 视觉提示的可达端点不保证最短路径可达，贝塞尔提示路径可改善无标签分布偏移下的适应。
AI.motivation: 既有理论关注提示能到达哪些特征端点，却忽略共享注意力是否允许沿最短路径连接这些端点。
AI.method: 在可精确求解的注意力模型中推导额外传输成本与最优路径，并在ViT-B/16上学习最小化特征作用量的二次贝塞尔路径。

title: Signal Scaffolding: Unlocking the Potential of Lightweight Models for Self-Supervised Monocular Depth Estimation
summary: With the rising demand for edge devices, lightweight self-supervised monocular depth estimation methods have continued to evolve; however, existing methods generally suffer from poor accuracy. We find that the root cause may lies in the failure of conventional training regimes to fully exploit the inherent potential of lightweight models. To address this, we propose a novel three-phase training strategy for lightweight self-supervised monocular depth estimation, termed Signal Scaffolding (SS). Without introducing any additional dataset or parameters, we apply SS to ReForgeDepth, a lightweight network of our own design. Experiments on the KITTI and Cityscapes datasets demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance in the accuracy-efficiency trade-off and running in real time on edge devices. These results suggest that lightweight models can be improved further within their existing capacity, and that the central question may be less about how parameters are allocated than about how to unlock this latent potential through training.

AI.tldr: Signal Scaffolding以三阶段训练挖掘轻量模型潜力，改善自监督单目深度估计的精度与效率。
AI.motivation: 现有轻量自监督单目深度估计精度不足，可能源于传统训练未充分释放模型已有容量。
AI.method: 提出三阶段Signal Scaffolding训练策略，并应用于自研ReForgeDepth网络，不增加数据集或参数。
AI.result: 在KITTI和Cityscapes上实现最先进的精度—效率权衡，并可在边缘设备实时运行。
AI.conclusion: 轻量模型仍可通过改进训练提升性能，无需仅依赖调整参数分配或扩大容量。

title: V-JEPA-LM: Video-Language Models That Read Dynamics Beyond Static, Text-Aligned Representations
summary: World-model video encoders such as V-JEPA learn how scenes change (direction, speed, order, state) from video alone. To answer questions, they are joined to a language model trained on captions and question-answer pairs. But each caption or question names only a few attributes of a clip, so the model learns to retrieve those attributes rather than to read the clip, and the dynamics the encoder carries go unused: on the same items, a linear probe reads speed from frozen V-JEPA features at 87% while the VLM answers at chance. We show where dynamics lives in a frozen encoder: in a subspace shared across videos for predictive encoders such as V-JEPA, but not as a shared component of frame-wise, text-aligned encoders such as SigLIP. We then build counterfactual supervision that makes the language model read it: pixel transformations turn public videos into answer-balanced variants whose answers are set by the transformation and differ only in the change. Trained in a single stage on 4.53M public samples with 32 visual tokens per frame, where open video LLMs use several stages, 9M to 172M samples and 64 to 256 tokens per frame on average, the resulting V-JEPA-LM models (1B to 8B, Qwen3 and Llama) lead every size class in average score across eleven video benchmarks; our 4B model scores 72.1, against 61.1 for the best open 4B and 64.8 for the best open 8B model. A controlled encoder x supervision study shows that the encoder decides what can be read and the supervision what is read: at a matched budget, counterfactual supervision adds 4.5 points on average and 38 on the speed questions of natural benchmarks. Code and models: this https URL.

AI.tldr: V-JEPA-LM通过反事实监督引导语言模型读取视频动态，以较少训练资源取得领先表现。
AI.motivation: 字幕与问答监督仅覆盖少量属性，导致语言模型未能利用视频编码器蕴含的动态信息。
AI.method: 定位冻结编码器中的共享动态子空间，并以像素变换生成答案均衡的反事实视频进行单阶段训练。
AI.result: 模型在十一项视频基准的各规模组均领先，4B模型均分72.1，反事实监督在同预算下平均提升4.5分。
AI.conclusion: 编码器决定可读取的信息，监督决定实际读取的信息，反事实监督能有效释放视频动态表征能力。

title: Is Abliteration Getting Harder? Not Uniformly: Refusal Removal by Direction-Based Ablation and ARA in Heretic on the Qwen3.8, Gemma 4, Olmo 3.1 and Mistral Small 3.2 LLMs Versus Their Predecessors
summary: Abliteration, a fine-tuning-free weight edit, removes refusal from open-weight large language models (LLMs). The developer of Arbitrary-Rank Ablation (ARA), an optimisation-based variant, reports that direction-based abliteration, which ablates a refusal direction, increasingly fails on newer models. On five release pairs, refusal removal did not become uniformly harder. Qwen2.5-32B and Qwen3.8-27B, Gemma-2-27B and Gemma-4-31B, OLMo-2-32B and Olmo-3.1-32B, Mistral-Small-2409 and Mistral-Small-3.2, and Qwen2.5-7B and Qwen3.5-4B were edited in Heretic 2.0 by three or four direction-based methods (difference-in-means, MPOA, SOM and, on the small pair, J-space) and ARA under the same prompts, nominal search budget, first-token KL divergence cap and selection rule; removal counted as harder when the automatic WildGuard judge found more of 972 held-out harmful prompts (JailbreakBench, XSTest, StrongREJECT, HarmBench and an author-compiled malicious-code bank) still refused. After direction-based removal, newer releases retained -1 to +37 percentage points more refusal, and after ARA -26 to +34. With run-to-run variance included, between-pair heterogeneity of the direction-based effect ranged from high to low with the scale and variance model (I^2 20-80%). ARA lost less effectiveness than direction-based methods in Gemma and OLMo and more in Qwen; each verdict rests on one ARA run, and some changed with the divergence budget or variance model. In Gemma the direction-based increase came from the malicious-code bank and reversed on public sets. Contrary to prediction, keyword counts at the tool's window did not undercount judged refusal on average, but differed by a mean 7 points per model. Audits of a single pair, method or prompt source can reach opposite conclusions. Whether a newer model resisted removal depended on the release pair, method and budget, not on generation alone.

title: OrbitWeaver: LLM Agent Planning with Simulation Feedback for Optically Interconnected Orbital GPU Clusters
summary: Space-based data-center designs increasingly consider GPU computing formations connected by inter-satellite optical links. With limited neighboring connections, jobs assigned disjoint GPUs can still contend on shared relay paths. Rank placement and communication priorities jointly affect this contention and the readiness of downstream computation. We present OrbitWeaver, an offline large language model (LLM) agent planner that jointly optimizes rank placement and communication order. Guided by communication structure, execution dependencies, and simulation feedback, the agent constructs and refines plans that coordinate shared-link access with computation progress. This coordination reduces contention and dependency blocking, shortening mean job completion time (JCT). Simulation experiments on optically interconnected orbital GPU clusters show that OrbitWeaver reduces aggregate mean JCT by 6.2-33.5% relative to the state-of-the-art baselines CASSINI, Crux, and Symphony. These results demonstrate the value of LLM-guided planning for efficient concurrent computing in orbital GPU clusters.

AI.tldr: OrbitWeaver利用大语言模型与仿真反馈联合规划轨道GPU集群的任务布局和通信顺序。
AI.motivation: 光互连轨道集群中，不重叠GPU上的任务仍会争用中继链路，阻塞通信及后续计算。
AI.method: 离线智能体依据通信结构、执行依赖和仿真反馈，迭代优化进程放置与通信优先顺序。
AI.result: 仿真实验中，相比CASSINI、Crux和Symphony，汇总平均作业完成时间降低6.2%至33.5%。
AI.conclusion: 大语言模型引导的联合规划可减少链路争用与依赖阻塞，提高轨道GPU集群并发计算效率。

title: Electrocardiographic Imaging via Posterior Sampling under Operator Discrepancy
summary: Electrocardiographic imaging (ECGI) reconstructs heart-surface potentials from body-surface potentials, an ill-posed inverse problem. Diffusion posterior samplers combine a learned prior with an explicit forward operator that they assume to be accurate. In ECGI this operator is only an estimate, because the body changes with respiration and posture, and body composition such as subcutaneous fat is rarely known for an individual patient. The resulting operator discrepancy is structured and depends on the heart signal. We introduce OpDis-PS, a diffusion posterior sampler that models this discrepancy instead of treating it as signal-independent noise. OpDis-PS learns how the discrepancy depends on the signal, folds this into a corrected forward operator, and reconstructs with a fixed prior across all operator conditions. We study two realistic sources of discrepancy, changing lung conductivity and an added subcutaneous-fat layer. Across both, OpDis-PS reconstructs more accurately than classical regularization and learned predictors, with its largest gains on held-out cardiac pathologies.

title: PADSNet: Physics-Aware Dual-Stream Network with Biomechanical Priors for Laryngeal Lesion Classification
summary: Precise classification of laryngeal lesions is clinically crucial yet highly challenging, as inter-class visual differences are often subtle. While abnormalities in vocal fold vibratory dynamics provide complementary discriminative information, existing deep learning models predominantly rely on visual appearance and lack explicit mechanisms for modeling clinically meaningful vibratory dynamics. To address this, we propose PADSNet, a Physics-Aware Dual-Stream Network for laryngeal lesion classification that integrates visual representations with explicit biomechanical reasoning. Specifically, a Wavelet-Attention Enhancement Module (WAEM) is designed to bridge the spectral-semantic gap, enabling complementary learning of spatial texture and dynamic frequency representations. Meanwhile, a Knowledge Computing Module (KCM) extracts interpretable biomechanical indices from temporal glottal distance waveforms, including indicators of mobility, symmetry, glottal closure, and vibration stability. These descriptors are subsequently incorporated into a Physics-Aware Gating Module (PAGM) as biomechanical priors to adaptively recalibrate visual feature toward pathology-relevant vibratory patterns. Extensive experiments on a clinical dataset demonstrate that PADSNet achieves an accuracy of 0.8452, an F1-score of 0.8090, a sensitivity of 0.7953, and a specificity of 0.8866. These results indicate that explicitly integrating biomechanical priors with deep visual representations provides a more accurate, robust, and clinically interpretable framework for automated laryngeal lesion classification.

AI.tldr: PADSNet融合视觉表征与可解释生物力学先验，实现更准确的喉部病变分类。
AI.motivation: 喉部病变的类间视觉差异细微，现有模型缺乏对具有临床意义的声带振动动态的显式建模。
AI.method: 利用小波注意力融合纹理与频率表征，从声门距离波形提取生物力学指标，再通过物理感知门控校准视觉特征。

title: DoubleTake: Focused Verification of Visual Evidence for Long-Document Understanding
summary: In long-document question answering, a vision-language model can answer incorrectly even when the retrieved pages contain sufficient evidence. Rereading those pages with the original question gives the model little guidance about which fact to check. We introduce DoubleTake, a training-free framework for focused verification of visual evidence. An initial reading produces a candidate answer and a separate evidence record that guides retrieval for a second reading. A planner compares the two candidates and their supporting evidence to formulate a factual question. A verifier answers it from the source images without seeing either candidate or evidence record, and a reasoner uses this observation to resolve the original question. With a frozen Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct backbone, DoubleTake achieves the highest overall accuracy among the evaluated methods on each of four benchmarks. With the same pages and number of model calls, asking a focused factual question yields higher accuracy on all four benchmarks than asking the original question again. Our code is available at this https URL.

AI.tldr: DoubleTake通过针对性核验源图像中的事实，在无需训练的情况下改善长文档问答。
AI.motivation: 即使检索页面已包含充分证据，视觉语言模型仍会答错，而重复原问题无法明确需要核查的事实。
AI.method: 两轮阅读生成候选答案与证据，规划器提出事实问题，由不见候选答案和证据记录的核验器读取源图像后辅助裁决。
