title: On the Limits of Sufficient Explanations
summary: We formally characterize the conditions under which sufficient explanations exist for classifiers on structured data such as graphs and strings. We focus on post-hoc explainers that select parts of the input as sufficient explanations. An explanation is sufficient if the selected part alone ensures the predicted label. Sufficient explanations have been widely adopted across data modalities, including graphs, strings, and images. However, a unified formal analysis of sufficient explanations remains missing. We bridge this gap with four main contributions: (i) We define a general explanation formalism consisting of an instance space, a classifier, and a select relation. The select relation specifies which potential sub-instances or feature subsets can be selected as explanations from each instance; (ii) We show that the existence of sufficient explainers is fully characterized by the interplay between the classifier and the select relation; (iii) We extend this analysis to practically relevant variants of sufficiency, including probabilistic sufficiency and deletion sufficiency; (iv) Based on the formal analysis, we devise statistics that bound the maximum achievable sufficiency for a given task. We evaluate these statistics on language, protein, and molecular classification datasets and find that full sufficiency is unattainable on most of them. Since these bounds hold for every explainer, they provide a task-level reference against which any explainer's sufficiency can be judged in absolute terms.

AI.tldr: 研究形式化刻画充分解释的存在条件，并发现多数受测分类任务无法实现完全充分性。
AI.motivation: 充分解释已广泛用于多种数据模态，但仍缺少统一分析其存在条件与能力边界的形式化框架。
AI.method: 以实例空间、分类器和选择关系建立框架，扩展至概率及删除充分性，并构造任务级充分性上界统计量。
AI.result: 充分解释是否存在由分类器与选择关系共同决定；语言、蛋白质和分子数据上的多数任务无法达到完全充分性。
AI.conclusion: 适用于所有解释器的任务级上界，可为评价解释充分性提供绝对参照。

title: Detection and Classification in Latent Spaces: High-Dimensional Analysis and Validation
summary: Foundation models produce high-dimensional latent representations in which suitably designed statistical decision rules can be effective yet analytically tractable. We study such detectors in the high-dimensional regime, where latent dimension and training sample size grow proportionally. For linear and quadratic statistics, we derive explicit large-deviation characterizations of false-alarm and miss-detection performance under the Neyman-Pearson paradigm, and show how the binary analysis extends to multi-class classification. The resulting error probabilities and corresponding decay rates exhibit non-monotonic dependence on the shape parameter, including double-descent and, in some regimes, multiple-descent. Experiments on vision, text, and audio datasets using modern foundation models show close agreement between theoretical predictions and empirical performance. In particular, the proposed framework allows us to set a prescribed false-alarm level and accurately predict the corresponding miss-detection probability. Overall, our results provide a theoretically grounded and interpretable framework with competitive empirical performance across different modalities.

AI.tldr: 研究为基础模型高维潜在空间中的检测与分类建立可预测错误概率的理论框架。
AI.motivation: 基础模型潜在表示维度高，需要兼具统计有效性、可分析性与可解释性的决策规则。
AI.method: 在维度与样本量同比增长下，推导线性及二次统计量的奈曼—皮尔逊大偏差表征，并扩展至多分类。
AI.result: 错误概率及衰减率呈双下降或多下降，视觉、文本和音频实验与理论预测接近，并能准确预测指定误报率下的漏检率。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为跨模态检测与分类提供理论依据和可解释分析，同时具有竞争性的实证表现。

title: ALoMa: Affine Correspondences Beyond Patches
summary: Affine correspondences (ACs) enable robust and efficient solvers for multiple-view geometry by constraining the local geometry of point correspondences (PCs). Despite their utility in minimal solvers, AC estimation remains understudied. We revisit AC estimation beyond local image patches, extending it to the image and image-pair levels. Rather than estimating the components of the affine transformation separately, we learn the full 4-DoF matrix jointly. Building on this formulation, we introduce ALoMa, an AC estimator using LoMa keypoint descriptions, demonstrating consistent improvements across a wide range of downstream tasks. Code at this https URL.

AI.tldr: ALoMa将仿射对应估计从局部图像块扩展至图像及图像对层面，改善多种下游任务表现。
AI.motivation: 仿射对应有助于高效稳健地求解多视几何，但其估计方法仍缺乏研究。
AI.method: 利用LoMa关键点描述，联合学习完整的四自由度仿射矩阵，而非分别估计各分量。
AI.result: ALoMa在广泛的下游任务中取得一致改进。
AI.conclusion: 超越局部图像块并联合估计仿射矩阵，是改善仿射对应估计的有效方向。

title: STaG: Human-Annotation-Free Unsupervised Domain Adaptation for Text-Based Person Retrieval
summary: Real-world deployment of Text-Based Person Retrieval (TBPR) is bottlenecked by the absence of textual annotations in new domains. Existing Unsupervised Domain Adaptation (UDA-TBPR) methods still assume access to target-domain human-written annotations (albeit unpaired with images), limiting their practicality. We consider a more practical setting: human-annotation-free UDA-TBPR, with labeled image-text data in the source domain and annotation-free, unlabeled images in the target domain. This setting introduces two core challenges: the absence of cross-modal alignment in the target domain, and visual domain shifts from source to target. To tackle these, we propose STaG, a dual-path framework comprising Style-Agnostic Text Alignment (SATA) and Heterogeneous Graph Memory Alignment (HGMA). Specifically, SATA leverages source-domain data to decouple identity-discriminative semantics from machine-generated stylistic artifacts, establishing robust cross-modal alignment for the target domain. Meanwhile, HGMA exploits cross-domain semantic neighborhoods via a memory-based graph to learn domain-invariant visual features. Ultimately, STaG achieves state-of-the-art performance across three benchmarks under this realistic setting.

AI.tldr: STaG在目标域完全无人类标注的条件下，实现文本行人检索的无监督域适应。
AI.motivation: 现有方法仍依赖目标域人工文本，难以应对无文本标注、跨模态失配及视觉域偏移。
AI.method: 结合风格无关文本对齐与异构图记忆对齐，分别学习稳健跨模态关系和域不变视觉特征。
AI.result: STaG在该无人类标注设定下的三个基准上均达到最先进性能。
AI.conclusion: 双路径对齐为无需目标域人工标注的文本行人检索提供了有效方案。

title: Safety Certificates for Systems under Attack via Stackelberg Set Games
summary: We study a Stackelberg set selection game for linear systems subject to bounded disturbances and additive attacks. The defender selects the vector parameter of a polytopic safe set template; the attacker, after observing this choice, selects the vector parameter of an admissible attack set. The payoff is a signed, facet-normalised invariance margin that tests invariance exactly and quantifies either the available contraction or the facet inflation needed when invariance fails. Both controlled and robust controlled invariance are treated, corresponding to different information patterns for the control input. Exploiting the structure of parameterised polyhedra, we show that within each validity region the margin is concave in the attack parameter, which reduces the follower minimisation to finitely many extreme parameters. The complete max--min game is then solved by a finite family of LPs, one per defender validity region, each enforcing all attacker regions under a common defender decision and guaranteed margin. The framework handles hard state constraints and additional costs related to the safe set size, and recovers optimal set parameters together with state and attack realisations that activate the certificate. A load frequency control example under false data injection illustrates the construction, the validity decomposition, and the two information patterns.

AI.tldr: 通过Stackelberg集合博弈，为受扰动与加性攻击的线性系统构建安全证书。
AI.motivation: 需在攻击者可响应防御决策时，确定安全集并精确量化系统的不变性裕度。
AI.method: 定义带符号的面归一化不变性裕度，利用分区域凹性将最大最小博弈化为有限组线性规划。
AI.result: 证明攻击者最小化可归约至有限极端参数，并通过线性规划获得最优集合参数及证书激活实例。
AI.conclusion: 该框架兼顾两种控制信息模式、硬状态约束及安全集规模成本，并以负荷频率控制示例说明。

title: ESI: An Embodied Self-Improvement Flywheel for LLM-VLA Agents
summary: Independently pretrained language models and vision-language-action (VLA) policies provide complementary building blocks for embodied agents, but connecting them does not automatically produce coordinated behavior. The VLA may generate actions that diverge from the LLM's intended subtask and, upon regaining control after a correction, undo the promising state restored by the LLM. We introduce ESI (Embodied Self-Improvement), an automated flywheel that uses environmental interaction to align reasoning and action. ESI treats the modular agent as the unit of post-training, repeatedly refining the prompts that guide the LLM, the shared skill interface that expresses its intent, and the VLA parameters that realize that intent, then redeploying these components together. Our key insight is that collaboration itself can supply supervision for improving this interface. The LLM's subtask decisions provide semantic supervision for what the policy should execute, while its effective corrections and subsequent student continuations provide action-level supervision for recovery and handoff. The student also learns from its own effective execution, allowing locally useful experience to contribute even when the overall episode fails. On ten selected RoboDojo tasks, ESI achieves a mean Score of 62.03 and a mean success rate of 49.41% using an LLM-VLA agent without generating task-specific control code. On both metrics, it outperforms the published reference results of all hybrid embodied agents, including the Agent+WAM system GO-3 Nano Preview (47.27 Score and 36.60% success), as well as all compared code-based methods.
comment: Technical report. 25 pages, 7 figures. Code: this https URL

AI.tldr: ESI通过环境交互联合改进LLM与VLA模块，使具身智能体的推理和动作更协调。
AI.motivation: 独立预训练的LLM与VLA可能意图不一致，且策略接管后可能破坏纠错恢复的状态。
AI.method: 迭代优化LLM提示、共享技能接口及VLA参数，利用子任务决策、纠错、接管和有效执行提供监督。
AI.result: 在十项选定RoboDojo任务上平均得分62.03、成功率49.41%，两项均超过所比较方法。
AI.conclusion: 将模块化智能体整体作为后训练对象，可在不生成任务专用控制代码的情况下改善协作表现。

title: Explanations that Transfer: Interpreting Medical Retrieval with Sparse AutoEncoders
summary: Medical AI systems that answer users' queries rely on retrieving medical knowledge from large document collections. In this context, finetuning general models on medical datasets can improve retrieval relevance. Yet the dense embeddings underlying modern retrieval systems remain largely opaque, making it difficult to understand the mechanics behind their results. Moreover, adapting to a specific medical dataset risks losing transferability to new clinical corpora. In this work, we tackle these issues by applying Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) to medical information retrieval, transforming dense text embeddings into semantically interpretable representations. To do so, our model combines a reconstruction objective with an InfoNCE contrastive loss that directly preserves query-document relevance. We evaluate three embedding models across six medical retrieval datasets, both in-domain and out-of-domain. Trained on a medical corpus, our sparse codes improve in-domain retrieval over the original embeddings, and lose less out-of-domain performance than their dense counterparts, especially when the target corpus is distant from the training one. Importantly, our experiments show that the method yields interpretable features whose semantic content can be inferred from the queries and documents that activate them most strongly. The interpretation of these features sheds light on why a particular document was retrieved, and transfers beyond the training distribution.

AI.tldr: 稀疏自编码器将医学检索的稠密嵌入转化为可解释且更具跨域迁移性的稀疏表示。
AI.motivation: 医学检索的稠密嵌入难以解释，且针对特定语料微调可能损害跨语料泛化。
AI.method: 结合重构目标与InfoNCE对比损失训练稀疏自编码器，在保留查询文档相关性的同时学习稀疏特征。
AI.result: 在三种嵌入模型和六个数据集上，稀疏表示改善域内检索、减少域外性能损失，并呈现可解释特征。
AI.conclusion: 稀疏特征既能解释文档被检索的原因，其语义解释也能迁移至训练分布之外。

title: LaMe: a Joint Latent Mediation Framework for High-Dimensional Systems
summary: Mediation analysis seeks to understand how an exposure influences an outcome through intermediate variables. However, as increasingly rich datasets become available, hundreds to thousands of potential mediators make these systems difficult to model and hard to interpret. Latent-variable approaches offer a natural way to accommodate these high-dimensional settings. However, existing latent mediation methods face limitations, including overparameterization, biased inference, or limited scalability. We develop LaMe, a joint linear-Gaussian framework that summarizes a high-dimensional exposure-mediator-outcome system through a small number of latent variables. We identify natural direct and indirect effects under an explicit assumption that the manifest measurements fully capture the latent mediators, and characterize conditions under which the latent representation effectively restricts the observed cross-covariance structure. Simulations assess recovery of observed association parameters, natural effects, and manifest features associated with latent mediation pathways across a range of challenging settings. Four real-world applications demonstrate competitive predictive performance with compact latent representations, including single-dimensional representations of biomarker and proteomic measurements. Together, these results establish LaMe as a practical framework for estimating and summarizing multivariate mediation systems under explicit structural and measurement assumptions.

AI.tldr: LaMe以紧凑潜变量联合建模高维中介系统，并在明确假设下估计直接与间接效应。
AI.motivation: 大量候选中介使建模和解释困难，而现有潜变量方法存在参数过多、推断偏差或扩展性限制。
AI.method: 构建联合线性高斯框架，在观测完全捕获潜在中介的假设下识别自然效应并刻画交叉协方差约束。
AI.result: 四项实际应用显示，紧凑潜表示具有竞争性预测性能，部分生物标志物和蛋白组测量可用单维表示。
AI.conclusion: LaMe为在明确结构与测量假设下估计和概括多变量中介系统提供了实用框架。

title: PTMTD: A Topology-Aware Temporal-Graph Attention Network for Joint Cyber-Attack Detection and Relay-Level Localization in Power System Protection Networks
summary: The digitization of protection relays exposes power grids to sophisticated cyberattacks, yet existing GNN detectors omit temporal encoding, rely on static topologies, and lack relay localization. We propose PTMTD-a Pearson-driven Temporal Multimodal Topology-aware Detection Network-coupling a dilated TCN with multi-head GATv2 in a dual-head architecture for simultaneous 37-class detection and four-relay localization. PTMTD constructs its graph from measurement correlations (no impedance data) and is trained with a composite loss jointly optimizing both tasks. On the MSU-ORNL benchmark (78,377 samples, 37 classes), it achieves 99.27% accuracy, 99.25% macro F1, and 95.98% localization, outperforming GraphKAN, LSTM, GCN, and Random Forest by 5.64-11.15 percentage points (p < 0.05). Ablations confirm gains from temporal encoding (+2.38%), graph attention (+2.69%), residuals (+2.07%), and correlation-driven supervision. With 639k parameters and 2.5 ms CPU inference, PTMTD is lightweight and deployment-ready. While validated on a transmission testbed, the architecture applies to microgrids with similar relay structures. Code and models are publicly available.

AI.tldr: PTMTD联合建模时间与相关性拓扑，实现电力保护网络的网络攻击检测及继电器级定位。
AI.motivation: 现有图神经网络检测器缺少时间编码、依赖静态拓扑，且无法定位受攻击继电器。
AI.method: 利用测量相关性构图，结合膨胀时序卷积、多头GATv2及双任务损失，完成37类检测和四继电器定位。
AI.result: 在MSU-ORNL上准确率99.27%、宏F1为99.25%、定位率95.98%，CPU推理耗时2.5毫秒。
AI.conclusion: 该轻量架构在输电测试平台上表现优异，并可应用于具有相似继电器结构的微电网。

title: NPU-Accelerated GNSS Signal Acquisition
summary: On small single-board computers (SBCs), GNSS signal acquisition is a major CPU load. This paper proposes using the neural processing unit (NPU) of an SBC not for machine learning but as an accelerator for the parallel code search in GNSS signal acquisition. The discrete Fourier transform (DFT) used in acquisition is decomposed by the four-step DFT into matrix products of small DFTs and expressed by $1\times1$ convolutions, element-wise products, and transposes, which NPUs execute efficiently. Furthermore, we propose a method that divides the DFT, the non-coherent integration, and the peak detection between the CPU and the NPU according to the configuration of the NPU (an NPU with its own memory connected via PCIe, or an NPU sharing memory with the CPU). The proposed method is implemented in the open-source software GNSS receiver Pocket SDR and evaluated on a Raspberry Pi 5 combined with the external AX8850 NPU and on the NPU built into the SoC (RK3588) of the ROCK 5C, a small SBC of comparable size. Compared with acquisition by an optimized CPU implementation, the acquisition of short codes on the Raspberry Pi 5 with the AX8850 is 3.0-3.8 times faster. In the evaluation of the whole receiver, the number of tracking channels that reach their first lock within 30 s with the NPU is 1.5 times that with the CPU, and the time until 90% of the channels are locked is reduced from 66 s to 26 s. Furthermore, because the CPU load of acquisition is reduced, the number of tracking channels that can be processed in real time increases from about 175 to about 230. These results show that using the NPU on SBCs with limited CPU resources is effective for achieving both GNSS signal acquisition and tracking. The implementation is publicly available as open source under the name PocketSDR-NPU.

AI.tldr: 将单板计算机的NPU用于非机器学习的GNSS并行码搜索，可加快捕获并释放CPU跟踪资源。
AI.motivation: GNSS信号捕获占用大量CPU资源，限制小型单板计算机的接收机性能。
AI.method: 将四步DFT分解映射为NPU高效算子，并按内存架构在CPU与NPU之间分配变换、积分和峰值检测。
AI.result: 树莓派5搭配AX8850短码捕获提速3.0—3.8倍，90%通道锁定时间由66秒降至26秒。
AI.conclusion: NPU加速可同时改善GNSS捕获与跟踪，实时跟踪通道数由约175增至约230。

title: SemRAG: Semantic-Guided Sentence-Level Retrieval-Augmented Sign Language Production
summary: Sign language production (SLP) aims to generate sign pose sequences that faithfully express spoken-language text while preserving the rhythm and coordination patterns of signing. Common SLP methods learn text-to-pose mappings from training data but often suffer from semantic inaccuracies in long or complex sentences. Retrieval augmentation offers a way to introduce realistic signing priors to provide more explicit guidance for text-to-pose generation. However, existing retrieval-based SLP methods typically operate at the gloss or word level, relying on gloss-pose dictionaries or isolated sign segments that require costly annotations and fail to preserve continuous sentence-level dynamics. To bridge this gap, we propose SemRAG, a semantic-guided sentence-level retrieval-augmented framework that retrieves full-sentence signing templates as priors without constructing gloss/word-level sign dictionaries. While such templates preserve local motion patterns and global rhythm, they also introduce a semantic mismatch problem: irrelevant motions in the retrieved sentence may interfere with the target semantics. To address this issue, we introduce an SLT-guided template semantic localization module that identifies target-relevant temporal regions within the retrieved template while suppressing irrelevant signing content. To adaptively incorporate the template features into the generator, we further introduce layer-specific learnable gates that regulate their contribution across generator layers. Extensive experiments show that SemRAG improves semantic consistency and motion quality over baselines under both back-translation and motion accuracy metrics.

AI.tldr: SemRAG通过语义引导的整句手语检索增强生成，改善语义一致性与动作质量。
AI.motivation: 现有手语生成易在复杂长句上出现语义偏差，而词级检索依赖昂贵标注且难以保留连续动态。
AI.method: 检索整句手语模板，以手语翻译引导模块定位相关时段，并用分层可学习门控调节模板特征。
AI.result: 实验显示，SemRAG在回译与动作精度指标上优于基线，提升语义一致性和动作质量。
AI.conclusion: 整句模板结合语义定位与自适应融合，可在无需词级手语字典的情况下有效增强手语生成。

title: MarathonTS: a benchmark of long synthetic time series from window assembly and long-series generators
summary: Many applications of synthetic time series require a series that is much longer than the windows on which a generative model is trained. Such a series can be assembled from a pool of short generated windows, which requires deciding which windows are taken, in what order, and how their seams are processed, or it can be produced directly by a long-series generator. This study presents MarathonTS, to our knowledge the first open benchmark that compares both families under one protocol. Every method produces a series of the same length on 9 open hourly datasets with 10 seeds. The series is evaluated by its fidelity to the real data (83 metrics in 12 groups, against three real references: train, validation and an out-of-time split), by its utility (models are trained on the synthetic series only and tested on real data, TSTR against TRTR, in 14 classification and regression tasks), by its memorisation of the training data and by its computational cost. The statistical analysis is carried out as a separate stage that reads the published tables and gives the rankings of every method in every slice, the answers to the research questions with tests and uncertainty, and the results of a pre-specified confirmatory family. In the main run, the methods differ in both confirmatory cells; the choice of windows matters more than the processing of their seams, which does not improve the series, and no method trains the downstream models as well as the real series. The top tier of the leaderboard is reproduced on other hardware, whereas the exact places within it are not. For the reproducibility of the study, the code, the data hashes and all results are publicly available (links below).

AI.tldr: MarathonTS以统一协议比较短窗口拼接与长序列直接生成，揭示窗口选择比接缝处理更重要。
AI.motivation: 实际应用需要超出训练窗口长度的合成时间序列，但两类生成方案缺少统一比较基准。
AI.method: 在9个小时级数据集上使用10个随机种子，统一评估保真度、下游效用、训练数据记忆和计算成本。
AI.result: 窗口选择影响大于接缝处理，后者未带来改善，且所有方法的下游训练效果均不及真实序列。
AI.conclusion: 该开放基准支持长合成序列的系统比较，领先方法群体可跨硬件复现，但其内部名次不稳定。

title: Data-Driven Sparse Identification and Robust Tube-Based Predictive Control for Multivariable Chaotic Systems
summary: This paper addresses the data-driven synchronization and robust control of multivariable chaotic systems subject to strict actuation constraints, modeling uncertainties and bounded input disturbances. Using empirical data collected from a four-dimensional chaotic Rossler response system, Sequentially Thresholded Least Squares (STLSQ) sparse regression is employed to recover a nominal control-affine model, achieving an identification accuracy of R^2 = 1.0000 across all channels with root-mean-square error within [4.15e-6, 8.33e-4]. To establish a mathematically rigorous bridge between data-driven identification and robust synthesis, all structural discrepancies in the drift vector field and input matrix are unified into a single lumped uncertainty field delta(x,u). A computable scalar bound delta_bar is established based on library truncation error, regression residuals, input bounds, and Lipschitz constants (Lemma 1). We subsequently prove that input-output feedback linearization maps delta(x,u) into a state- and control-dependent additive disturbance d(z,nu) in Brunovsky canonical coordinates, bounded by ||d(z,nu)||_2 <= alpha_1 delta_bar + alpha_2 delta_bar ||nu||_2 with closed-form expressions for alpha_1 and alpha_2 (Theorem 1). This certified bound, together with a bounded input disturbance and a zero-order-hold margin, yields a compact disturbance set that seeds a robust tube-based model predictive controller. We prove that the resulting tightened quadratic program is recursively feasible, that the physical actuator limit (|u_i| <= 1100) remains inactive under an explicit sufficient condition, and that the closed-loop tracking error is Input-to-State Stable (ISS) with an asymptotic gain that is linear in delta_bar plus a term due to the exogenous input disturbance (Theorems 2 and 3).

AI.tldr: 研究将稀疏数据辨识与鲁棒管束预测控制衔接，为受约束混沌系统提供误差界与稳定性保证。
AI.motivation: 多变量混沌系统的同步控制需同时应对严格执行器约束、建模不确定性和有界输入扰动。
AI.method: 利用STLSQ辨识四维Rössler系统，将结构误差统一有界化，经反馈线性化构建鲁棒管束预测控制器。
AI.result: 各通道辨识R²为1.0000，均方根误差为4.15×10⁻⁶至8.33×10⁻⁴，并证明递归可行性与输入到状态稳定性。
AI.conclusion: 可计算的不确定性界建立了数据辨识与鲁棒控制的理论联系，并在充分条件下保证执行器限幅不激活。

title: T2ST: Data-Efficient Spatio-Temporal Foundation Models via Temporal Data and Knowledge Transfer
summary: Spatio-temporal foundation models (STFMs) require large-scale training corpora, yet synchronized observations and spatial metadata are costly to acquire and curate, limiting the availability of suitable data. By contrast, time-series data are abundant and easier to collect. Since observations at each location form a time series, this motivates a natural question: can abundant time-series data enhance STFMs when spatio-temporal observations are scarce? To bridge this gap, we propose T2ST, a data-efficient training framework that augments limited spatio-temporal observations with selected auxiliary time series and transfers knowledge from a frozen time-series foundation model. Our key insight is that temporal pattern learning can benefit from abundant external time series, while spatial dependency learning remains grounded in real spatio-temporal observations. Guided by this insight, T2ST retrieves matched sequences to reinforce sparsely observed temporal patterns and selects reliable complementary sequences to broaden temporal coverage. Temporal relation distillation aligns relationships among historical patches, while multi-scale prediction distillation transfers forecasting behavior at fine and coarse temporal resolutions, enabling knowledge transfer across heterogeneous architectures. Using only 10\% of the original spatio-temporal data, T2ST enables STFMs to achieve overall forecasting performance competitive with or superior to their full-data counterparts across six long-term and twelve short-term forecasting datasets. These results establish a new paradigm for data-efficient training of spatio-temporal foundation models. Code is available at this https URL.

AI.tldr: T2ST利用辅助时间序列和冻结模型的知识迁移，以少量时空数据训练高效时空基础模型。
AI.motivation: 时空基础模型依赖大量同步观测和空间元数据，而这些数据获取昂贵，普通时间序列则更丰富。
AI.method: 检索匹配及互补时间序列，并通过时间关系蒸馏和多尺度预测蒸馏迁移冻结时间序列基础模型的知识。
AI.result: 仅用10%的原始时空数据，在6个长期和12个短期预测数据集上达到接近或优于全数据模型的总体表现。
AI.conclusion: 外部时间序列与跨架构知识迁移可有效降低时空基础模型对真实时空训练数据的需求。

title: From Pen-and-Paper to Machine-Checked Proofs: Lean for System Identification
summary: Mathematical proofs in scientific papers are often long and intricate, relying on chains of references to earlier results. This makes it difficult for readers and reviewers to verify each and every step. Interactive theorem proving offers a complement: the theorem and its proof are written as code, and every inference is checked by a small, trusted piece of software called the kernel. This paper serves as an introduction to the Lean 4 proof assistant for a system identification and control audience, assuming no prior exposure to formal methods. We first show how a Lean proof is read using two elementary examples: the first on identifiability, the second on set invariance. We then illustrate how Lean can be used to analyse results from the literature, taking as example a classic lemma on the inversion of the noise filter in prediction-error identification (Ljung, 1999, Lemma 3.1). Since in Lean every step must be justified, the formalization brings to light a subtle point: the original claim of that lemma holds almost surely, although not for every realisation, as its statement may suggest. A simple counterexample makes this concrete. Finally, the paper discusses guidelines and perspectives on the use of Lean in system identification research.

AI.tldr: 论文面向系统辨识与控制研究介绍Lean 4，并通过形式化核查发现经典引理的陈述需澄清。
AI.motivation: 科学论文中的复杂证明依赖多层引用，读者和审稿人难以逐步核验其正确性。
AI.method: 通过可辨识性、集合不变性示例介绍Lean证明，再形式化分析预测误差辨识中的噪声滤波器求逆引理。
AI.result: 形式化揭示该经典引理仅几乎处处成立，而非对每个实现成立，并给出简单反例。
AI.conclusion: 交互式定理证明可辅助核验系统辨识结论，揭示传统文字证明中容易忽略的条件与细节。

title: Characterisation of the DQsym Framework Against Harmonic State-Space and Dynamic Phasor Models for Modular Multilevel Converters
summary: Modern power systems rely on power converters that exhibit multifrequency periodic dynamics, such as modular multilevel converters (MMCs). Such converters are commonly analysed using harmonic state-space (HSS) and dynamic phasor (DP) representations. Both approaches rely on building state matrices based on the system topology, whose size grows with the number of harmonics retained in the model. This paper shows that a symmetrical direct-quadrature (dq) dynamic phasor formulation for time-domain simulation, named DQsym, has a smaller solver state matrix than HSS and DP, and whose size is independent of the truncation order K. This reduction results from evaluating harmonic coupling outside the state matrix, in the nonlinear signal blocks. The open-loop MMC model used in this paper is derived in three harmonic-domain (HD) formulations and validated against a three-phase time-domain reference model. The models are compared in terms of state-space size and sparsity, harmonic content, steady-state accuracy and eigenvalues. For truncation at K = 4, the DQsym solver has 45 states against 135 for HSS and DP, stays within about 4% of the reference, and, once closed with its coupling blocks, yields eigenvalues identical to those of HSS and DP.
comment: Submitted to the 25th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission

AI.tldr: DQsym将谐波耦合移至非线性信号模块，以更小且不随截断阶数增长的求解器状态矩阵建模换流器。
AI.motivation: 模块化多电平换流器具有多频周期动态，传统谐波状态空间与动态相量模型规模随谐波数量增长。
AI.method: 推导三种谐波域开环模型，对照三相时域参考模型比较状态规模、稀疏性、谐波、稳态精度和特征值。
AI.result: 截断阶数为4时，DQsym仅需45个状态而对照方法需135个，误差约在4%内，闭合耦合后特征值相同。
AI.conclusion: DQsym在保持参考精度及相同特征值的同时，显著缩减了换流器仿真的求解器状态规模。

title: A Reinforcement Learning Approach to Space-Filling Input Design for Nonlinear System Identification
summary: In this paper, we propose a reinforcement learning (RL) approach to space-filling input design for nonlinear system identification, in which an agent learns a control policy that actively drives the system to explore its state space. Classical input design, developed mainly for linear models, minimises the covariance of the estimated parameters. For nonlinear black-box models, however, the dominant error is the bias induced by the model structure over the region of interest, which motivates space-filling strategies that seek to cover the system state space. Existing space-filling approaches rely on predefined input signal classes and require solving explicit optimisation problems. Unlike these methods, the proposed approach requires no input class to be selected and no frequency band to be tuned for the system at hand, satisfies an amplitude bound by construction, and adapts to varying initial conditions through its observation-based policy without re-optimisation. The learned excitation signals exhibit physically meaningful behaviours, such as resonance excitation and amplitude modulation. The approach is evaluated against tuned swept sine and crest-factor-optimised multisine excitations, and against a state-of-the-art space-filling multisine design, on two nonlinear benchmark systems: a mass-spring-damper with nonlinear stiffness and a Van der Pol oscillator. Under the same amplitude bound, the learned policy achieves the best overall space-filling performance on both systems and distributes its samples more uniformly than the state-of-the-art design.

AI.tldr: 研究通过强化学习设计非线性系统辨识的空间填充输入，在两个基准系统上优于对照激励。
AI.motivation: 非线性黑箱辨识需要充分覆盖状态空间，而现有空间填充设计依赖预设输入类别和显式优化。
AI.method: 训练基于观测的控制策略主动探索状态空间，直接满足幅值限制，无需选择输入类别或调节频带。
AI.result: 在非线性弹簧质量阻尼系统和范德波尔振子上，策略取得最佳总体空间填充表现，采样分布也更均匀。
AI.conclusion: 强化学习可生成具有共振激励和幅度调制行为的输入，并无需重新优化即可适应不同初始条件。

title: Personalization of Basic and Moral Values Guiding LLM-Controlled Assistant Robots
summary: Personal assistant robots powered by large language models (LLMs) are likely to enter everyday life within the next decade, but the values that should guide their behaviour remain largely unspecified. Current alignment practice steers a single model toward an aggregate of human values, ignoring that individual users may prefer a robot whose value profile differs from their own. We administer parallel self- and robot-targeted versions of three established psycho-metric instruments - the simplified Schwartz Values Survey (SVS), the Portrait Values Questionnaire (PVQ-21), and the Moral Foundations Questionnaire (MFQ) - to potential future users (N=22), capturing both their personal values and the values they would want an assistant robot to embody. We compare the three instruments as personalization tools using the UEQ-S and benchmark fifteen contemporary LLMs against the resulting profiles. Participants wanted their robot to score markedly lower than themselves on personal-focus values and higher on social-focus values; moral profiles were nearly identical. LLMs prompted to act as robots shifted only weakly toward the desired profile, indicating that default model behaviour and prompt engineering are no substitute for explicit value personalization.
comment: 18 pages, 6 figures. Version accepted for publication in: Value Engineering in Artificial Intelligence: Fourth Inter-national Workshop, VALE 2026, Bremen, Germany, August 15, 2026, Proceedings. Work-shop affiliated with 35th International Joint Conference on Artificial Intelligence (IJCAI-ECAI 2026)

AI.tldr: 用户期望助手机器人的价值观不同于自身，而默认大模型与角色提示难以充分满足这种偏好。
AI.motivation: 现有对齐通常面向聚合人类价值，却忽视用户可能希望机器人具备不同于自身的价值配置。
AI.method: 对22名潜在用户开展三种量表的自我与机器人版本调查，比较个性化工具体验并评测15个大模型。
AI.result: 用户希望机器人更弱化个人取向、强化社会取向，道德配置则接近自身；机器人角色提示仅带来微弱调整。
AI.conclusion: 助手机器人的价值对齐需要显式个性化，不能仅依靠模型默认行为或提示工程。

title: NeoResearch: Literature- and Experience-Guided Autonomous Time Series Model Discovery
summary: Developing effective forecasting models for diverse time-series domains requires substantial expert knowledge, evidence from scientific literature on the web, and iterative experimentation. However, translating this knowledge and research experience into model designs requires preserving source context and testing applicability under task-specific assumptions. In this paper, we propose NeoResearch, a literature- and experience-guided autonomous research framework that leverages large language models (LLMs) as researchers to discover lightweight, domain-specific forecasting models. Specifically, NeoResearch establishes an expert-inspired dual-loop research workflow, coupling hypothesis-driven architecture exploration with iterative training and hyperparameter optimization through experimental feedback. To enable knowledge-grounded discovery, the agent autonomously mines scientific literature from the Web, extracting modeling mechanisms, empirical evidence, and applicability conditions to formulate task-grounded, testable architecture hypotheses. Furthermore, a hierarchical experience memory links literature findings to experimental outcomes and consolidates conditional lessons, guiding architecture discovery and training optimization while supporting reuse across forecasting tasks. Experiments on ten datasets show competitive performance and support dual loops, literature extraction, and memory reuse. Our code is available.

AI.tldr: NeoResearch结合文献证据与实验经验，自主发现轻量级领域专用时间序列预测模型。
AI.motivation: 预测模型设计依赖专家知识与反复实验，且文献知识转化需保留来源语境并检验任务适用性。
AI.method: 以大语言模型驱动架构探索与训练优化双循环，并用文献挖掘和分层经验记忆指导研究。
AI.result: 十个数据集上的实验显示性能具有竞争力，并支持双循环、文献提取和记忆复用的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 结合有依据的架构假设与可复用实验经验，可支持跨预测任务的自主模型发现。

title: Small Is Not Dead: Distance-Aware Cluster Revival for e-means
summary: e-means (Bessa et al., 2026) is a recent mini-batch k-means algorithm, now part of the FAISS library, that reaches the error of Lloyd's algorithm about an order of magnitude faster on large embedding datasets. Every five mini-batches, it removes every cluster whose running point count falls below a tenth of the average and reuses its centre to split a large cluster. In the authors' ablation, removing this mechanism, called dead-cluster revival, raises the error more than removing any other component added to the moving-average update. The rule, however, considers only cluster size: it cannot distinguish a cluster that is small because it is redundant from one that covers a rare, isolated group of points, and on data with such groups it repeatedly removes centres whose removal is costly. We add a second condition, based on the distance between centres: a small cluster is removed only if its centre is close to another centre, relative to a running estimate of the mean squared error. When a centre equals the mean of its points, this squared distance is an upper bound on the average increase in squared error, per point of the cluster, caused by removing the centre. The condition costs one nearest-centre search for the small clusters every five mini-batches and adds no measurable running time. On the e-means paper's embedding benchmarks, it never prevents a removal, so the results are identical to those of FAISS. On datasets with small isolated groups not used during development, it reduces the test error after two epochs by roughly 10% to 80% relative to count-based revival, and it preserves the advantage of k-means++ initialization; on the other evaluation datasets, it stays within about 1% of the better of revival enabled and disabled. We also report two failure modes that the analysis predicts. This is a CPU proof of concept; GPU implementations are left to future work.

AI.tldr: 为e-means的小簇复活机制加入中心距离条件，避免误删覆盖稀有孤立点群的簇。
AI.motivation: 仅按簇大小删除中心无法区分冗余小簇与重要孤立小簇，可能反复造成较大误差。
AI.method: 仅当小簇中心相对运行均方误差足够接近其他中心时才删除，并分析距离对应的误差上界。
AI.result: 孤立小群数据上两轮训练后测试误差降低约10%至80%，原嵌入基准结果不变且无可测耗时增加。
AI.conclusion: 距离感知复活可保护重要小簇，但存在两类预测到的失效模式，目前仅完成CPU概念验证。

title: Neural Classifiers as Error-Correcting Codes
summary: A unified framework is proposed that characterizes supervised deep classification as the decoding of error-correcting codes in the Shannon sense. Cross-entropy optimization is shown to align softmax classifiers with maximum-likelihood decoding, where logits map to Hamming distances to class-specific codewords. This correspondence explains the emergence of standard divergence objectives (e.g., Kullback-Leibler, Jeffreys) and provides a geometric basis for the stability of decision boundaries. Furthermore, the geometries of Neural Collapse and LeJEPA are identified as optimal constellations for decoding under isotropic noise. Unlike classical Error-Correcting Output Codes, deep networks are shown to learn effective codebooks in the feature space implicitly. This insight is leveraged to derive novel criteria for lossless quantization, improved knowledge distillation, and architectural regularization based on code redundancy. Finally, this perspective is extended to self-supervised encoders, offering a cohesive explanation for the geometry of latent representations in modern neural models.
comment: 40 pages, 6 figures. Submitted version. Published in Information Sciences 766 (2027) 124394

AI.tldr: 提出将深度监督分类统一解释为香农意义下纠错码解码的理论框架。
AI.motivation: 需要统一解释深度分类的损失目标、决策边界稳定性及特征表示几何。
AI.method: 将交叉熵与最大似然解码对应，并将分类器逻辑值映射为到类别码字的汉明距离。
AI.result: 揭示神经坍缩与LeJEPA几何是各向同性噪声下的最优解码星座，并推导量化、蒸馏与正则化准则。
AI.conclusion: 深度网络在特征空间隐式学习有效码本，纠错码视角也可统一解释自监督表示几何。

title: SCAR: Bridging Coarse Retrieval and Fine Localization through Candidate Reranking
summary: Natural-language point-cloud localization typically retrieves candidate map cells and then predicts a position inside each candidate, yet the final output is still determined by retrieval order. A retrieval score measures region-description relevance, not whether the coordinates a region yields are accurate: a relevant region may produce a displaced prediction, and a lower-ranked region may contain a successful one. We study the final selection problem after the candidate pool and Fine predictions are fixed---how to choose the coordinate most likely to localize successfully, and under which conditions the gain holds. We propose SCAR (Spatial Consistency-Aware Reranking). SCAR treats each cell--Fine-coordinate pair as a localization hypothesis, interprets directional relations as functions of position, and reads spatial support at the backbone's actual Fine point (Fine-conditioned Evidence Readout). It organizes this readout with center support, semantic presence, retrieval score, and geometric offsets into a 23-D representation, trains a shared scorer with localization-success labels, and at inference reranks existing hypotheses and returns their original coordinates. Experiments cover four public backbones and a corrected Des4Pos reimplementation across five domains. Excluding one protocol-reference configuration, exploratory TEST point estimates on the remaining 24 configurations show Top-1@5\,m above Original on 23 and Cell R@1 above Original on all 24. On development-set VAL, the Fine readout improves Top-1@5\,m by 5.77 percentage points (pp) over a center surrogate on corrected Des4Pos*KITTI, and the complete scoring scheme improves it by 13.98\,pp over FSR on MambaPlace$\times$nuScenesFull; the latter measures the complete scheme, not learned ranking alone.

AI.tldr: SCAR对固定候选区域及其精定位坐标重排序，以定位成功概率而非检索顺序选择输出。
AI.motivation: 区域与描述的检索相关性并不代表坐标准确性，低排名候选也可能成功定位。
AI.method: 在实际精定位点读取空间证据，结合语义、检索分数与几何偏移构建23维特征并训练共享评分器。
AI.result: 探索性测试中，24种配置有23种提升5米内首选定位成功率，全部提升首选单元召回率。
AI.conclusion: 候选固定时，精定位点条件化证据与完整评分方案可改善选择，但收益需结合具体配置与协议解读。

title: D2ToF: One-Step Diffusion for Depth Super-Resolution from Lightweight Single-Photon LiDAR Waveforms
summary: Single-photon LiDAR (SPL) sensors offer exceptional temporal resolution and single-photon sensitivity for depth imaging. However, cost-effective SPL arrays typically suffer from extremely low spatial resolutions (e.g. $8\times 8$ pixels), limiting their real-world utility. In this paper, we propose a novel, one-step super-resolution framework, D2ToF, Distilled Diffusion for Time-of-Flight, that bridges the gap between high-fidelity generative modeling and real-time execution. Our approach uses an amortized variational distillation strategy that allows for a measurement-based data consistency term to be incorporated directly into the one-step training objective. This encourages that the synthesized high-resolution depth maps are consistent with the captured low-resolution Time-of-Flight (ToF) histograms. To overcome the severe ill-posedness of upsampling extremely degraded inputs, we introduce a multimodal guidance strategy. By leveraging a foundational monocular depth model to extract structural priors from a high-resolution reflectivity image, our network is guided by a rich triad of the ToF histogram, reflectivity map, and relative depth estimate. Experimental results outperform evaluated baselines, achieving $16\times$ spatial super-resolution (from $8\times 8 \times 100$ histograms to $128\times 128$ depth maps) at an accelerated inference speed of approximately $83$ milliseconds.

AI.tldr: D2ToF利用一步蒸馏扩散，将低分辨率单光子激光雷达波形重建为高分辨率深度图。
AI.motivation: 低成本单光子激光雷达空间分辨率极低，需要兼顾深度重建质量、测量一致性与实时性。
AI.method: 采用摊销变分蒸馏并加入测量一致性项，以飞行时间直方图、反射率图和单目相对深度联合引导。
AI.result: 优于所评估基线，可将8×8×100直方图重建为128×128深度图，推理约需83毫秒。
AI.conclusion: 一步扩散结合多模态结构先验，可实现极低分辨率单光子测量的快速高倍深度超分辨率。

title: RACE: Ranking-Uncertainty Aware Capacity-Adaptive Customization for Efficient Sequential Recommendation
summary: Efficient sequential recommendation has emerged as a promising paradigm for providing real-time personalized service. To deploy models under resource-constrained environment, model compression becomes a necessity, yet existing methods typically apply uniform compression ratios, overlooking the heterogeneity in user intent complexity. This "one-size-fits-all" approach leads to a fundamental Capacity-Complexity Mismatch, where computational resources are either wasted on simple instances or insufficient for complex ones. To address this, we propose RACE (Ranking-uncertainty Aware Capacity-Adaptive Customization for Efficient Sequential Recommendation), a framework that dynamically adapts both model structures and input sequences with uncertainty-aware compression ratios. To ensure capacity-adaptive inference, RACE captures the model's intrinsic uncertainty of its predictions and transforms it into a proactive resource allocator. Specifically, we derive a list-wise ranking-uncertainty metric from the distributional stability of top-$K$ predictions, which serves as a measurable proxy for instance complexity. A lightweight predictor is then trained via self-supervision to anticipate this uncertainty from early-layer features. Guided by this signal, RACE performs instance-specific slimming in two dimensions: a hypernetwork-style channel sensitivity extractor identifies parameter redundancy, while importance-aware progressive sequence filtering mitigates data redundancy. Extensive experiments on four popular datasets demonstrate that RACE outperforms state-of-the-art baselines on accuracy, efficiency, and adaptability.
comment: Accepted by WSDM 2027 (Main Conference)

AI.tldr: RACE依据排序不确定性，按实例动态压缩推荐模型通道与输入序列。
AI.motivation: 统一压缩比例忽视用户意图复杂度差异，导致简单实例资源浪费、复杂实例容量不足。
AI.method: 从前K项预测稳定性定义排序不确定性，以早层特征自监督预测，并指导通道裁剪与渐进序列过滤。
AI.result: 四个常用数据集上的实验表明，RACE在准确性、效率和适应性上优于现有先进基线。
AI.conclusion: 将排序不确定性转化为资源分配信号，有助于缓解序列推荐中的容量与复杂度失配。

title: Probabilities of Causation in Nondeterministic Causal Models
summary: We study probabilities of causation in nondeterministic causal models, where mechanisms may remain intrinsically stochastic even after all latent variables are fixed. Focusing on binary treatments and outcomes, we develop a generic identification program that represents observational and interventional data as moment constraints on latent stochastic mechanism types and computes minimal/maximal values of counterfactual quantities via constrained optimization. Within this framework, we derive sharp analytic bounds on the probabilities of causation under several assumptions tailored to nondeterministic models. Resulting identification regions are often more informative than those attainable under deterministic alternatives. We illustrate the practical relevance of these results in a case study on personalized treatment decisions and experiments on semi-synthetic datasets. Our results clarify how classical bounds relate to nondeterministic causal semantics, generalizing previous works and providing a unified route from qualitative structural restrictions to computable partial identification regions.
comment: 24 pages, 6 figures

title: Dancing Tokens on the Vocabulary Network from LLM Generation
summary: Large language models (LLMs) generate text one token at a time, yet how a particular generation relates to the geometry learned in pre-training remains unclear. The fundamental explainability of LLMs is elusive. Here, we build a similarity network from the input embeddings of six open LLMs and map generation onto it. The token-embedding network is scale-free while heavy-tailed, as are random embeddings with matched covariance, but far more fragmented. Distillation barely changes this topology because input embeddings are largely inherited. The knowledge space is thus deterministic from pre-training. Consecutive generated tokens are rarely graph neighbours and, in most models, no more often than in shuffled order, so generation is not a walk on the predefined network, although the tokens it visits are concentrated within it. Through the logit lens in a layer- wise manner, tokens settle late in depth in most models, and repetitive models remain confined to small domain-specific sub-graphs. These observables could serve as inference-time monitors of degeneration. We thus provide a fresh perspective on understanding LLM generation in the microscopic way from node or link prediction by graph learning.
comment: 24 pages, 6 figures

title: Lens: Training-Free Semantic Search for Cross-Tile Object and Scene Retrieval in Satellite Imagery
summary: We developed Lens, a training-free system for semantic object and scene search across large satellite mosaics that requires no detector trained for the class of interest. Lens represents each tile with a frozen, self-supervised vision transformer (DINOv3), removes the positional bias in its dense features by projecting them onto the subspace orthogonal to a positional basis estimated once from a constant image, and centers the debiased features on the mean feature computed across the whole area before comparison. Lens forms a query by averaging the centered features of a small neighborhood of patches around a chosen point, or of an entire tile for scene-level search, and matches it against the index by cosine similarity. It stores the centered patch features in a byte-quantized similarity index that supports real-time range search over a mosaic of thousands of patches, and a coarser whole-tile embedding index for scene-level retrieval. A guided upsampling network (AnyUp) runs once per tile to recover pixel-accurate boundaries beyond the native feature grid, and the result is cached so later queries reuse it. We evaluated Lens on the 5,128-tile DFC2020 test set and ran it as an interactive tool on five Sentinel-2 areas spanning agricultural, industrial, and desert terrain; the pipeline is not tied to a specific sensor. On DFC2020 a single click reaches 0.09 to 0.80 pixel F1 across eight land-cover classes at the per-class best threshold, with a mean F1 of 0.39, and it beats a pairwise INSID3 baseline on six of the eight classes at roughly four hundred times lower query cost. Indexing 1.31 million patches takes 169 s on one CPU thread, and a click returns a rendered overlay in 6 to 10 ms.

title: ParetoM$^3$: Learning on the Pareto Set under Preference Guidance via Min-Max-Min Optimization
summary: Learning across multiple inherently conflicting objectives requires selecting desirable trade-offs from the Pareto set. In this work, we study preference-guided multi-objective optimization, where a predefined preference function is minimized over the weak Pareto set of multiple nonconvex objectives. Leveraging a merit function that vanishes on the weak Pareto set, we propose a penalty-based min-max-min formulation, termed the M$^3$ problem, which unifies preference optimization and the enforcement of weak Pareto optimality in a single objective. We further develop ParetoM$^3$, a single-loop first-order algorithm for computing stationary solutions of the resulting M$^3$ problem. Under a local Kurdyka-Lojasiewicz assumption, we prove that ParetoM$^3$ finds an $\epsilon$-stationary point of the M$^3$ problem that is also approximately weakly Pareto optimal for the original multi-objective problem when the penalty parameter is sufficiently large, with explicit non-asymptotic convergence rates. We also show that this stationarity notion recovers existing optimality criteria, including approximate preference stationarity and approximate Karush-Kuhn-Tucker conditions, under the same assumptions used in prior works. Experiments on a synthetic benchmark, image classification, regression, and math reasoning demonstrate that ParetoM$^3$ reliably attains preferred weak Pareto optimal solutions while achieving strong practical performance. Code is available at this https URL.

title: Pose-based Neural Clothing for Animated Characters
summary: Traditional garment simulation for animated characters is a time-consuming bottleneck for artists due to slow simulations and tedious parameter this http URL data-driven methods offer a powerful alternative, capable of learning from a dataset of simulated data to generate high-quality deformations. A lightweight network design allows data-driven systems to achieve a real-time inference speed. This significantly improves the artist workflow, as they can interactively pose a character and see high-quality folds and wrinkles at animation time, thereby allowing to make creative decisions ahead of time. However, existing neural clothing methods have presented appealing results on datasets based on realistic human models (\eg SMPL), but when trained on animated character datasets, they struggle to generalize to unseen poses. In this paper, we aim at designing neural networks and training strategies to generalize better to unseen poses in real-time to enable the interactive posing applications. We focus on a production-oriented setting where the model is trained for a single garment in a quasi-static setup. Technically, we leverage a smooth, expressive latent space by first training a Variational Auto-Encoder (VAE). We then progressively train the VAE encoder to transition from reconstruction to pose-driven prediction. To guide this prediction, we condition the network on both low-dimensional pose parameters and character body surface displacements. Finally, we introduce a novel local gradient histogram loss that mitigates the over-smoothing effect of reconstruction losses. Extensive evaluations on production-level assets and public datasets demonstrate that our method produces sharp, realistic wrinkles, smooth large-scale drape, and temporal coherence in real-time, offering a robust and easily integrable solution for interactive posing workflows.

title: Linear Modeling of Hybrid Shipboard Power Systems under Pulsed Power Load Operation
summary: A model-based approach is a valuable tool in the power system design process, enabling the integration of component models and the evaluation of dynamic interactions. Simplified models support rapid preliminary assessments by allowing parameters and configurations to be adjusted. This paper investigates the effects of high-bandwidth loads in hybrid AC--DC shipboard power systems. The problem is addressed by developing a linear model aimed at capturing the relevant dynamics over the time scale of interest with reduced computational effort. A LVDC subsystem has been developed with a battery energy storage system that supports the grid during pulsed power load operation. A control strategy has been proposed to satisfy transient requirements. The proposed approach is validated under different pulsed power load conditions using a high-fidelity model developed in DIgSILENT PowerFactory, which preserves nonlinearities and includes converter switching effects and digital control implementation. The validation shows that the model captures the relevant transient behavior with significantly reduced simulation time, while maintaining acceptable accuracy, making it suitable for rapid preliminary design studies.

title: Deep Bundle Adjustment
summary: We present \textbf{DeepBA} (\textbf{Deep} \textbf{B}undle \textbf{A}djustment), a graph neural network (GNN) that recovers camera poses, intrinsics, and scene structure from 2D matches across an arbitrary number of views. Rather than solving a non-linear least-squares problem per scene, DeepBA amortizes bundle adjustment into a learned graph network that iteratively refines its estimate from geometric residuals. Where classical SfM computes its updates analytically and needs careful initialization, DeepBA learns them and converges from a cold start. It is trained with scale-invariant supervision (ground-truth rotation, translation direction, and intrinsics, plus reprojection self-consistency), so datasets with arbitrary metric units can be mixed without per-scene normalization. DeepBA is decoupled from the matcher. At 2.04M parameters, it outperforms prior learned SfM from matches on scene reconstruction and on most pose metrics, is competitive with classical SfM at moderate accuracy thresholds and overtakes it in wall time as the view count grows, and approaches monolithic image-to-geometry transformers such as VGGT ($\sim$1.2B parameters) with greater modularity. Project~page: this https URL

title: Structural Self-Teaching for Compositional Generation in Unified Multimodal Models
summary: We propose Structural Self-Teaching (SST), a novel framework that enhances compositional image generation in diffusion-based unified multimodal models (UMMs) by leveraging their internal understanding path as a source of structural supervision. The generation path of UMMs often struggles with dense compositional prompts, leading to missing objects, attribute binding failures, and spatial errors. In contrast, their understanding path localizes the same phrases in images that satisfy these prompts. SST converts this phrase-level grounding into training-time structural signals for the generation path. Specifically, we extract phrase-conditioned support masks from internal attention maps derived from the understanding path and employ them through two mechanisms. Phrase-local contrastive alignment uses these masks as pooling regions and aligns each generated phrase region with the same region of the target image. A structural scaffold builds a phrase-level layout from the same masks and modulates an intermediate spatial state of the generation path during training. The scaffold is phased out during training and removed at inference. SST requires no external structural annotations for training and no additional input at test time. Extensive experiments across multiple UMMs demonstrate that SST improves compositional fidelity over LoRA fine-tuning on the same data, with no inference-time cost. Project page is available at this https URL
comment: NeurIPS 2026

AI.tldr: 结构自教学利用统一多模态模型自身的理解路径，提升组合图像生成的结构一致性。

title: TetraCoder: Adaptive Tetrahedral Encoding for Neural Fields
summary: Implicit and explicit representations of geometry are central in computer graphics applications and come with their pros and cons. With surface sampling being faster on explicit representations and spatial queries being faster on implicit representations, finding efficient conversions between them is a highly desirable property. We present TetraCoder, a single resolution hash-free adaptive tetrahedral encoding that links an explicit tetrahedral spatial encoder with an underlying implicit signed distance field (SDF). The resulting hybrid implicit-explicit space is continuous piecewise affine (CPWA) by design, allowing to obtain an exact correspondence between the implicit SDF and the explicit analytic mesh. TetraCoder's design comes with additional perks, in particular: (a) it scales better than multi-resolution encoding methods due to its single resolution optimizable grid, (b) unlike hash-based methods, it is not affected by collisions, (c) it enables fast tetrahedral ray-tracing, geometry and appearance editing, directly through its adaptive tetrahedral scaffold. We demonstrate the versatility of TetraCoder by showing an improvement over state-of-the-art methods on multiple tasks: 2D/3D fitting from images and point clouds, 3D novel view synthesis, 3D reconstruction, and geometry/appearance editing.
comment: 8 pages, 4 figures

title: From Bytes to Behavior: Request-Level Attribution from Live GPU Hidden States
summary: Existing memory forensics for machine learning systems typically targets static artifacts, such as model weights or prompt logs, rather than the transient computational states of a live inference process. This gap limits an examiner's ability to analyze the specific behavior of a running large language model (LLM) service that cannot be restarted or modified. We present a method for acquiring per-layer residual-stream activations from a live GPU process using a non-modifying debugger, without requiring prior knowledge of the model's architecture parameters or weights. The approach employs a general six-stage process with platform-specific adapters, utilizing either a PyTorch allocator clock or a kernel-launch clock to identify and read tensor allocations from video memory. We validate this acquisition on 33 open-source decoder-only models across nine architecture classes, demonstrating that the recovered bytes are byte-exact and usable for downstream analysis. As a use case, we apply linear probes trained on standard framework activations to the recovered states, successfully distinguishing refusal from compliance with an AUROC of 0.88 on held-out prompts. This work establishes that live, observational access to intermediate hidden states is feasible on named inference platforms, providing a new source of evidence for examining the operational behavior of deployed AI systems.
comment: 7 pages, 1 figure, 4 tables

title: Right Token, Right Time: From Per-Token Gating to Trajectory-Aware Activation Steering
summary: Activation steering via sparse autoencoders (SAEs) enables behavioral control of large language models without task-specific fine-tuning. Yet, standard methods apply the steering signal at every generated token, displacing representations from the distribution the model was trained on and eroding generation quality. We show that \emph{when} along a generation the intervention is applied is a decisive axis of control. We cast steering as a per-token allocation problem under a fixed budget of steerable tokens, so that methods differ only in which tokens they select, making allocation the sole variable. Within this framework we introduce two gates. The first, Contrastive Feature Projection (CFP), is memoryless and selects the tokens least aligned with the target behavior through a sparse, interpretable feature projection. The second, Closed-Loop Adaptive Bernoulli Steering (CLABS), is trajectory aware. It treats allocation as closed-loop feedback control, tracking the alignment a generation has accumulated so far and spending budget where the trajectory falls behind. On a linear steering-response model we derive an explicit gain region that guarantees closed-loop stability of CLABS and show that its integral term reduces the steady-state tracking offset. Empirically, CFP and CLABS achieve the largest behavioral shift among budgeted gates at matched budgets, with CLABS strongest under the tight budgets where allocation matters most, while best preserving fluency.

title: Clean Tickets, Wrong Orders: Catching Silent Errors with a Language Model in Your Browser Tab
summary: A small language model that turns a typed order into structure can fail in two ways. It can print something broken, which any system rejects. Or it can print a clean, well formed order that nobody placed. Our companion work calls the second kind a silent error, and it is the dangerous one. We present a web demo in which a fine-tuned 0.8B parameter model runs entirely inside the visitor's browser tab, through this http URL compiled to WebAssembly. No order text leaves the device. The page parses orders as the visitor types, scores every ticket with the PIZZA benchmark's own matcher ported to TypeScript, refuses anything off the menu with "?" so the model can face the open web, and lets visitors hunt for silent errors or try to cause one. Run in the browser on all 1,357 PIZZA test orders, the deployed model writes the same output as the server evaluation for 99.0% of them and reaches the same exact match (0.882); we also report its latency on 3 consumer laptops. Demo: this https URL

title: PrivacyPR: A Dataset of Real-World Privacy Fixes for Benchmarking Privacy-Aware Code Review
summary: Coding agents increasingly review code, yet whether they catch the privacy defects that laws such as the GDPR require software to avoid remains largely untested, partly because few datasets connect real privacy defects to their accepted fixes and review context. We present PrivacyPR, a dataset of 4,131 merged GitHub pull requests (PRs) from 1,469 repositories, created between June 2018 and January 2024. Each PR includes its commits, diffs, review discussion, and LLM-generated labels for privacy relevance, fix type, and GDPR principles. PrivacyPR provides 1,169 high-confidence privacy fixes and 1,643 non-fix PRs, together with Verified, a manually checked split of 250 privacy fixes and 250 non-fix PRs, and Small, a 100 + 100 subset for evaluation. On Verified, both annotators endorsed 72% of the LLM's GDPR-principle assignments. Beyond supporting empirical study of how privacy defects arise and are fixed, PrivacyPR provides a benchmark for privacy-aware code review on real, developer-accepted fixes. Its evaluation harness reverts each fix to reintroduce the defect. On Small, two coding agents detect only 42-51% of defects under a generic review prompt, but 88-91% when explicitly asked to check privacy, while flagging 11-15% of non-fix PRs. These results show that privacy defects can be detected by coding agents, but that detection depends strongly on review intent and comes with false alarms. Data, code, reviews, judge verdicts, and an extensible evaluation harness are publicly available at this https URL.

title: When evaluation becomes intervention in clinical AI
summary: AI judges, models that grade another system's output against a rubric, extend clinical review to the scale at which clinical AI writes. When teams use judge assessments to select a prompt or train a model, the judge becomes part of the intervention. Selection can then favor errors the judge overlooks. We describe what a judge's report must contain and the independent clinical test each judge-driven change needs.

AI.method: 阐述评判模型报告应包含的信息，以及每次评判驱动变更所需的独立临床测试。
AI.result: 摘要未提供具体结果。
AI.conclusion: 临床AI不能仅依赖评判模型自证改进，评判驱动的变更需要独立临床检验。

title: Objectives as Policies: Vision-Language Model Cost Programs for Contact-Rich Manipulation
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) have shown strong semantic and spatial reasoning capabilities in 3D environments. Recently, connecting VLMs with model-predictive controllers (MPC) has emerged as a paradigm for combining strong semantic reasoning with physics-based planning. However, connecting these two for contact-rich robotic manipulation requires a task representation that bridges the two and captures how physical interactions can be reasoned by VLMs. In this work, we introduce Objectives as Policies (OaP), a framework that connects a pretrained VLM to a shared sampling-based MPC through an editable objective program. Each program specifies a sequence of stages for completing a task, combining running and terminal costs from a cost library with stage completion conditions. Given a natural-language task instruction and scene observation, we build a simulation-based digital twin through real-to-sim, and the VLM generates an objective program that is executed by the MPC in the simulation. The program is iteratively updated by the VLM based on MPC rollouts, before being deployed in the real world. We evaluate our framework in both simulation and the real world on four tabletop manipulation tasks, and show that it outperforms strong baselines. Additional videos and examples are available on the project website: this https URL
comment: 8 pages, 3 figures. Project website: this https URL

AI.tldr: OaP通过可编辑目标程序连接视觉语言模型与模型预测控制，实现接触密集型机器人操作。
AI.motivation: 接触密集型操作需要能衔接视觉语言模型语义推理与物理规划的任务表示。
AI.method: 由视觉语言模型生成分阶段代价程序，在数字孪生中依据控制器轨迹迭代更新后部署到现实。
AI.result: 在仿真和真实环境的四项桌面操作任务中，该框架优于强基线。
AI.conclusion: 可编辑目标程序可作为语义推理与物理控制的桥梁，支持接触密集型操作。

title: PROOF: Perceptive Robustness via Out-of-Distribution Fallback for Legged Locomotion
summary: Vision-based perceptive locomotion has enabled legged robots to achieve agile and terrain-aware locomotion across complex environments. However, the reliability of such systems heavily depends on visual observations, which are inherently susceptible to occlusion, reflective surfaces, and illumination variations, often resulting in catastrophic locomotion failures under degraded perception conditions. In this paper, we present PROOF (Perceptive Robustness via Out-of-Distribution Fallback for Legged Locomotion), a perceptive locomotion framework that enables robust locomotion under severe visual disturbances. Our method adopts a two-stage teacher-student learning paradigm that explicitly models perception reliability: the teacher learns both perception-driven and proprioceptive fallback behaviors, while the student predicts exteroceptive features with uncertainty and suppresses them under out-of-distribution inputs. We evaluate our method on a Unitree Go2 quadruped equipped with a RealSense D435 depth camera in real-world settings. Under normal visual conditions, our method enables the robot to successfully perform high-dynamic parkour maneuvers, including traversing large gaps, elevated platforms, and narrow beam terrains. Under severe visual degradation, such as heavy occlusion and strong illumination changes, the robot continues to maintain stable and robust locomotion performance.
comment: CoRL 2026

AI.tldr: PROOF通过感知不确定性估计和本体感觉回退，使四足机器人在严重视觉干扰下保持稳定运动。
AI.motivation: 视觉运动控制易受遮挡、反光和光照变化影响，感知退化可能导致灾难性运动失败。
AI.method: 采用两阶段教师—学生学习，教师学习视觉及本体感觉回退行为，学生预测特征不确定性并抑制分布外输入。
AI.result: Go2机器人在正常视觉下完成跨沟、登台和窄梁跑酷，在重度遮挡及强光变化下仍保持稳定运动。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模感知可靠性并启用本体感觉回退，可增强视觉退化条件下的足式运动鲁棒性。

title: AI for Parameter Selection in Sample-based Quantum Diagonalization
summary: Sample-based Quantum Diagonalization (SQD) methods provide a way to compute molecular ground-state energies, but their accuracy and runtime depend sensitively on configuration choices such as the subspace dimension, propagation timestep, and the allocation of a fixed sampling budget across circuits, for which no formal selection method exists. In this work, we explore whether oracle models can predict the quantum runtime and approximation error from the Hamiltonian and the candidate configuration. Using synthetic Hamiltonians with controllable spectral properties, we show that machine-learned models can map a Hamiltonian directly to the best-ranked configuration within a predefined grid for the SKQD algorithm, validated against classical Krylov propagation, achieving strong rank correlations between true and predicted error and runtime, Spearman $\rho = 0.969$ and $\rho = 0.905$, respectively. Extending the approach to 50 molecular Hamiltonians (20-50 qubits), with reference ground-state energies from classical calculations, we train regressors that predict the simulation error and runtime for a given molecule--configuration pair ahead of execution, and classifiers to distinguish, from 600 SqDRIFT quantum-hardware runs, whether a configuration achieves a ground-state energy within chemical accuracy ($1.6\times10^{-3}$ Ha $\approx 1$ kcal/mol). For the molecular Hamiltonians, the models additionally provide an a priori feasibility and resource estimate, predicting whether a molecule can reach chemical accuracy on current hardware and at what runtime, thus correctly classifying held-out molecules at the molecule level, achieving balanced accuracy 61.8% in-distribution and 100% for five larger held-out molecules.

AI.tldr: 利用机器学习预测采样量子对角化的误差与运行时间，辅助参数选择及化学精度可行性判断。
AI.motivation: 采样量子对角化的精度和耗时高度依赖配置，但缺乏正式的参数选择方法。
AI.method: 基于合成及50个分子哈密顿量训练误差、耗时预测模型，并利用600次硬件运行训练化学精度分类器。
AI.result: 合成数据误差与耗时排序相关系数为0.969和0.905；分子可行性分类平衡准确率为61.8%，五个更大分子为100%。
AI.conclusion: 学习模型可在执行前辅助配置排序，并估计分子达到化学精度的可行性与资源需求。

title: Hierarchical Interactions in Mobility Networks: A Model-Free Feedback Approach
summary: Urban mobility systems are large-scale networked systems whose performance emerges from hierarchically coupled decisions of public authorities, competing mobility operators, and travelers. Existing approaches to policy design either collapse one of these levels or assume that the authority can model and differentiate through the equilibrium responses of operators and travelers. In this paper, we model policy design as a tri-level game on a multimodal network, in which a municipality sets taxes, licenses, and integration subsidies, a public transport and a taxi operator compete on prices and service supply, and heterogeneous travelers reach a stochastic user equilibrium. We prove that the traveler equilibrium is unique and continuously differentiable in the operator strategies, that the variational inequality characterizing operator equilibria admits a solution for every policy, and that the resulting tri-level game admits a Stackelberg equilibrium. Building on this structure, we design a model-free hierarchical controller in which the municipality and the operators update their decisions from zeroth-order evaluations of observed equilibrium outcomes. On the Zurich multimodal network, operator equilibria computed from different initializations differ by a median of 0.3% in the municipal objective. On a grid of 3,125 policies, only those that subsidize transfers between public transport and taxis benefit both operators, and 24 of them also lower travel costs without degrading the municipal objective. Finally, the controller matches the best policies of three black-box optimizers and terminates at the most consistent policies across runs.
comment: 12 pages

AI.tldr: 将城市交通政策建模为三级博弈，并以无模型分层反馈协调政府、运营商与出行者决策。
AI.motivation: 现有政策设计常忽略某层参与者，或假设政府能够建模并求导运营商与出行者的均衡响应。
AI.method: 建立政府、竞争运营商和异质出行者的三级博弈，证明均衡性质，并设计基于零阶观测的分层控制器。
